def quick_items(items, wall, keep, current=None, no_recall=True):
    """The quick window: the wall without the memory's rows; the running
    round whole -- the person's words and every call/result pair of it --
    and before it the last `keep` elements of the earlier rounds, the cut
    never between a tool call and its result: it moves back to the call of
    every result it would orphan, so an older pair at the boundary stays
    whole. `current` is the call's round `(session_id, turn_id)`; without
    one, or when no element is of it, the newest round of the items.

    GH #1347: `keep` counted over the whole window cut the formulation round
    of three `weather` calls side by side (one question + 3 calls + 3
    results = 7 elements) to its last four: one call and the three results.
    The question and two calls fell out, two results stood without their
    call, and the answer named one or two of the three cities; with the
    whole round the same model named all three (a replay of the formulation
    request)."""
    kinds = {int(r.get("seq") or 0): str(r.get("kind") or "")
             for r in (wall or []) if isinstance(r, dict)}
    # T4-08 (GH #1247): a candidate pair is a `memory_recall` pair in the
    # wall, but no recall -- the quick round keeps it.
    kept = [it for it in items if not no_recall or kinds.get(it[0], "") not in QUICK_NO_KINDS
            or str(it[1].get("id") or "").startswith("call_candidates_")]
    keys = round_keys([r for r in (wall or []) if isinstance(r, dict)])
    rounds = [keys.get(it[0]) for it in kept]
    cur = tuple(current) if current else None
    if cur not in rounds:
        cur = next((k for k in reversed(rounds) if k is not None), None)
    first = next((i for i, k in enumerate(rounds) if cur is not None and k == cur),
                 len(kept))
    before = kept[:first]
    if keep <= 0 or len(before) <= keep:
        return kept
    start = len(before) - keep
    call_at = {str(it[1].get("id") or ""): i for i, it in enumerate(before)
               if str(it[1].get("type") or "") == "tool_call"}
    moved = True
    while moved:
        moved = False
        for it in before[start:]:
            if str(it[1].get("type") or "") != "tool_result":
                continue
            at = call_at.get(str(it[1].get("id") or ""), start)
            if at < start:
                start, moved = at, True
                break
    return before[start:] + kept[first:]


def recall_unneeded(hop, ctx):
    """True when a stamped turn names no `memory` need (GH #1441): a path, no
    `memory` in `needs`, and not a `talk` turn whose stamp is a fallback (A11:
    the route did not judge the needs, so its empty `needs` say nothing)."""
    path = str(hop.get("path") or ctx.get("path") or "").strip()
    if not path or "memory" in names_list(hop.get("needs") or ctx.get("needs")):
        return False
    return not (path == "talk" and str(hop.get("fallback") or "").strip())


# D54g (GH #1506, contract point 8): the keys of the route stamp's trail that the
# `route` mark takes.
TRAIL_KEYS = ("first", "p", "fallback", "sharpened", "second", "second_ms")


def route_trail(hop):
    """What the early verdict did with the turn, off the seam `hop` (`trail`, the JSON
    text of an object, as `needs_yes` travels): the first verdict's class and
    confidence, why the stamp is a fallback, whether a second verdict took its place,
    that verdict and how long it took. WHY on the `route` mark: the stamp says only
    the class that stood; the bars of the early verdict are calibrated from what it
    said BEFORE a bar or a second judge changed it, and the ledger is the one place a
    running colony keeps that. `{}` without a readable trail -- the mark of before.
    Names, numbers and booleans only: the trail never carries what the person said,
    and nothing else of the hop is read here."""
    trail = hop.get("trail") if isinstance(hop, dict) else None
    trail = loads(trail, {}) if isinstance(trail, str) else trail
    if not isinstance(trail, dict):
        return {}
    return {k: trail[k] for k in TRAIL_KEYS
            if isinstance(trail.get(k), (str, bool, int, float))}


def recall_sure_no(hop, bound):
    """GH #1466: the yes-value of the memory question when the route stamp on the seam
    `hop` SURELY says the turn needs no memory, else None. Sure is all of: a judged
    stamp (a path, no `fallback`), no `memory` among its `needs`, and a readable
    yes-value of the memory question (`needs_yes`, the JSON text of `{<need>: yes}`)
    of at most `bound`. WHY the yes-value and not `p`: `p` is the confidence of the
    PATH, and an empty `needs` holds a yes of 0.45 as well as one of 0.02. Everything
    unreadable is unsure -- no key (a route cell with `stamp_needs_yes` off, an older
    one), no object, no `memory` in it, a value that is no number from 0 to 1 (a
    bool is no number here), a bound that is none: a wrong "needs no memory" costs
    most when the person tells without asking, so only a stated low yes counts."""
    if not isinstance(hop, dict) or str(hop.get("fallback") or "").strip():
        return None
    if not str(hop.get("path") or "").strip() or "memory" in names_list(hop.get("needs")):
        return None
    yes = hop.get("needs_yes")
    yes = loads(yes, {}) if isinstance(yes, str) else yes
    yes = yes.get("memory") if isinstance(yes, dict) else None
    for v in (yes, bound):
        if isinstance(v, bool) or not isinstance(v, (int, float)) or not 0 <= v <= 1:
            return None
    return yes if yes <= bound else None


def family_in(name, names):
    """A tool name (`web_search`) or a family (`web`) among `names`."""
    return name in names or name.split("_")[0] in names


def menu_name(name, folded, menu=()):
    """GH #1346: the entry of the folded menu that carries the tool `name`.
    The `llm` cell matches scope names exactly against the menu it gets
    (`tool_scope.rs`, `matches_name`), and with the fold on an op of a folded
    family is on it only as its family: a stub run stamped `set_timer`, the
    collector had folded `set_pin` and `set_timer` into `set`, and the model
    got `[orga, story_read, weather, web]` -- no timer. A name on the menu
    (`menu`, the call's `tools.*` leaves) or a folded family itself stays; a
    name under a folded family (`folded`, the seam's `tools_folded`, longest
    family first like the collector's `family_of`) becomes that family; any
    other name stands for itself."""
    if name in menu or name in folded:
        return name
    for f in sorted(folded, key=len, reverse=True):
        if name.startswith(f + "_") and len(name) > len(f) + 1:
            return f
    return name


def menu_names(names, folded, menu=()):
    """`menu_name` of every name, stated order, each entry once."""
    out = []
    for n in names:
        v = menu_name(n, folded, menu)
        if v not in out:
            out.append(v)
    return out


def quick_scope(families, scope, folded=(), menu=(), klass=()):
    """A scoped call's `tool_scope` (R-WM-1, the curator owns what is
    visible): the class's tools (`klass`: the list `allow` of the target's
    profile, contract point 3) and the
    stamp's families, inside the channel's own allow when it names one; its
    deny stays. The class's tools stand at the ops stage, a stamped family
    outside the class at the hint stage. Every name is stated as the folded menu names it
    (`menu_name`, GH #1346): what the scope allows is on the menu the model
    gets, as its family or under its own name."""
    scope = scope if isinstance(scope, dict) else {}
    quick = menu_names(klass, folded, menu)
    want = quick + [f for f in menu_names(families, folded, menu) if f not in quick]
    allow = want
    if scope.get("allow"):
        allow = [n for n in menu_names(names_list(scope.get("allow")), folded, menu)
                 if family_in(n, want)]
    out = {"allow": allow}
    if scope.get("deny"):
        out["deny"] = names_list(scope.get("deny"))
    # GH #1248 (T4-12, R-WM-1): a family outside the class in the hint form --
    # name, first sentence, `{op}` -- a short menu for the first token.
    out["hint"] = [n for n in allow if not family_in(n, quick)]
    return out

def spec_cut(scope, tools, folded=(), menu=()):
    """The spec call's `tool_scope`: the lead's `spec_tools` (`tools`) only,
    inside the channel's allow, its deny kept, cut with the call's menu;
    never `require`, never the class's `quick_tools` and no hint stage."""
    scope = scope if isinstance(scope, dict) else {}
    want = menu_names(tools, folded, menu)
    allow = want
    if scope.get("allow"):
        allow = [n for n in menu_names(names_list(scope.get("allow")), folded, menu)
                 if family_in(n, want)]
    out = {"allow": allow}
    if scope.get("deny"):
        out["deny"] = names_list(scope.get("deny"))
    return out


def spec_release(held, session, turn):
    """The held answer out, twice: `spec_release` leaves the hive for the
    composite's splitter, `spec_tap` enters `./intake` as `in_llm`, so the
    wall, the episodes and the usage take it exactly like a quick answer."""
    head = dict(held.get("hop") or {})
    head.update({"finish_reason": str(held.get("finish") or ""),
                 "curator_call": str(held.get("call") or ""),
                 "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn, "iter": "0"})
    if held.get("episode_turn_id"):
        head["episode_turn_id"] = str(held.get("episode_turn_id"))
    msgs = [m for m in held.get("messages") or [] if isinstance(m, dict)]
    return [{"header": dict(head, route="spec_release"), "messages": msgs},
            {"header": dict(head, route="spec_tap"), "messages": msgs}]


def spec_mark(cid, session, turn, row, verdict, why, stamp, held=None):
    """One `spec` mark per turn that speculated: when it fired, when
    it was decided, kept or dropped, and why -- and (#1279) what the spec
    call cost, null while its answer is not in."""
    value = {"call": str(row.get("call") or ""),
             "fired_ms": epoch_ms(row.get("fired_at")),
             "done_ms": epoch_ms(stamp), "verdict": verdict,
             "reason": why,
             "cost": ((held or {}).get("hop") or {}).get("cost")}
    if held and not held.get("answer") and held.get("finish"):
        # GH #1382: a spec answer that failed says how (R034 lab run 2: a
        # provider timeout after 3 001 ms read only as `no_answer`).
        value["spec_error"] = {"finish": str(held.get("finish")),
                               "error_code": str(held.get("error_code") or "")}
    return (cid, ins("marks", with_audience({
        "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 7, "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn,
        # D58 target (N8, OR-d58-2.target.46): a neutral kind, no cell's name.
        "kind": "spec",
        "value": canonical(value),
        "at": stamp}, the_round)))


def late_spec_mark(cid, session, turn, call, held):
    """GH #1398 (V1): one `late_spec_discarded` mark for a spec answer that
    came after its turn was decided without it (its row went with the drop):
    discarded, never released, and nothing is sent on it."""
    stamp = now()
    return (cid, ins("marks", with_audience({
        "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 8, "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn,
        "kind": "late_spec_discarded",
        "value": canonical({"call": call, "finish": str(held.get("finish") or ""),
                            "cost": (held.get("hop") or {}).get("cost")}),
        "at": stamp}, the_round)))


def with_shown(sends, text):
    """GH #1432: the model calls of `sends` with the sentence a speculation
    already showed as their own last message, already delivered. Telegram
    round 4 (turns 2 and 5): the first spec sentence went out as a partial,
    the spec call timed out (`handle_ms=6502 first_partial_ms=4833`), the
    stored call -- and in turn 5 the brain after it -- wrote the answer anew
    in other words, and the rim, which cuts only an answer that begins with
    the shown text, sent it whole: the content twice. With the sentence as
    its own words the model writes on from there (on a Claude wire the llm
    cell makes it the note `TRAILING_ASSISTANT_NOTE`, GH #1282). A side call
    (its head field `call_kind`) and every send that is no model call stay as
    they are."""
    out = []
    for m in sends or []:
        head = (m.get("header") or {}) if isinstance(m, dict) else {}
        if isinstance(m, dict) and str(head.get("route") or "") == MODEL_ROUTE \
                and str(head.get(KIND_FIELD) or "") != SIDE_KIND \
                and isinstance(m.get("messages"), list):
            m = dict(m, messages=list(m["messages"]) + [
                {"origin": "assistant", "type": "text", "text": text}])
        out.append(m)
    return out


# GH #1432 / #1447: the ledger copy of a shown spec sentence, read by
# `./intake` (`shown_read`); the lead's own row has the same key.
SPEC_SHOWN_KEY = "spec_shown:"


def lead_spec(kind, session, turn, call_, **more):
    """An event of the turn's speculation for the lead (GH #1447, #1474), whose rows
    (`spec:`, `spec_held:`, `spec_fb:`, `spec_shown:`, `spec_go:`, `delta:`)
    live in its own store: a spec answer or partial, a stored fallback, a
    delta stamp, what a spec call's window showed (`spec_go`, D58 note).
    The round rides along for the marks the answer (`spec_act`) asks for."""
    return {"header": {"route": "lead_spec", "call": call_}, "messages": [],
            "event": dict(more, kind=kind, s=session, t=turn, call=call_, round=the_round)}


def go_ops_of(stored):
    """The ledger writes that go WITH a call's held sends (`go_ops`, D58 note,
    GH #1477; `horizon_ops` before). A call held in the lead -- the fallback of
    an awaited spec answer, a reused delta call, and what a spec call's own
    window showed -- carries them beside its sends; they are written only when
    those sends go, never when the call never goes. Riders today: the marks of
    the round's conditional feeds (D58 moveout, contract point 7) and the use
    of the `once` notes a window showed (their receipts ride in the sends)."""
    ops = (stored or {}).get("go_ops") if isinstance(stored, dict) else None
    return [tuple(o) for o in ops or [] if isinstance(o, list) and len(o) == 2]


def spec_act(a, call_):
    """GH #1447: what a move of the lead's speculation rows means for the
    ledger and the sends -- the `quick_spec` mark, the booking, the release,
    the stored call (with the shown sentence), the records of a call that
    never goes."""
    do = str(a.get("do") or "")
    session, turn = str(a.get("s") or ""), str(a.get("t") or "")
    row = a.get("row") if isinstance(a.get("row"), dict) else {}
    held = a.get("held") if isinstance(a.get("held"), dict) else {}
    fb = a.get("fb") if isinstance(a.get("fb"), dict) else {}
    if do == "book":
        # GH #1279: the spec call is booked on arrival like any answer the
        # tap takes -- kept or dropped, its money is spent.
        return [lstore([("h-use", upd("calls", a.get("use") or {}, {"call_id": call_}))],
                       "done", call_, "")]
    if do == "partial":
        # GH #1411 / #1415: the partial of an awaited spec call goes on.
        out = [{"header": dict(a.get("hop") or {}, route="partial"),
                "messages": [m for m in a.get("messages") or [] if isinstance(m, dict)]}]
        if a.get("shown"):
            # GH #1432 / #1447: the first shown sentence, copied to the
            # ledger for `./intake` (the wall, gh1432 pin 6); the lead keeps
            # its own row. `./intake` takes the copy down when it used it.
            key = SPEC_SHOWN_KEY + "%s#%s" % (session, turn)
            out.append(lstore([("p-shown", dict(ins("state", {
                "key": key, "value": canonical({"call": call_, "text": str(a.get("shown"))})}),
                if_absent={"key": key}))], "done", call_, ""))
        return out
    if do == "settle":
        # The awaited decision: keep -- release the held answer; drop -- the
        # stored normal call goes (GH #1432: with the shown sentence).
        keep, why = bool(a.get("keep")), str(a.get("why") or "")
        ops = [spec_mark("s-mark", session, turn, row, "kept" if keep else "dropped", why,
                         now(), held)]
        if a.get("shown_gone"):
            # GH #1432: a kept answer takes the shown sentence down (the
            # ledger copy, see `do == "partial"`).
            ops.append(("s-dsh", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                                  "where": {"key": SPEC_SHOWN_KEY + "%s#%s" % (session, turn)}}))
        go = a.get("go") if keep and isinstance(a.get("go"), dict) else {}
        if keep:
            # GH #1279: the stored call never went -- its record, its block
            # list, its -esc copy and its projection go with it.
            ops += [(c.replace("u", "f", 1), o) for c, o in
                    unsent_ops("s-u", sends_calls(fb.get("sends")))]
            # D58 note (GH #1477, contract point 3): the kept answer is what
            # the person hears; its window showed the `once` notes -- their
            # use and receipts (held by the lead, `spec_go`) go with it.
            ops += go_ops_of(go)
        sends = spec_release(held, session, turn) + list(go.get("sends") or []) if keep \
            else list(fb.get("sends") or [])
        if not keep and a.get("s_text"):
            sends = with_shown(sends, str(a.get("s_text")))
        if not keep:
            ops += go_ops_of(fb)
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: spec answer of turn %s dropped (%s) -- the stored"
                             " call goes\n" % (turn, why))
        return [lstore(ops, "done", call_, "")] + sends
    if do == "discard":
        ops = [spec_mark("h-mark", session, turn, row, "dropped", "no_answer", now(), held)] \
            if a.get("mark") else []
        if a.get("late"):
            ops.append(late_spec_mark("h-late", session, turn, call_, held))
        return [lstore(ops, "done", call_, "")]
    if do == "unsent":
        ops = unsent_ops("s-u", sends_calls(fb.get("sends")))
        return [lstore(ops, "done", call_, "")] if ops else []
    if do == "fb_go":
        ops = go_ops_of(fb)
        return ([lstore(ops, "done", call_, "")] if ops else []) + list(fb.get("sends") or [])
    if do == "delta":
        mine = a.get("mine") if isinstance(a.get("mine"), dict) else {}
        d_stamp = now()
        if a.get("won"):
            return [lstore([delta_mark("d-mark", session, turn, call_, "reused", d_stamp)]
                           + go_ops_of(mine), "done", call_, "")] + list(mine.get("sends") or [])
        ops = unsent_ops("d-u", sends_calls(mine.get("sends")))
        out = []
        if fb:
            out = list(fb.get("sends") or [])
            ops += go_ops_of(fb)
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: the delta call %s of turn %s lost its row (%r) -- never"
                         " sent\n" % (call_, turn, str(a.get("lost") or "none")))
        return [lstore(ops + [delta_mark("d-mark", session, turn, call_, "refired", d_stamp,
                                         "lost")], "done", call_, "")] + out
    sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: a spec act %r it does not know -- dropped\n" % do)
    return []

def pending_text(p):

    while a consult runs -- one the curator sent, or since GH #1280 one the
    brain started itself (`tap`)."""
    return ("A consult is pending (id %s, since %s): the backend works on this "
            "request and its answer comes on its own. Do not consult again; say it "
            "is being looked into if asked." % (p.get("consult_id", ""), p.get("at", "")))


def pending_note(p):
    """GH #1497: the pending consult as a note of the turn's notes block --
    the tail of the window, behind the cached prefix, like every other note.
    As a leaf of the system part it joined the tree with the first call after
    the consult started and left it with the advice: two changes of the front
    of the window without a rebuild (probe-10 of the strand: the call with
    the advice counted `prefix_break` 1, `curate_mark` "none"). `keep`: the
    model is told on every speaking call, whatever the role's `notes_share`
    leaves for the other notes (a share of 0 included)."""
    return {"id": CONSULT_PENDING, "source": "curator", "text": pending_text(p),
            "scope": "turn", "priority": 0, "at": "", "keep": True}

def with_deny(scope, deny):
    """A speaking call's `tool_scope` with the names the lead's verdict denies
    while a consult is pending (GH #1280, GH #1447 `deny`): the channel's own
    allow and deny kept; a scope whose `allow` does not hold the consult tool
    has nothing to take away and stays as it is. Since GH #1497 only the
    measure of what the call refuses (`cut_scope`): the menu it sends keeps
    the scope as it was."""
    out = dict(scope) if isinstance(scope, dict) else {}
    if not deny or ("allow" in out and not family_in(deny[0], names_list(out.get("allow")))):
        return scope
    have = names_list(out.get("deny"))
    out["deny"] = have + [n for n in deny if n not in have]
    return out

# >>> speaker v1 (GH #1248, T4-10)
# AFTER A TOOL RESULT THE CURATOR NAMES THE SPEAKER. A quick round that
# called a tool keeps the quick voice only while the result can be spoken as
# it is: every tool call of the turn has its result (no open gap), the newest
# result is neither empty nor an error, and the round is within
# `quick_max_iter` iterations. Anything else goes to the brain, with ONE
# `escalate` mark that says why (`iterations`, `gap`, `unspeakable`), and the
# turn stays with the brain for the rest of its round (state
# `escalated:<session>` = the turn).


def knob_int(name, default):
    """A number knob: the param, else the literal beside it."""
    v = P.get(name)
    try:
        return default if unset(v) else int(str(v))
    except ValueError:
        return default




def is_error_result(text):
    """A tool result nobody can speak as it is: empty, or an error object as
    its text -- read off its structure, never its words. A result that failed
    in plain prose is named by the collector's `tool_errors` slot instead
    (#1279, `failed_ids`)."""
    t = str(text or "").strip()
    if not t:
        return True
    try:
        v = json.loads(t)
    except Exception:
        return False
    return isinstance(v, dict) and bool(v.get("error") or v.get("error_code"))


def result_failed(r, el):
    """Whether the tool result `el` of the wall row `r` failed, as the window
    plan and its render read it (GH #1468): the verdict `./intake` wrote
    beside the row when it filed the result (`failed`, 1 or 0 -- judged once,
    from the text and from the header code the collector hands on as
    `tool_errors`). A row filed before the field holds none (NULL, or no
    key): for it the text alone decides, as before (`is_error_result`).
    Before, the rebuild knew the text only, and a failure told in prose
    under a header code was shrunk like a fine result (wave d58-2, bank find
    F2). The verdict is the row's, never the element's: it reaches no
    window. The verdict is no superset of the text's judgement -- `./intake`
    (`tool_failure`) files as not failed a result with no text, and an error
    object whose `error` is neither a string nor an object (`true`, a number,
    a list), an empty one, or a string that says there is none (NO_ERROR:
    "none", "null", "false"), when nothing else on the turn says it failed;
    a string with no code in it (a sentence) IS a failure there (wave
    d58-2, close inventory 9) --, and the fix must shrink nothing the
    rebuild kept before: a result is a failure when the verdict says so OR
    its text does (`is_error_result`)."""
    if is_error_result(el.get("text")):
        return True
    return r.get("failed") not in (None, 0, "0", False)


def failed_ids(slot):
    """GH #1279: the call ids of this iteration's tool results that came
    back with an `error_code` in their header -- the collector's `tool_errors`
    slot of the curate (`{tool_call_id: error_code}`), parked with the call by
    `./intake`. Only this iteration's codes travel there, so a later, healthy
    turn is never read as failed. A malformed slot names nothing."""
    if not isinstance(slot, dict):
        return set()
    return {str(k) for k, v in slot.items() if str(k) and str(v or "").strip()}


def speaker(it, wall, turn, failed=frozenset()):
    """The reason a fast call hands its round to its fallback (the lead
    asked, `speak_check`), "" to keep it: before any tool result (`it` 0)
    nothing changes; after one, only a speakable result stays -- never
    after a result the collector named failed (`failed`), whatever its
    words are."""
    if it < 1:
        return ""
    calls, results, last = set(), set(), None
    mine = [r for r in (wall or []) if isinstance(r, dict)
            and str(r.get("turn_id") or "") == turn
            and str(r.get("kind") or "") not in QUICK_NO_KINDS]
    for r in sorted(mine, key=lambda r: int(r.get("seq") or 0)):
        el = element_of(r)
        if not isinstance(el, dict):
            continue
        if el.get("type") == "tool_call":
            calls.add(str(el.get("id") or ""))
        elif el.get("type") == "tool_result":
            results.add(str(el.get("id") or ""))
            last = el
    if calls - results:
        return "gap"
    if last is None or failed or is_error_result(last.get("text")):
        return "unspeakable"
    return ""


def tool_failed(wall, turn, failed=frozenset()):
    """GH #1279: whether a tool of this iteration failed -- named by the
    collector's `tool_errors` slot (`failed`, prose or not), or the newest
    tool result of the turn is an error object as its text; never an empty
    one alone. Such a turn leaves the quick voice for the brain with the
    note `TOOL_ERROR_NOTE`."""
    if failed:
        return True
    last = None
    mine = [r for r in (wall or []) if isinstance(r, dict)
            and str(r.get("turn_id") or "") == turn]
    for r in sorted(mine, key=lambda r: int(r.get("seq") or 0)):
        el = element_of(r)
        if isinstance(el, dict) and el.get("type") == "tool_result":
            last = el
    if last is None:
        return False
    return bool(str(last.get("text") or "").strip()) and is_error_result(last.get("text"))

# >>> class-notes v1 (#1279, GH #1478)
# WHAT THE CURATOR DOES FOR A CLASS OF THE STAMP IS THE COMPOSITION'S WORD.
# The route stamp names the class of a turn (`hop.path`); which class a turn
# has is the composition's model's word, never this cell's. `class_notes`
# maps a class to `{text, tools?, pair?}`, read off the stamp this cell has
# itself (`seam_path`) and never on the turn that answers an errand
# (`consult_id`): `text` is ONE turn note of such a turn (id the class,
# source `curator`); `tools` "none" gives it no tool at any target -- nothing
# opened, and no frozen system part of the turn, which serves the tool
# rounds of a turn, and a turn without a tool has none; `pair` names the
# field under which the pair -- the assistant's answer to such a turn and the
# person's next words -- goes to the affinity as ONE `propose`, with the
# class the next turn's stamp resolved to: how this person asks, learnt from
# the asking. Every other string of the pair (state key, proposal id,
# `source_ref`, tool call id) and the note's id are built from the class's
# name. Shipped empty: the curator names no class of its own; without an
# entry with `pair` no pair row is ever written.
# D54g (GH #1506): the stamp may also carry a move (`hop.move`) -- HOW the
# speaker answers this turn, a name of the composition's own list. A key
# `<class>/<move>` is the entry of a turn stamped with both: its `text` is
# the turn's note in place of the class's. Of such an entry ONLY the text
# counts: a move steers the speaking and nothing else, so it opens and
# closes no tool, starts no pair, and reaches neither the way nor the
# question to the lead. Without such an entry the class's entry stands,
# without either there is none. The curator knows no move by name: the key
# is the composition's, the move is whatever the stamp says.
MOVE_SEP = "/"


def class_notes_of(value):
    """`class_notes` as `{class: {text, tools, pair}}` (each a stripped
    string, "" when absent): a JSON object or its text; an entry that is no
    object and a class with an empty name are left out. D54g (GH #1506): a
    key `<class>/<move>` keeps its `text` alone -- `tools` and `pair` of such
    an entry are dropped here, with a line on stderr, so no reader below can
    let a move close a tool or start a pair."""
    if isinstance(value, str):
        try:
            value = json.loads(value) if value.strip() else {}
        except ValueError:
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: class_notes is no JSON object -- none\n")
            value = {}
    out = {}
    for name, entry in (value.items() if isinstance(value, dict) else ()):
        name = str(name).strip()
        if name and isinstance(entry, dict):
            out[name] = {k: str(entry.get(k) or "").strip() for k in ("text", "tools", "pair")}
            if MOVE_SEP in name and (out[name]["tools"] or out[name]["pair"]):
                sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: class_notes `%s` names a move -- only "
                                 "its text counts, tools and pair are not read\n" % name)
                out[name]["tools"] = out[name]["pair"] = ""
    return out


CLASS_NOTES = class_notes_of(P.get("class_notes"))
# The classes whose entry names `pair`, in a fixed order: one state row each.
PAIR_CLASSES = sorted(k for k, e in CLASS_NOTES.items() if e["pair"])


def class_entry(path, answered, move=""):
    """The entry of `class_notes` for a turn stamped `path`; {} for a class
    without one and for the turn that answers an errand (`answered`). D54g
    (GH #1506): a turn stamped with a `move` too takes the TEXT of the entry
    `<path>/<move>` when there is one with a text -- before the class's own
    text, which then does not stand. `tools` and `pair` are always the
    class's: a move changes what is said, never what the turn may do."""
    if not path or answered:
        return {}
    entry = CLASS_NOTES.get(path, {})
    text = CLASS_NOTES.get(path + MOVE_SEP + move, {}).get("text", "") if move else ""
    if not text:
        return entry
    return {"text": text, "tools": entry.get("tools", ""), "pair": entry.get("pair", "")}


def pair_key(name, session):
    """The state row of a class's open pair in `session`."""
    return name + ":" + session
# THE TARGET'S MOMENT. `frame` -- now and place -- is a slot of any target
# whose profile says `frame`, on an instance that sets `place` or `timezone`
# (OR-d58-2.frame.2): the profile says whether the target wants the moment,
# the instance says where and when the person is. Without both knobs there is
# no moment to tell and no leaf -- also none in UTC -- so a window of a
# composition without a place stays byte-identical whatever its profiles say.
FRAME_PATH = "frame"
FRAME_HEAD = "[now and place -- facts of this moment, not something the person said]"
PLACE = str(P.get("place") or "").strip()
TIMEZONE = str(P.get("timezone") or "").strip()


def frame_text(stamp):
    """The facts of `frame`: the call's own stamp in `timezone` (UTC when it
    names none or one this python does not know) and `place`."""
    lines = [FRAME_HEAD]
    us = epoch_us(stamp)
    if us is not None:
        # wall-clock: timezone -- the call's stamp, read once by `now()`.
        at = datetime.datetime(1970, 1, 1, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc) \
            + datetime.timedelta(microseconds=us)
        zone = "UTC"
        if TIMEZONE:
            try:
                import zoneinfo
                at, zone = at.astimezone(zoneinfo.ZoneInfo(TIMEZONE)), TIMEZONE
            except Exception:
                sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: timezone %r unknown -- UTC\n" % TIMEZONE)
        lines.append("now: %s, %s (%s)" % (at.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), at.strftime("%A"), zone))
    if PLACE:
        lines.append("place: " + PLACE)
    return "\n".join(lines)


def with_frame(leaves, stamp):
    """`frame` among the leaves of a call, once, in its place by path; none
    while the instance sets neither `place` nor `timezone`. The caller asks
    only for a target whose profile says `frame`."""
    if not (PLACE or TIMEZONE) or any(x[0] == FRAME_PATH for x in leaves):
        return leaves
    text = frame_text(stamp)
    return sorted(leaves + [(FRAME_PATH, text, block_hash({"path": FRAME_PATH, "text": text}))],
                  key=lambda x: path_key(x[0]))


def no_tool_scope(scope):
    """The `tool_scope` of a turn whose class says `tools` "none": no tool,
    the channel's deny kept."""
    out = {"allow": []}
    if isinstance(scope, dict) and scope.get("deny"):
        out["deny"] = names_list(scope.get("deny"))
    return out


def class_note(name, entry):
    """The turn note of a turn of class `name`: its entry's `text`, id the
    class."""
    return {"id": name, "source": "curator", "text": entry["text"], "scope": "turn",
            "priority": 0, "at": ""}


def person_of(round_value):
    """The one person of the round (its entry that is no `agent:`); empty
    when the round names none or more than one."""
    people = [x for x in loads(audience_of(round_value) or "[]", [])
              if not str(x).startswith("agent:")]
    return str(people[0]) if len(people) == 1 else ""


def class_pair(name, field, wall, row, session, turn, path, round_value):
    """`(args, why)` of the affinity proposal of the pair of a turn of class
    `name`, under `field`: the assistant's final answer to that turn (its
    sidecar block left out) and the person's words of this turn; args None
    and the reason when one of them is missing."""
    asked_turn = str(row.get("turn") or "")
    mine = sorted([r for r in wall or [] if isinstance(r, dict)
                   and str(r.get("session_id") or "") == session],
                  key=lambda r: int(r.get("seq") or 0))
    question, answer = "", []
    for r in mine:
        el = element_of(r) or {}
        if el.get("type") != "text":
            continue
        kind, rt = str(r.get("kind") or ""), str(r.get("turn_id") or "")
        if kind == "assistant" and int(r.get("final") or 0) == 1 and rt == asked_turn:
            question = stripped_text(str(el.get("text") or "")).strip()
        elif kind == "user" and rt == turn and str(el.get("text") or "").strip():
            answer.append(str(el.get("text") or "").strip())
    who = person_of(round_value)
    if not question:
        return None, "no_question"
    if not who:
        return None, "no_person"
    return {"op": "propose",
            "id": name + ":" + str(uuid.uuid5(NAMESPACE, "%s#%s" % (session, asked_turn))),
            "source_ref": "curator:%s:%s#%s" % (name, session, asked_turn),
            "entity_ref": who, "field_path": field,
            "value": {"question": question, "answer": "\n".join(answer), "class": path,
                      "session_id": session, "asked_turn": asked_turn,
                      "answered_turn": turn}}, ""


def pair_bundle(name, session, c_raw, args, turn, put_ops):
    """The pair's own bundle: the row of class `name` taken by its key and
    the value read -- the proposal leaves only when this chain took it
    (phase `class-pair`), so a turn of the class is proposed exactly once; a
    new turn's row of the same class is put after the take, never before
    it."""
    msg = None
    if args is not None:
        msg = {"header": {"route": "propose", "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn},
               "messages": [{"origin": "assistant", "type": "tool_call",
                             "id": name + "-" + str(args["value"]["asked_turn"]),
                             "text": canonical(args)}]}
        if audience_of(the_round) is not None:
            msg["header"]["audience_set"] = audience_of(the_round)
    return lstore([("c-del", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                              "where": {"key": pair_key(name, session), "value": c_raw}})]
                  + list(put_ops), "class-pair", "", canonical(msg) if msg else "")


def usage_fields(u):
    """The `calls` columns of a model answer's usage, as the tap books them
    (`cost` as its JSON text, anything else no cost)."""
    fields = {}
    for k in ("model", "tokens_prompt", "tokens_completion", "tokens_cached",
              "tokens_cache_write", "cost", "cache_expires_at"):
        if u.get(k) is not None:
            fields[k] = u.get(k) if k != "cache_expires_at" else str(u.get(k))
    if "cost" in fields:
        c = fields.pop("cost")
        try:
            if not isinstance(c, bool):
                fields["cost"] = canonical(c if isinstance(c, (int, float)) else float(str(c)))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            pass
    return fields

# >>> live-feed v1 (#1279)
# THE VOICE HEARS WHAT CHANGED, AND A DELTA'S STAMP IS NOT DECIDED TWICE.
# `live_feed` "1": after each closed turn of a running session (`live` on
# the turn's seam or context, D58 live) ONE `live_feed`
# leaves -- `hop.section` `live_feed_section` (`renew`: the voice renews its
# session at the turn's end, `hop.at_turn_end` "1", and takes the facts from
# the next seed) -- when the facts a seed of the call carries moved since the
# call's last seed or feed: the session and until notes, the newest inner
# turn (advice, delegation, event), the named topic, the screen topics. The
# body says what moved; facts only, no instruction; nothing moved, nothing
# sent; a text turn sends nothing. The facts and their digest are one state
# row per call, `seed_facts:<call>`, written by `./history` with each seed
# and here with each feed (`seed_fact_state`, one text in both cells).
# `delta_speculation` "1": the stamp `./route` gave a delta of the turn (the
# cumulative partial text, `in_delta_stamp`) is kept per turn in
# `delta:<turn>` (the newest wins). The turn's spec curate (#1275) whose final
# text normalises to the delta's `text_norm` is the turn's normal curate
# under the delta's path, needs, families and turn notes: its call goes only
# when its row moved `fired` -> `delta` (CAS), and the later normal curate
# parks. Another text, or no delta: #1275 as before. One mark `delta` per
# decided spec curate with a delta. Off, a delta stamp is parked.
LIVE_FEED = switch_on(P.get("live_feed"))
LIVE_FEED_SECTION = str(P.get("live_feed_section") or "renew").strip() or "renew"
if LIVE_FEED_SECTION != "renew":
    # #1370: the section of the renewal is `renew` (this knob) -- no other
    # section is built from the knob; other sections come as orders (D58
    # feed). D54g kprofil (#1507): what the own feed is for one target is
    # that target's matter, not the instance's -- the profile field
    # `feed_own` of the limits it named (`feed_own_of`, below): `context`
    # goes out WITH words (`payload`), which is what a receiver of that
    # section asks for; a wordless one it refuses.
    sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: live_feed_section %r is not built -- renew\n"
                     % LIVE_FEED_SECTION)
    LIVE_FEED_SECTION = "renew"


# >>> fact-from-tool v1 (#1407)
# THE FACT COMES STRAIGHT FROM THE TOOL. On the phone (d53 battery round 1,
# DIAG-A B-P2-1) the fact of a tool turn came out of the SECOND model round:
# tool_result -> start of round 2 took 77-327 ms, then the model wrote its
# answer and the sidecar in 2 774-6 675 ms, and only the splitter's `sidecar
# section fact` reached the voice -- although `tools/weather` hands back its
# finished sentence as `summary`. Once (01-P2) the model wrote `context`
# instead and no fact came at all (B-P4-4). `fact_from_tool` names tools or
# families (`weather`, `web_search`): the first tool result of a running
# session's turn (`live`) from a listed tool whose JSON carries a non-empty `summary`
# leaves at once as ONE `live_feed` with `hop.section` `fact`,
# `hop.fact_source` "tool" and the summary as `payload` -- the body the
# splitter's sidecar has. Round 2 still runs for the answer; the voice drops
# a later `fact` of the same `hop.turn_id` (`fact_deduped`). At most one per
# turn: since D58 feed (GH #1481, contract point 6) the fact is an order of
# the curator's own on the one road of `in_feed` -- the claim
# `pending:feed:<live>#<turn>#tool_fact` (`if_absent`, `parked_at` for the
# A13 sweep), the mark `feed {section: fact, mark: {tool}}` where it took.
# A failed or error result is never a fact. `""` (the default): nothing read
# or written.
FACT_FROM_TOOL = names_list(P.get("fact_from_tool"))
FACT_TOOL_ONCE = "tool_fact"


def tool_fact(wall, turn, failed=frozenset()):
    """(tool, summary) of the first tool result of `turn` on the wall from a
    tool of `fact_from_tool` that carries a `summary`, or None. A result the
    collector named failed (`failed`) or an error object is never one."""
    names, mine = {}, [r for r in (wall or []) if isinstance(r, dict)
                       and str(r.get("turn_id") or "") == turn]
    for r in sorted(mine, key=lambda r: int(r.get("seq") or 0)):
        el = element_of(r)
        if not isinstance(el, dict):
            continue
        el_id = str(el.get("id") or "")
        if el.get("type") == "tool_call":
            names[el_id] = call_name(el)
            continue
        if el.get("type") != "tool_result" or el_id in failed:
            continue
        name = names.get(el_id, "")
        if not name or not family_in(name, FACT_FROM_TOOL) or is_error_result(el.get("text")):
            continue
        try:
            res = json.loads(str(el.get("text") or ""))
        except Exception:
            continue
        summary = res.get("summary") if isinstance(res, dict) else None
        if isinstance(summary, str) and summary.strip():
            return name, summary.strip()
    return None
# <<< fact-from-tool v1


# >>> feed v1 (#1481)
# A FEED ON ORDER (D58 feed, R-58-9 no. 4). A domain orders on the lane
# `in_feed` that something goes into a running session now, without waiting
# for a turn's end; the curator sends it, keeps "at most once", books it and
# keeps the held state of the start window true. Before this lane every feed
# was built for itself: the tool fact had its claim `pending:fact_tool:`
# and its own mark, the interrupt the claim `pending:interrupt:` and no mark,
# the renewal neither -- three forms of one move, and an orderer from
# outside had no door at all.
#
#   head  `live` (the handle; none: booked with `reason: no_live`, never
#         sent -- the policy keeps no state "a session runs"), `session_id`,
#         `turn_id`, the round `audience_set` (else the context's),
#         `section` (the orderer's name, passed on: what the receiver takes
#         is the receiver's matter and its composite's edge), `sender` (the
#         orderer, set by it or its edge), optionally `once` (a key of the
#         orderer: claim `pending:feed:<live>#<turn>#<once>`, sent only where
#         the claim took; a key with `#` is booked `reason: bad_once`) and
#         `at_turn_end` (passed on untouched -- the receiver waits at its own
#         turn boundary). Every other head field travels on.
#   body  goes out as the feed's body, except `mark`, which the curator takes
#         out and lays, uninterpreted, into the mark `feed`; `source` and `id`
#         name a note: a `once` note never rides a feed (booked `reason:
#         once_note`; a read of the note the store refused is booked
#         `reason: store_error` -- unknown is never sent), a note a seed of the handle carries is entered into the
#         held state `seed_facts:<live>` -- by compare-and-set on the value
#         read, digest by the rule of `seed_fact_state`, because
#         `./history` writes the same key with every start window -- so the
#         next renewal neither names it again nor renews for it alone.
#
# Every sent feed books ONE mark `feed {section, sender, once?, mark?}` in the
# order's session, turn and round, in the same step as the send. `feed_in`
# "1" opens the lane from outside; "0" (shipped) takes no order -- nothing
# read, written or sent. The curator's own feeds take this road whatever the
# knob says (`own_feed`, `feed_reads`, `feed_out`: they return writes and
# send): the tool fact (`once` `tool_fact`, its tool as `mark.tool`) and the
# renewal (no `once` -- its "once" is the held state's digest, and its moment
# stays: the mark rides the step that writes the state). An own feed carries
# no `sender`; its `once` is not on the hop. A domain beside the curator (the
# lead of a composite, D58 moveout) orders on the lane like any other.
FEED_IN = switch_on(P.get("feed_in"))
FEED_CLAIM = "pending:feed:"
FEED_MARK = "feed"
FEED_SENDER = "sender"


def feed_order(head, body, round_value=None):
    """One order as the curator keeps it between its steps: the head without
    `route` (the round in its canonical form -- the head's, else
    `round_value`), the body without `mark` and `header`, the orderer's
    `mark` apart. A plain dict, so it rides a store round trip on the
    reason."""
    head = dict((k, v) for k, v in (head or {}).items() if k != "route")
    rnd = audience_of(head.get("audience_set"))
    if rnd is None:
        rnd = audience_of(round_value)
    head.pop("audience_set", None)
    body = dict((k, v) for k, v in (body or {}).items() if k != "header")
    order = {"head": head, "round": rnd}
    if "mark" in body:
        order["mark"] = body.pop("mark")
    order["body"] = body
    return order


def own_feed(head, body, round_value, once="", mark=None):
    """An order of the curator's own (contract point 6: the tool fact, the
    renewal): built as `feed_order` builds one from outside,
    so it takes the same `feed_reads`/`feed_out`. Its `once` stands beside
    the head, not in it: the head is exactly what leaves -- for the person
    and the voice nothing changes, no `once` and no `sender` on the hop."""
    order = feed_order(head, body, round_value)
    if once:
        order["once"] = once
    if mark is not None:
        order["mark"] = mark
    return order


def feed_once(order):
    """The `once` of an order as text, "" for none: the orderer's in the
    head, an own feed's beside it (`own_feed`)."""
    v = order.get("once", order["head"].get("once"))
    return "" if v is None else str(v)


def feed_note(order):
    """`(source, id)` of the note an order carries in its body, or None."""
    b = order["body"]
    src, nid = str(b.get("source") or ""), str(b.get("id") or "")
    return (src, nid) if src and nid else None


def feed_refused(order):
    """The reason an order is booked instead of sent before any read: no
    handle, or a `once` key that cannot stand in the claim's key (its `#`
    would part the key wrong, `<live>#<turn>#<once>`). "" = it may go."""
    if not str(order["head"].get("live") or ""):
        return "no_live"
    if "#" in feed_once(order):
        return "bad_once"
    return ""


def feed_reads(order, claim_extra=None):
    """The ONE store round trip an order takes before it goes, as ledger ops
    (`[]`: it goes at once). With `once` the claim `if_absent` (`parked_at`
    for the A13 sweep, `claim_extra` beside it -- never `session` or `hop`,
    which `brain_busy` reads as a parked turn); with a note the note's rows
    and the held state of the start window, in the same bundle -- a second
    round trip before the send would cost what the lane is for."""
    if feed_refused(order):
        return []
    head, ops = order["head"], []
    live, once = str(head.get("live") or ""), feed_once(order)
    if once:
        key = FEED_CLAIM + "%s#%s#%s" % (live, str(head.get("turn_id") or ""), once)
        ops.append(("fd-claim", dict(ins("state", {"key": key, "value": canonical(
            dict(claim_extra or {}, parked_at=now()))}), if_absent={"key": key})))
    note = feed_note(order)
    if note:
        n_read = round_sel("notes", NOTE_READ_COLS, {"source": note[0], "note_id": note[1]},
                           order["round"], str(head.get("session_id") or ""))
        if n_read is not None:
            ops.append(("fd-note", n_read))
        ops.append(("fd-st", sel("state", ["key", "value"],
                                 {"key": {"in": [SEED_FACTS_KEY + live]}})))
    return ops


def feed_with_note(state, note_key):
    """The held state with the note `note_key` (`<source>:<id>`) entered, its
    digest by the rule of `seed_fact_state`: the
    sha256 of the state without its digest, keys sorted, 16 hex digits."""
    out = dict((k, v) for k, v in state.items() if k != "digest")
    out["notes"] = sorted(set([str(n) for n in out.get("notes") or []] + [note_key]))
    out["digest"] = hashlib.sha256(
        json.dumps(out, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]
    return out


def feed_out(order, lg_=None, stamp=None, seq_off=15):
    """`(ops, msg)` of an order: the writes of its step -- the mark `feed`,
    and the held state's compare-and-set for a fed note -- and the
    `live_feed` that leaves with them, `msg` None when nothing goes. `lg_`
    holds the answers of `feed_reads` (None: there were none). A claim that
    did not take is `([], None)`: silent, no mark (another chain sends). A
    refused order is its reasoned mark alone. `seq_off`: the offset of the
    mark's seq in its step (a round's feed rides beside the step's marks)."""
    head, rnd = order["head"], order["round"]
    stamp = stamp or now()
    value = {"section": str(head.get("section") or ""),
             FEED_SENDER: str(head.get(FEED_SENDER) or "")}
    if feed_once(order):
        value["once"] = feed_once(order)
    if "mark" in order:
        value["mark"] = order["mark"]
    why = feed_refused(order)
    lg_ = lg_ or {}
    if not why and feed_once(order) and (lg_.get("fd-claim") or {}).get("rows_affected", 0) != 1:
        return [], None
    if (lg_.get("fd-note") or {}).get("error_code") == "unknown_table":
        # GH #1303: a ledger from before the `notes` table holds no note.
        lg_.pop("fd-note")
    if not why and failed_legs(lg_, ("fd-note",)):
        # OR-d58-2.feed.10: the read of the note failed -- whether it is a
        # `once` note is unknown, and a `once` note never rides a feed (the
        # rule of the strand note). Booked, not sent: the same pattern as
        # an order that cannot go.
        why = STORE_ERROR
    n_rows = [r for r in rows(lg_, "fd-note")
              if passes(r, rnd, str(head.get("session_id") or ""))]
    if not why and any(str(r.get("scope") or "") == "once" for r in n_rows):
        why = "once_note"
    if why:
        value["reason"] = why
    ops = [("fd-mark", ins("marks", with_audience({
        "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + seq_off, "session_id": str(head.get("session_id") or ""),
        "turn_id": str(head.get("turn_id") or ""), "kind": FEED_MARK,
        "value": canonical(value), "at": stamp}, rnd)))]
    if why:
        return ops, None
    note, live = feed_note(order), str(head.get("live") or "")
    st_raw = state_of(lg_, "fd-st").get(SEED_FACTS_KEY + live, "")
    held_ = loads(st_raw, {}) if st_raw else {}
    if note and held_ and not failed_legs(lg_, ("fd-note", "fd-st")) \
            and seed_notes(n_rows, now_ms(), live):
        n_key = "%s:%s" % note
        if n_key not in (held_.get("notes") or []):
            # Compare-and-set on the value read: `./history` writes the key
            # with every start window; lost, its state stands and is true.
            ops.append(("fd-seed", upd("state", {"value": canonical(feed_with_note(held_, n_key))},
                                       {"key": SEED_FACTS_KEY + live, "value": st_raw})))
    out = dict(head, route="live_feed")
    if rnd is not None:
        out["audience_set"] = rnd
    msg = dict(order["body"], header=out)
    msg.setdefault("messages", [])
    return ops, msg

# >>> delegation-park v1 (#1407)
# THE TURN PATH WAITS FOR ITS DELEGATION. On the phone (d53 battery round 1,
# call 00-P2) the voice model delegated the person's turn at +248 ms, and
# beside the delegation round the turn's own path went on: a second weather
# call at +4 071 ms, then the quick voice's second round ran 20 s into its
# timeout -- two tool rounds for one question, the quick cell busy after
# every delegation. A delegation round is the round `./assemble` keys
# `<turn>~<deadline_ms>~<hex8>` with a `delegation_id` beside it: its first
# curate puts `pending:delegation:<session>#<turn>` (`delegation_id`, the
# round, `until` = the key's deadline, `parked_at` for the A13 sweep). A
# curate of a running session's turn path (the turn's own id) while that row
# stands and its `until` is ahead sends no call: the parked turn goes, mark
# `turn_parked {delegation_id, iter}`. The delegation answers the turn. A
# late delegation, one of another turn, an advice round and a text turn
# change nothing; a turn with a handle reads the one row more, nothing else.
DELEGATION_KEY = "pending:delegation:"
# D38 V3 (GH #1451, T-8, OR-38-78): in the R039 acceptance (09:07:30/38) two
# model runs answered one delegation and the voice spoke both facts. The park
# is written under the session of the DELEGATION round (the call id) and read
# under the turn path's own (`phone-...`), so the keys never met -- no such row
# in any R039 blob. The key is the running session's
# (`pending:delegation:<live>#<label>`), which both rounds carry; a round
# without a handle keeps its session. D58 live (contract point 7): the knob
# `delegation_park_by_call` fell, every composition parks so; the row always
# carries the round's audience and a rebuild reads the whole prefix.


def delegation_scope(session, live):
    """The scope of a delegation row: the running session's handle (`live`),
    else the session."""
    return str(live) if live else session


def rebuild_delegations(state_rows, session, round_value):
    """The state rows of a rebuild (OR-d38-3.o15.8): a delegation row of
    another scope -- a handle the rebuild never knows -- counts as the session's when its own audience passes the
    round (`allowed`); it is listed under the session's prefix. A row without
    an audience (one of before) and every other row stay as read."""
    own = DELEGATION_KEY + session + "#"
    out = {}
    for key, value in state_rows.items():
        if key.startswith(DELEGATION_KEY) and not key.startswith(own):
            v = loads(value, {})
            if not (isinstance(v, dict) and allowed(round_value, v.get("audience_set"))):
                continue
            key = own + key[len(DELEGATION_KEY):]
        out[key] = value
    return out


def round_label(key):
    """The member turn an event round answers (`<label>~<deadline_ms>~<hex8>`,
    `./assemble` `event_key`); "" for a turn's own round."""
    p = str(key or "").rsplit("~", 2)
    return p[0] if len(p) == 3 and p[1].isdigit() else ""


def round_deadline(key):
    """The deadline (epoch ms) an event round key carries; 0 without one."""
    p = str(key or "").rsplit("~", 2)
    return int(p[1]) if len(p) == 3 and p[1].isdigit() else 0

# >>> errand-outcome v1 (GH #1469)
# AN ERRAND WITHOUT AN ANSWER LEAVES ITS OUTCOME IN THE WINDOW. Bank find F6
# (wave d58-2, wall `delegations`): the call of a delegation round came back
# with `finish_reason` "error", or nothing came back before the deadline in
# its turn key, and the ledger held the `(delegation)` row alone. A rebuild
# counted that row as the scaffold of a closed errand (`closed_round` asks the
# deadline only) and shrank it; the person had heard the promise, and the
# model knew on the next turn neither of the failure nor of the deadline.
# With `errand_outcome` "1":
#   * the tap of a delegation round says at the parked row how the round
#     ended -- `ended` "failed" with the `error_code` in the form of a code,
#     or `answered` 1 when a final answer of the round reached the wall
#     (phase `errand-end`, a compare-and-set on the row as read);
#   * the first curate of the session that finds a parked errand failed, or
#     past its `until` without an answer, files ONE wall row of the kind
#     `outcome` under the turn of the errand, at the end of the wall and in
#     the window of that very call, and the mark `errand_outcome` with the
#     `delegation_id`; the parked row carries `outcome` from then on, so no
#     later curate files it again (the store decides, never this child);
#   * the sweep leaves a parked delegation row whose errand has neither an
#     answer nor an outcome while its `until` is ahead (`sweep_ops`); past
#     it, the sweep takes the row and files the outcome in the same go
#     (phase `swept`): no errand ends without a word, and a row nobody
#     reads again -- a session without another turn, a call that ended --
#     never stands for good in the sweep's read;
#   * a rebuild never shrinks the row (`shrinkable` asks the kind) and never
#     counts it as scaffold, and `window_lost` watches it (`LOST_KINDS`).
# Nothing here waits or polls: every check runs on a message that comes
# anyway (R-AG-1). The rule hangs on the kind of the row, the same for every
# role. Shipped "0": no read, no write, no row more -- the curator of before.
ERRAND_OUTCOME = switch_on(P.get("errand_outcome"))
OUTCOME_KIND = "outcome"
OUTCOME_MARK = "errand_outcome"
OUTCOME_FAILED = "failed"
# Wave d58-2 close (inventory 39, errand review M1, first gap): the park holds
# one errand per turn of the person. With the knob on, a second errand of
# the same turn is not parked over the first; its own round gets the mark
# `errand_outcome` with this outcome instead (phase `dlg-park`), so nobody is
# followed silently. Off, the park is the set of before (review close I1).
OUTCOME_UNFOLLOWED = "not followed"
OUTCOME_SILENT = "no answer"
# The form of a code, as `./intake` gates one (`error_code`, OR-BD-6: never
# the text of a provider): `[a-z][a-z_]{0,31}`.
OUTCOME_CODE_FIRST = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
OUTCOME_CODE_CHARS = OUTCOME_CODE_FIRST + "_"
OUTCOME_CODE_MAX = 32
# The legs of an outcome's writes (`outcome_ops`): block, wall row, mark.
OUTCOME_LEGS = ("eo-b", "eo-w", "eo-m")


def outcome_code(value):
    """`value` when it is in the form of a code, else ""."""
    s = str(value or "").strip()
    return s if 0 < len(s) <= OUTCOME_CODE_MAX and s[0] in OUTCOME_CODE_FIRST \
        and all(c in OUTCOME_CODE_CHARS for c in s) else ""


def errand_open(value):
    """True for the value of a parked delegation row whose errand has neither
    an answer nor a filed outcome: the sweep leaves it (contract point 4)."""
    v = loads(str(value or ""), {})
    return bool(v.get("delegation_id")) and not v.get("answered") and not v.get("outcome")


def errand_running(value, now_ms_value):
    """True while the `until` of a parked delegation row lies ahead of the
    clock: the errand may still be answered, the sweep leaves its row."""
    v = loads(str(value or ""), {})
    try:
        return int(v.get("until") or 0) > now_ms_value
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return False


def sweep_outcome(row, now_ms_value):
    """The outcome the sweep files for the parked row `row` it took
    (OR-d58-2.errand.14): "" for an errand that was answered, whose outcome
    stands or whose `until` is still ahead; else `failed` when its tap said
    so, `no answer` otherwise."""
    if not isinstance(row, dict) or not row.get("delegation_id") \
            or row.get("answered") or row.get("outcome") \
            or errand_running(canonical(row), now_ms_value):
        return ""
    return OUTCOME_FAILED if row.get("ended") == OUTCOME_FAILED else OUTCOME_SILENT


def errand_session(key, row):
    """The session the `(delegation)` row of a parked errand stands in: the
    one the park holds (`errand_session`), else the scope of its key -- the
    session, unless the row was parked under a handle."""
    return str(row.get("errand_session") or "") \
        or key[len(DELEGATION_KEY):].rsplit("#", 1)[0]


def errand_ended(row, end, code):
    """The parked row with what a tap of its round heard, added to what it
    holds: `answered` 1, or `ended` "failed" and the code beside it."""
    new = dict(row)
    if end == "answered":
        new["answered"] = 1
    elif end == OUTCOME_FAILED:
        new["ended"] = OUTCOME_FAILED
        if outcome_code(code):
            new["error_code"] = outcome_code(code)
    return new


def errand_outcome(row, turn, now_ms_value):
    """The outcome a curate of the turn `turn` files for the parked row `row`,
    "" for none: nothing for an errand that was answered or whose outcome
    stands, and nothing from a curate of the errand's own round -- that round
    is still at work (an escalation after a failed call runs under the same
    turn), and its answer or its next failure decides. `failed` as soon as
    its tap said so, `no answer` once `until` lies behind the clock."""
    if not isinstance(row, dict) or not row.get("delegation_id") \
            or row.get("answered") or row.get("outcome") \
            or str(row.get("round") or "") == turn:
        return ""
    if row.get("ended") == OUTCOME_FAILED:
        return OUTCOME_FAILED
    try:
        until = int(row.get("until") or 0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return ""
    return OUTCOME_SILENT if 0 < until <= now_ms_value else ""


def errand_head(found, turn):
    """How the `(delegation)` row of the round `turn` names its errand: its
    first line, cut where a one-line form cuts it (`LINE_CHARS`). `found` are
    wall rows with their `body`; "" when none of them is that row."""
    for r in found:
        if str(r.get("turn_id") or "") == turn and str(r.get("kind") or "") == "delegation":
            head = first_line((element_of(r) or {}).get("text"), LINE_CHARS)
            if head:
                return head
    return ""


def outcome_text(head, row, outcome):
    """The text of an outcome row: the errand as its own row names it, the
    outcome, and behind `failed` the code when the tap brought one."""
    code = outcome_code(row.get("error_code")) if outcome == OUTCOME_FAILED else ""
    return "%s -- outcome of this errand: %s%s" % (
        head or "[delegation %s]" % row.get("delegation_id"), outcome,
        " (%s)" % code if code else "")


def outcome_ops(parks, found, session, turn, round_value, stamp, now_ms_value,
                sweep=False):
    """What a curate of `(session, turn)` files for the parked delegation rows
    `parks` (`{key: value as read}`): `(rows, ops)`. `rows` are the new wall
    rows, each with its `body`, numbered behind every row the call read
    (`found`) and behind the clock -- the end of the wall; `ops` writes, per
    errand, the block, the wall row, the mark and the parked row with its
    `outcome`. Every write is its own guard: the block by its hash, the wall
    row and the mark by the errand's round and their kind (`if_absent`), the
    parked row by the value read -- two writers in flight file one row and
    one mark, whatever each says.
    `sweep`: the rows were taken by the sweep (phase `swept`) -- the outcome
    is `sweep_outcome`, session and round are the errand's own as its park
    holds them, and no parked row is written back."""
    out, ops = [], []
    floor = max([epoch_us(stamp) or 0] + [int(r.get("seq") or 0) + 1 for r in found])
    for key in sorted(parks):
        row = loads(parks[key], {})
        outcome = sweep_outcome(row, now_ms_value) if sweep \
            else errand_outcome(row, turn, now_ms_value)
        if not outcome:
            continue
        inner = str(row.get("round") or "")
        el = {"origin": "user", "type": "text",
              "text": outcome_text(str(row.get("errand") or "") or errand_head(found, inner),
                                   row, outcome)}
        h, n = block_hash(el), len(out)
        aud = row.get("audience_set") or (row.get("errand_round") if sweep else round_value)
        own = errand_session(key, row) if sweep else session
        wall_row = with_audience({
            "seq": floor + n, "session_id": own, "turn_id": inner, "iter": 0,
            "kind": OUTCOME_KIND, "hash": h, "nth": 0, "final": 0, "episode_idx": None,
            "at": stamp, "turn_at": ""}, aud)
        block = ins("blocks", {"hash": h, "kind": OUTCOME_KIND, "chars": len(el["text"]),
                               "body": canonical(el), "first_seen": stamp})
        block["if_absent"] = {"hash": h}
        filed = ins("wall", wall_row)
        # Wave d58-2 close (inventory 39/44, errand review M1 and m3): the
        # wall row and the mark are guarded by the errand alone -- its own
        # round (one per `delegation_id`) and the kind --, never by what they
        # say. Keyed on the text and the outcome, a curate past the deadline
        # (`no answer`) racing the tap that heard the call fail (`failed`),
        # or a curate naming the errand by its wall row beside the sweep that
        # had `[delegation <id>]` only, filed two rows and two marks.
        filed["if_absent"] = {"turn_id": inner, "kind": OUTCOME_KIND}
        value = canonical({"delegation_id": str(row.get("delegation_id")), "outcome": outcome})
        mark = ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": (epoch_us(stamp) or 0) + 15 + n, "session_id": own, "turn_id": inner,
            "kind": OUTCOME_MARK, "value": value, "at": stamp}, aud))
        mark["if_absent"] = {"turn_id": inner, "kind": OUTCOME_MARK}
        ops += [("eo-b%d" % n, block), ("eo-w%d" % n, filed), ("eo-m%d" % n, mark)]
        if not sweep:
            ops.append(("eo-p%d" % n, upd("state",
                                          {"value": canonical(dict(row, outcome=outcome))},
                                          {"key": key, "value": parks[key]})))
        out.append(dict(wall_row, body=canonical(el)))
    return out, ops
