                                            ", ".join(sorted(failed)), STORE_ERROR))
    # GH #1247 (T4-07): the way this call leaves on, and the quick window.
    seam_hop = dict(slim.get("hop") or {})
    if str(LEAD.get("spec") or "") == "parked" or (
            not LEAD_WIRED and str(seam_hop.get("spec") or "") == "1"):
        # GH #1275: a spec curate while `quick_speculative` is off -- never a call.
        # D58 lead (GH #1474, review A I1): without a lead nobody switches
        # speculation on (`quick_speculative` is the lead's knob), so a spec
        # curate is parked as before the move; the empty verdict alone let it
        # run as a second full call on `hop.target` beside the turn's normal one.
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: a spec curate of turn %s while quick_speculative is"
                         " off -- parked, no call\n" % slim.get("turn"))
        emit([lstore([("f-drop", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                                  "where": {"key": "pending:" + call}})], "done", call, "")])
    # GH #1279: a spec curate with a delta stamp of its turn. The same text:
    # this curate is the turn's normal one under the delta's stamp; another
    # text: #1275 as before. Either way the delta row goes.
    d_verdict, d_ops = "", []
    dl = LEAD.get("delta") if isinstance(LEAD.get("delta"), dict) else {}
    if dl.get("raw"):
        # GH #1447: the delta row and the claim are the lead's (`delta`).
        d_stamp = dl.get("stamp") if isinstance(dl.get("stamp"), dict) else {}
        if dl.get("ok"):
            heard = normalize(heard_text(wall, session, turn))
            same = heard and heard == str(d_stamp.get("text_norm") or "")
            # GH #1435 (K7 review I-1): this spec curate fired without the
            # memory leg (collector `spec_fire`); a delta whose turn leaves on
            # brain for its memory (`memory_to_brain`, the lead's rule) is
            # refired, so the turn's normal curate makes the brain call.
            d_why = "memory" if same and dl.get("memory") else ""
            if same and not d_why:
                d_verdict = "reused"
                seam_hop = delta_hop(seam_hop, d_stamp)
                slim["hop"] = seam_hop
                ctx["turn_notes"] = seam_hop["turn_notes"]
            else:
                d_verdict = "refired"
                d_ops.append(delta_mark("f-dmark", session, turn, call, d_verdict, stamp,
                                        d_why))
        if d_verdict != "reused":
            _ALSO.extend(lead_note("delta_end", session, turn, raw=dl.get("raw")))
            if d_ops:
                _ALSO.append(lstore(d_ops, "done", call, ""))
    f_live = live_of(seam_hop)
    if LIVE_FEED and f_live and str(seam_hop.get("spec") or "") != "1":
        # GH #1279: the turn is a running session's -- its tap sends the live
        # feed. D58 live (OR-d58-2.live.3): the policy holds the handle per
        # turn itself, out of the seam (a speculation never), no verdict
        # field of the lead's.
        _ALSO.append(lstore(put("f-live", LIVE_TURN_KEY + "%s#%s" % (session, turn),
                                canonical({"live": f_live})),
                            "done", call, ""))
    dg_id = str(seam_hop.get("delegation_id") or ctx.get("delegation_id") or "")
    dg_label = round_label(turn)
    dg_scope = delegation_scope(session, live_of(seam_hop))
    if dg_id and dg_label and str(slim.get("iter") or "0") == "0":
        # GH #1407: a delegation round opens -- its turn's own path parks
        # until the round's deadline.
        # OR-d38-3.o15.8: the park carries the round's audience -- a rebuild
        # knows no handle (OR-d38-3.v.25) and tells the row by it.
        dg_park = {"delegation_id": dg_id, "round": turn,
                   "until": round_deadline(turn), "parked_at": stamp,
                   "audience_set": the_round}
        if ERRAND_OUTCOME:
            # GH #1469: how the `(delegation)` row names the errand, kept with
            # the park -- the outcome row says it in the same words, also
            # when a rebuild has covered that row by then.
            dg_park["errand"] = errand_head(wall, turn)
            # OR-d58-2.errand.14: where its `(delegation)` row stands -- the
            # sweep files the outcome there when nobody reads the row again
            # (a key under a handle's scope does not name the session).
            dg_park["errand_session"] = session
            dg_park["errand_round"] = the_round
        dg_key = DELEGATION_KEY + "%s#%s" % (dg_scope, dg_label)
        if ERRAND_OUTCOME:
            # Wave d58-2 close (inventory 39, errand review M1, first gap):
            # the park is written only while none stands under its key -- a
            # second errand of the same turn never parks over the first, and
            # a round delivered again finds its own row. Read back in the
            # same bundle: phase `dlg-park` tells a refused park from one
            # that stands. Shipped "0" parks as before (review close I1).
            _ALSO.append(lstore([("f-dlg", dict(ins("state", {"key": dg_key,
                                                               "value": canonical(dg_park)}),
                                                if_absent={"key": dg_key})),
                                 ("f-dlgr", sel("state", ["key", "value"], {"key": dg_key}))],
                                "dlg-park", call,
                                canonical({"k": dg_key, "t": turn, "id": dg_id, "s": session})))
        else:
            _ALSO.append(lstore(put("f-dlg", dg_key, canonical(dg_park)), "done", call, ""))
    dg_row = loads(state.get(DELEGATION_KEY + "%s#%s" % (dg_scope, turn), ""), {}) \
        if turn and not dg_label else {}
    # GH #1504 (contract point 4): the lead only hears this turn (`listen`:
    # a running session's own model has answered it) -- no call, the same
    # place and the same course as the park beside a delegation, and ahead
    # of it: a heard turn is marked as heard also beside its delegation.
    dg_heard = LEAD.get("listen") is True
    dg_open = False
    if isinstance(dg_row, dict) and dg_row.get("delegation_id") \
            and int(dg_row.get("until") or 0) > now_ms():
        dg_open = True
    if dg_heard or dg_open:
        # GH #1407: a delegation of this turn is open -- the turn path sends
        # no call beside it; the delegation answers the turn.
        dg_iter = str(slim.get("iter") or "0")
        if dg_heard:
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: call %s of turn %s is only heard -- no call\n"
                             % (call, turn))
            if LIVE_FEED and f_live and str(seam_hop.get("spec") or "") != "1":
                # GH #1504 (contract point 5): the answer that closes a turn
                # starts the readers of its live feed (phase `live`); a
                # heard turn has no such answer, so its park starts them --
                # under the condition its `live_turn:` row was written
                # above, and behind that write in the same output (`emit`
                # appends `_ALSO` in order), or the phase reads no row.
                _ALSO.append(lstore(live_reads(session, turn), "live", call,
                                    canonical({"s": session, "t": turn})))
            if turn:
                # Review 1 M-5 of GH #1504: the answer that closes a turn
                # also ends the lead's rows of the turn (note `turn_end`:
                # the stamp of its last delta, a shown speculation
                # sentence). A heard turn has no such answer and the lead's
                # store sweeps nothing: one `delta:<turn>` row stayed per
                # heard turn. Its park says the end, once -- without
                # `round_end`: no round ran, none is booked.
                _ALSO.extend(lead_note("turn_end", session or "default", turn, shown_end=True))
        else:
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: call %s of turn %s parks beside delegation %s\n"
                             % (call, turn, dg_row.get("delegation_id")))
        # Review I-2: a park at iteration 0 comes before the spec decision
        # below -- the turn's speculation ends here as at a drop, or its rows
        # (`spec:`/`spec_held:`, no `pending:` rows, the A13 sweep never
        # reaps them) stay with no curate left to decide them.
        dg_srow = LEAD.get("spec_row") if isinstance(LEAD.get("spec_row"), dict) else {}
        dg_held = LEAD.get("spec_held") if isinstance(LEAD.get("spec_held"), dict) else {}
        dg_spec = []
        if LEAD.get("spec_raw"):
            _ALSO.extend(lead_note("spec_end", session, turn))
            if str(dg_srow.get("state") or "") in ("fired", "held", "await"):
                dg_spec.append(spec_mark(
                    "f-psmark", session, turn, dg_srow, "dropped",
                    "parked:listen" if dg_heard else "parked:delegation", stamp,
                    dg_held if str(dg_held.get("call") or "") ==
                    str(dg_srow.get("call") or "") else None))
        if dg_heard and t_key:
            # Review 1 M-5 of GH #1504 (GH #1471): the row the turn is cut
            # by ends with the answer that ends the turn. A heard turn has
            # none; its row stayed until the sweep of the parked rows, which
            # runs only beside a rebuild probe. No later call of the turn
            # reads it: the turn gets none.
            dg_spec.append(("f-tcutd", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                                        "where": {"key": t_key}}))
        emit([lstore([("f-drop", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                                  "where": {"key": "pending:" + call}}),
                      ("f-dpark", ins("marks", with_audience({
                          "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 14, "session_id": session,
                          "turn_id": turn, "kind": "turn_parked",
                          "value": canonical(dict(
                              {"reason": "listen"} if dg_heard
                              else {"delegation_id": str(dg_row.get("delegation_id"))},
                              iter=int(dg_iter) if dg_iter.isdigit() else 0)),
                          "at": stamp}, the_round)))] + dg_spec, "done", call, "")])
    ft_live = live_of(seam_hop)
    # Review I-1: never in a delegation round (nor any event round, keyed
    # `<turn>~<deadline>~<hex8>`): the voice speaks ONE answer per delegation
    # (`settle_delegation`), the delegation's own; a tool fact there took its
    # place or came twice. Round 2 of the delegation answers, fact included.
    if FACT_FROM_TOOL and turn and ft_live and str(slim.get("iter") or "0") != "0" \
            and not dg_id and not dg_label \
            and str(seam_hop.get("spec") or "") != "1":
        # GH #1407: a tool result is in -- a listed tool's summary is the
        # turn's fact now, not after round 2. It leaves in `feed-send` only
        # where the turn's claim took: once per turn, whatever iteration.
        ft = tool_fact(wall, turn, failed_ids(slim.get("tool_errors")))
        if ft:
            # D58 feed (GH #1481, contract point 6): an order of the
            # curator's own on the one road -- claim
            # `pending:feed:<live>#<turn>#tool_fact`, mark `feed` with the
            # tool as `mark.tool` (OR-d58-2.feed.5), head and body as before.
            ft_order = own_feed({"section": "fact", "live": ft_live, "session_id": session,
                                 "turn_id": turn, "fact_source": "tool"},
                                {"messages": [], "section": "fact", "payload": ft[1]},
                                the_round, once=FACT_TOOL_ONCE, mark={"tool": ft[0]})
            _ALSO.append(lstore(feed_reads(ft_order, {"tool": ft[0], "at": stamp}),
                                "feed-send", call, canonical(ft_order)))
    # F2d: `seam_path`, not `path` -- the leaves below loop over `path`.
    seam_path = str(seam_hop.get("path") or ctx.get("path") or "").strip()
    answered = str(seam_hop.get("consult_id") or ctx.get("consult_id") or "")
    # GH #1447: the way, its reason and the escalation are the lead's verdict;
    # the window checks only what the wall shows (`speak_check`).
    # D58 target (contract point 9): the verdict names the target, its
    # fallback and a departure; nothing is read off a way name. `way` says
    # whether the call leaves the composite: "away" (its bundle,
    # `DEPARTURE`), "" for any other.
    departs = LEAD.get("departs") if isinstance(LEAD.get("departs"), dict) else {}
    d_class = str(departs.get("class") or "")
    c_fallback = str(LEAD.get("fallback") or "")
    c_from = ""
    way = "away" if d_class else ""
    # GH #1478: the entry of the stamp's class (`class_notes`); none on the
    # turn that answers an errand.
    # D54g (GH #1506): with the stamp's move (`hop.move`, the collector's
    # seam), read here and handed to nothing else -- not to the lead's
    # question, not to the way.
    c_entry = class_entry(seam_path, answered, str(seam_hop.get("move") or "").strip())
    no_tools = c_entry.get("tools") == "none"
    way_reason = "memory" if LEAD.get("reason") == "memory" else ""
    way_ops = []
    try:
        it_now = int(str(slim.get("iter") or "0"))
    except ValueError:
        it_now = 0
    escalated = str(LEAD.get("escalate") or "")
    esc_detail = {}
    # GH #1279: the tool results of this iteration the collector named
    # failed (`tool_errors` of the curate, parked in `slim`).
    failed_now = failed_ids(slim.get("tool_errors"))
    if ESCALATE in flags:
        # How the tool round ended (and its error) rides behind the reason
        # into the mark (GH #1260, #1352).
        esc_detail = loads(base.partition(":")[2], {})
        if not isinstance(esc_detail, dict):
            esc_detail = {}
    elif LEAD.get("speak_check"):
        escalated = speaker(it_now, wall, turn, failed_now)
        if escalated:
            c_from = str(LEAD.get("target") or "")
            _ALSO.extend(lead_note("escalated", session, turn))
    # GH #1279: a quick turn whose tool failed goes to the brain with a note,
    # never with the quick voice's words about the failure.
    tool_err = escalated == "unspeakable" and tool_failed(wall, turn, failed_now)
    # GH #1279, #1478: the pair of a turn of a class with `pair` -- at the
    # first curate of the person's next turn in the session (iteration 0, no
    # spec, no escalation) that carries their words; its bundle rides beside
    # every emission from here. This turn's own row goes into the bundle of
    # its class's open row, after the take, else on its own.
    c_first = it_now == 0 and ESCALATE not in flags \
        and str(seam_hop.get("spec") or "") != "1"
    c_cls = seam_path if c_entry.get("pair") else ""
    c_put = put("f-pair", pair_key(c_cls, session), canonical({"turn": turn, "call": call,
                                                               "at": stamp})) \
        if c_cls and c_first else []
    for p_cls in PAIR_CLASSES:
        c_raw = state.get(pair_key(p_cls, session), "")
        c_row = loads(c_raw, {})
        if not (c_raw and c_first and str(c_row.get("turn") or "") != turn):
            continue
        c_args, c_why = class_pair(p_cls, CLASS_NOTES[p_cls]["pair"], wall, c_row, session,
                                   turn, seam_path, the_round)
        if c_args is not None and not c_args["value"]["answer"]:
            # No words of the person in this turn (an inner turn): the pair
            # waits for their next one.
            continue
        if c_args is None:
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: %s turn %s -- no proposal (%s)\n"
                             % (p_cls, c_row.get("turn"), c_why))
        p_put = c_put if p_cls == c_cls else []
        _ALSO.append(pair_bundle(p_cls, session, c_raw, c_args, turn, p_put))
        if p_put:
            c_put = []
    way_ops += c_put
    # (#1275, quick_spec; GH #1447): what becomes of this turn's speculation
    # is the lead's verdict (`spec`) on its own rows, which it moves itself
    # (`lead_writes`); the marks and the sends are the window's.
    l_spec = str(LEAD.get("spec") or "")
    s_raw = str(LEAD.get("spec_raw") or "")
    s_row = LEAD.get("spec_row") if isinstance(LEAD.get("spec_row"), dict) else {}
    s_held = LEAD.get("spec_held") if isinstance(LEAD.get("spec_held"), dict) else {}
    # A spec curate whose delta stamp it reuses is the turn's normal curate
    # now (`delta_hop` took `spec` off the seam).
    is_spec = l_spec == "call" and str(seam_hop.get("spec") or "") == "1"
    # D58 target (contract point 1): the target of this call -- the lead's
    # verdict names it, else the curate (`hop.target`); there is no built-in
    # one. A call that names none is cut for the one target the curator holds
    # a row of, else on the values of the instance; both are marked, like a
    # target without a row (`target_unknown`, OR-d58-2.target.6).
    c_named = str(LEAD.get("target") or "") or str(seam_hop.get("target") or "")
    if c_from:
        # The fast call handed its round on: it goes to the fallback the
        # verdict named, which hands nothing on itself.
        c_named, c_fallback, way = c_fallback, "", ""
    if is_spec:
        # A speculative call never leaves the composite -- before its cut is
        # read.
        way = ""
    c_holds = held_targets(state)
    c_target = c_named or (c_holds[0] if len(c_holds) == 1 else "")
    # GH #1497: the rows this call is cut by are the ones the target's window
    # was first cut by on this state of the plan (`form_view`); the side
    # calls and the question for a row read the rows as they stand. A row
    # that moved since orders the change of plan that takes it on
    # (`c_moved`, the projection carries it to the tap).
    # GH #1517 (d): and the slots of its system part the same way
    # (`form_slots`); a refused read of the slots holds none.
    c_slots_now = None if slots_failed else form_slots(own_slots(rows(lg, "w-slots"), the_rk))
    c_state, c_form, c_moved, c_slots, c_bodies = form_view(
        c_target, state, window_epoch(plan), c_slots_now, form_bodies(c_slots_now, blocks))
    if slim.get("turn_cut") and t_cut is not None:
        # A later call of a turn is cut by the row its turn laid (GH #1471):
        # the plan it reads may be one a rebuild replaced meanwhile -- the
        # first call of the turn ordered it; the next turn orders it anew if
        # it was lost, never every call of a round once more.
        c_moved = False
    c_row = catalog_row(c_target, c_state)
    c_profile = c_row.get("window_profile") if isinstance(c_row.get("window_profile"), dict) else {}
    # Wave d58-2 close (inventory 62, target review R2 m4): a call that leaves
    # the composite has no target and no profile by contract point 4; it is
    # no curate that forgot one, and is not marked as one.
    c_missing = "" if way == "away" else \
        "target" if not c_named else ("" if c_row else "profile")
    cp = call_profile(c_target, way, c_state)
    c_mode = cp["system"]
    # The call's values (contract point 3): read by the cut of this call only.
    SHORT_IDS, IDENTITY_BUDGET, STATE_LINES = cp["short_ids"], cp["identity_budget"], \
        cp["state_lines"]
    NOTES_SHARE, BROADCAST_MODE, WINDOW_TARGET = cp["notes_share"], cp["broadcast_mode"], \
        cp["window_target"]
    # The wall's values (Nachtrag 11.11.): the floor of the guard reads them
    # here (OR-d58-2.target.27); the tap and the rebuild get them through
    # the projection (`est_row`).
    w_target, w_profile, w_unknown = wall_source(c_target, cp, c_state)
    if w_profile:
        KEEP_RECENT, KEEP_RECENT_TOKENS = wall_values(w_profile)[:2]
    spec_wait = None
    spec_fams = []
    s_drop = [("f-drop", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                          "where": {"key": "pending:" + call}})]
    if l_spec == "parked:delta":
        # GH #1279: the turn was called from its delta stamp -- this normal
        # curate parks, and the row (its guard until now) goes in the lead.
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: turn %s was called from its delta stamp (call %s)"
                         " -- no second call\n" % (turn, s_row.get("call")))
        emit([lstore(s_drop, "done", call, "")])
    if l_spec == "parked:decided":
        # The normal curate of the turn came first: it decided alone.
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: spec curate of turn %s after its decision"
                         " -- no call\n" % turn)
        emit([lstore(s_drop, "done", call, "")])
    if l_spec == "parked:called":
        # GH #1279 / #1371: the turn's normal call is given and its row is
        # not this call's own `await` -- this spec curate came after it.
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: spec curate of turn %s after its call"
                         " -- no call\n" % turn)
        emit([lstore(s_drop, "done", call, "")])
    if is_spec:
        # The spec call goes to the target the verdict named (`spec_target`),
        # whatever a stamp would say; it hands nothing on.
        way, escalated, way_ops, c_fallback = "", "", [], ""
    elif l_spec == "kept":
        # Kept: the held answer is this turn's answer; no call. D58 note (GH
        # #1477, contract point 3): what its window showed (`spec_go`, the use
        # of its `once` notes and their receipts) is booked with it.
        s_go = LEAD.get("spec_go") if isinstance(LEAD.get("spec_go"), dict) else {}
        emit([lstore(s_drop + [spec_mark("f-smark", session, turn, s_row, "kept", "kept",
                                         now(), s_held)] + go_ops_of(s_go),
                     "done", call, "")] + spec_release(s_held, session, turn)
             + list(s_go.get("sends") or []))
    elif l_spec.startswith("dropped:"):
        s_why = l_spec[len("dropped:"):]
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: spec answer of turn %s dropped (%s)\n"
                         % (turn, s_why))
        # GH #1279: the row went in the lead -- a spec answer still on its
        # way finds no row and is discarded (booked on arrival, M2).
        way_ops += [spec_mark("f-smark", session, turn, s_row, "dropped", s_why, stamp,
                              s_held if str(s_held.get("call") or "") ==
                              str(s_row.get("call") or "") else None)]
    elif l_spec == "wait":
        # A quick turn whose spec answer is not in yet: the normal call is
        # built and stored in the lead, the answer decides on arrival.
        spec_wait = names_list(seam_hop.get("needs") or ctx.get("needs"))
        spec_fams = names_list(seam_hop.get("families") or ctx.get("families"))
    # GH #1447: the errand's mark is the lead's (ended, lapsed or standing).
    pending = LEAD.get("pending") if isinstance(LEAD.get("pending"), dict) else {}
    pending_raw = canonical(pending) if pending else ""
    # Review M1 of F2: the window of THIS call's way. A brain call of a turn
    # that kept its system takes the window that system was fitted to; a
    # way without a window of its own yet takes the brain's, as before.
    # GH #1512 (a): a speculative call neither reads nor writes the turn's
    # row. It runs before the stamp, so without the turn's notes
    # (`context.turn_notes`); measured in the lab (twice), the first turn of
    # a freshly born colony: the spec call to a target without a reported
    # profile was cut `delta` on the instance's knobs, wrote the row with its
    # notes block, and the brain call of the same turn took that block frozen
    # -- the router's crisis note did not reach the speaker. Fidelity before
    # the stability of the prefix.
    frozen = turn_system_of(state.get(turn_system_key(session, turn), ""), turn,
                            the_round, c_target) \
        if c_mode == "delta" and not is_spec else None
    # Review o15-R1 M5: `cut_ms` sums the cut's own functions only.
    c_spent = [0.0]
    # GH #1497 (review M1 of the strand): the budget is read off the rows
    # the window was cut by (`c_state`, `form_view`) like every other value
    # of the cut -- read off the row as it stood, the sidecar cap of the
    # earlier answers (`SIDECAR_SHARE` of it) tipped with a row that came
    # home inside the plan.
    c_budget = cut_timed(c_spent, cut_budget, c_target, c_state, frozen)
    contract_cap = budget_chars(c_budget["soft"], SIDECAR_SHARE)
    contract_cuts = []
    stubs = set(plan.get("stubs") or [])
    # The round's own summary slot as the leaf `history.summary`, another
    # round's not at all (GH #943, OR-BC.W.2).
    for r in turn_cut_slots(own_slots(rows(lg, "w-slots"), the_rk), t_cut):
        h = str(r.get("hash") or "")
        b = blocks.get(h)
        el = element_of(b) if b else None
        if el is None:
            continue
        path, text = str(r.get("path") or ""), str(el.get("text") or "")
        if session_bound(path):
            # A session's slot from before review I-4: the call carries its own.
            continue
        if path in bound and (bound[path] is None or bound[path][0] != h
                              or not allowed(the_round, bound[path][1])):
            continue
        if c_slots is not None and held_slot(r) and c_slots.get(path) != h:
            # GH #1517 (d): a slot that arrived or changed since the target's
            # window was first cut on this state of the plan waits for the
            # next change of plan (`form_view` ordered it): an arrived one is
            # left out; a changed one keeps the block it was cut with -- out
            # of the read when it brought it, else out of the first cut's
            # record (`c_bodies`; the read brings the blocks of today's slot
            # rows only). A record without it (written before it kept blocks)
            # lets the slot go as it stands; the order is placed all the same.
            k_h = c_slots.get(path, "")
            k_b = blocks.get(k_h) or ({"body": c_bodies[k_h]} if k_h in c_bodies else None)
            k_el = element_of(k_b) if k_b else None
            if path not in c_slots:
                continue
            if k_el is not None:
                h, text = c_slots[path], str(k_el.get("text") or "")
        if path.startswith("tools.") and path[6:] in stubs:
            leaf = {"path": path, "text": stub_text(text)}
            h = block_hash(leaf)
            views.append((leaf, h, "system"))
            text = leaf["text"]
        if path == CONTRACT_PATH:
            fitted, c_cuts = fit_contract(text, contract_cap)
            if c_cuts:
                leaf = {"path": path, "text": fitted}
                h = block_hash(leaf)
                views.append((leaf, h, "system"))
                text = fitted
                contract_cuts += c_cuts
        leaves.append((path, text, h))
    pins = [p for p in rows(lg, "w-pins") if allowed(the_round, p.get("audience_set"))]
    pinned, tail = pin_split(pins, blocks, plan, now_ms())
    # The slots of this call's session come from its parked turn alone (review
    # I-4), a block of their own each like a pin leaf, so `call_blocks` names
    # what the ledger holds.
    for path, text in session_slots_of(slim) + pinned:
        leaf = {"path": path, "text": text}
        h = block_hash(leaf)
        views.append((leaf, h, "system"))
        leaves.append((path, text, h))
    leaves.sort(key=lambda x: path_key(x[0]))
    # GH #1279: another target's prompt is never this one's. The slots as
    # they were stay for the bridge, which reads its own (`b_src`).
    s_slots = [x for x in leaves if in_family(x[0], "instructions")]
    leaves = without_slots(leaves, foreign_slots(cp, c_state))
    # THE IDENTITY BUDGET (GH #935): `full` drops the `identity_short*`
    # leaves and changes nothing else -- a ledger without them builds the
    # system part of 1.3.0 byte for byte; `split` sends the short form and
    # puts the whole pack first in `messages` as a snapshot.
    # The snapshot state of THIS session (review I-4) holds its element: no
    # block read, and an element that is not the one its hash names is none
    # (`identity_slots` then takes a fresh snapshot -- never the wrong text).
    id_aud = audience_of(the_round) or "[]"
    id_snap = loads(state.get("identity_full:" + session, ""), {})
    id_stored = id_snap.get("element")
    if not isinstance(id_stored, dict) or block_hash(id_stored) != id_snap.get("hash"):
        id_stored = None
    id_key = {"session": session,
              "epoch": window_epoch(plan, session, str(id_snap.get("epoch") or "")),
              "renewed": state.get("renewed_last:" + session, ""), "audience": id_aud}
    ident = identity_slots(IDENTITY_BUDGET, leaves, id_snap, id_key, id_stored,
                           state.get("identity_short_missing:" + session, ""))
    if len(ident["leaves"]) != len(leaves) or ident["full"] is not None:
        leaves = sorted(ident["leaves"], key=lambda x: path_key(x[0]))
        for path, text, h in leaves:
            if path == IDENTITY_FAMILY and ident["full"] is not None:
                # The short form as the `identity` leaf: a block of its own,
                # so `call_blocks` names what the ledger holds.
                views.append(({"path": path, "text": text}, h, "system"))
    # Released as THIS round sees it (review I-1): a release another round
    # said shapes only the windows of rounds that may see it.
    # R-IG-1: the window's own share of the sidecar is measured against the
    # usable window kept in state (`input_soft`), and every block it leaves
    # out is said on the call's hop (`cuts`).
    c_at = len(cuts)
    # GH #1462: the form each block leaves in, kept only for the list `sent`.
    c_forms = {} if SNAPSHOT_WINDOW else None
    items = render(c_plan["blocks"], wall, dict(P, input_soft=c_budget["soft"],
                                                short_ids="1" if SHORT_IDS else "0"), plan,
                   (session, turn), tail, round_canon(the_round), cuts, c_forms)
    # GH #1337: the person's words as `render` left them, for their frame.
    own = own_words(items)
    # GH #1303: the notes block, on the speaking ways only (a consult's errand
    # and a bridge carry none: the bridge of a tool round is built from the
    # quick way's items, and the quick way takes its own share, 0 -- no block,
    # so its words need no frame either, GH #1337 review I-1). The calls of one brain turn show the block of
    # its first call (GH #1298: the person's turn is part of the prefix a
    # signed thinking is bound to); a `turn` note is the turn's that first
    # saw it, shown or not.
    turn_key = "%s#%s" % (session, turn)
    notes_in, notes_out, note_ops, notes_kept = [], [], [], None
    # D58 note (GH #1477): the use and the receipts of the `once` notes this
    # call shows -- they go out with the call's own sends (the last `emit`),
    # never with its records alone: held with them in the lead (`go_ops`) and
    # booked with their release; a spec call's are booked when its answer is
    # kept (`spec_go`).
    once_ops, once_sends = [], []
    # GH #1335: the block that opens the person's newest message; what moves
    # into that message later goes behind it.
    lead = ""
    if cp["speaks"]:
        if frozen is not None:
            kept_notes = frozen.get("notes") or {}
            n_block = str(kept_notes.get("block") or "")
            notes_in = list(kept_notes.get("in") or [])
            notes_out = list(kept_notes.get("dropped") or [])
            f_once = set((str(x.get("source") or ""), str(x.get("id") or ""))
                         for x in notes_in if isinstance(x, dict)
                         and str(x.get("scope") or "") == "once") if NOTE_ONCE else set()
            if f_once:
                # D58 note (GH #1477, contract point 3): the turn's block was
                # made by an earlier call (a spec call's, held in the lead) --
                # a `once` note it shows that is still open is booked by the
                # call that goes with it; one already used by this turn is not.
                once_ops, once_sends = once_go(
                    [n for n in live_notes(rows(lg, "w-notes"), the_round,
                                           epoch_ms(stamp) or 0, turn_key,
                                           live_of(slim.get("hop")))
                     if (n["source"], n["id"]) in f_once],
                    turn_key, session, turn, c_target, stamp)
        else:
            # GH #1439: the state line opens the block; beside the handover
            # leaf the line leaves the topic and the promises to it.
            s_text = ""
            if STATE_BLOCK and STATE_LINES > 0:
                s_now = epoch_ms(stamp) or now_ms()
                s_rows = dict((str(r.get("key") or ""), str(r.get("value") or ""))
                              for r in rows(lg, "w-sdlg") + rows(lg, "w-sdlgc"))
                s_rows[ERRAND_ROW + session] = pending_raw if pending else ""
                s_texts = dict((h, str((element_of(b) or {}).get("text") or ""))
                               for h, b in blocks.items())
                s_marks = sorted(rows(lg, "w-stopic") + rows(lg, "w-smarks"),
                                 key=lambda r: -int(r.get("seq") or 0))
                s_parts = ("open", "set_today") if any(x[0] == HANDOVER_PATH for x in leaves) \
                    else STATE_PARTS
                s_age = None
                if TOPIC_AGING and "w-sage" in lg:
                    s_wall = rows(lg, "w-sage")
                    s_age = (s_wall, live_opened_of(next((r.get("value")
                                                          for r in rows(lg, "w-sopen")), "")),
                             len(s_wall) >= TOPIC_AGE_ROWS)
                s_text = state_block(state_of_rows(s_marks, pins, s_texts, s_rows, the_round,
                                                   session, s_now, day_of(stamp), s_age,
                                                   live_of(slim.get("hop")),
                                                   names_list((slim.get("hop") or {}).get("needs")
                                                              or ctx.get("needs"))),
                                     s_parts, STATE_LINES)
            # GH #1436: the turn's notes leave their carried notes (with the
            # call's sends, below); a fresh one stands in for its carried note.
            t_notes = turn_notes_of(ctx.get("turn_notes"))
            t_live = live_of(slim.get("hop"))
            carry_ops, carry_fresh = carried_notes(t_notes, session, t_live, stamp,
                                                   the_round) \
                if CARRY_NOTES else ([], set())
            pool = ([state_note(s_text)] if s_text else []) \
                + [n for n in live_notes(rows(lg, "w-notes"), the_round,
                                         epoch_ms(stamp) or 0, turn_key, t_live)
                   if n["source"] not in carry_fresh] \
                + t_notes \
                + ([class_note(seam_path, c_entry)] if c_entry.get("text") else []) \
                + ([{"id": "tool_error", "source": "curator", "text": TOOL_ERROR_NOTE,
                     "scope": "turn", "priority": 0, "at": ""}] if tool_err else []) \
                + ([pending_note(pending)] if pending and CONSULT_PENDING else [])
            n_share = NOTES_SHARE
            n_block, shown_n, dropped_n = note_block(
                pool, budget_chars(c_budget["soft"], n_share) if n_share > 0 else 0)
            notes_in = [note_ref(n) for n in shown_n]
            notes_out = [note_ref(n) for n in dropped_n]
            for i, n in enumerate(pool):
                r = n.get("row")
                if r is not None and n["scope"] == "turn" and not str(r.get("used_turn") or ""):
                    note_ops.append(("f-nuse%d" % i, upd(
                        "notes", {"used_turn": turn_key},
                        {"source": str(r.get("source") or ""),
                         "note_id": str(r.get("note_id") or ""),
                         "audience_set": str(r.get("audience_set") or ""), "used_turn": ""})))
            if NOTE_ONCE:
                once_ops, once_sends = once_go(shown_n, turn_key, session, turn, c_target,
                                               stamp)
            once_ops = once_ops + carry_ops
            notes_kept = {"block": n_block, "in": notes_in, "dropped": notes_out}
        items = with_note_block(items, wall, n_block)
        lead = n_block
        if notes_out:
            cuts.append({"what": "notes", "shown": len(notes_in),
                         "total": len(notes_in) + len(notes_out), "unit": "notes"})
    # GH #1279: the slot `instructions.quick` takes the place of the fixed leaf.
    q_own = slot_path(cp["slot"])
    # A profile's text holds only while its slot is empty (contract point
    # 3, OR-d58-2.target.50).
    q_slot = bool(q_own) and any(
        x[0] == q_own or x[0].startswith(q_own + ".") for x in leaves)
    # GH #1450 Z1.8: the tool scope is the cut's, for its target.
    q_scope, tool_round = cut_timed(
        c_spent, cut_tools, cp, is_spec, slim.get("tool_scope"),
        names_list(LEAD.get("spec_tools")),
        names_list(seam_hop.get("families") or ctx.get("families")),
        names_list(seam_hop.get("tools_folded") or ctx.get("tools_folded")),
        set(x[0][6:] for x in leaves if x[0].startswith("tools.")),
        names_list(seam_hop.get("needs") or ctx.get("needs")), it_now)
    if not is_spec and (tool_round or (cp["text"] and q_own)):
        # GH #1260 (OR-WG-6): THE TOOL ROUND carries no contract and no
        # `instructions.quick`: the answer comes in the next round, and the
        # bridge beside it says the sentence.
        if tool_round:
            leaves = [x for x in leaves if x[0] != CONTRACT_PATH
                      and not x[0].startswith(CONTRACT_PATH + ".")]
        else:
            # GH #1260 (OR-WG-2): the contract stays, fitted above like the
            # brain's (`fit_contract`, the window's `SIDECAR_SHARE`) -- a quick
            # answer is an answer and leaves its block for the splitter.
            if not q_slot:
                leaves = sorted(leaves + [(q_own, cp["text"],
                                           block_hash({"path": q_own,
                                                       "text": cp["text"]}))],
                                key=lambda x: path_key(x[0]))
    # GH #1462: the paths the tree holds before the next step of the cut; a
    # leaf that step adds is built here, a leaf a slot holds is not (`s_made`).
    s_had = set(x[0] for x in leaves) if SNAPSHOT_WINDOW else None
    # GH #1279: the target's own instructions and its moment.
    leaves = own_slot_leaves(leaves, cp)
    if cp["frame"]:
        leaves = with_frame(leaves, stamp)
    s_made = tuple(x[0] for x in leaves if x[0] not in s_had) if SNAPSHOT_WINDOW else ()
    # #1198: while a consult runs, the speaking model is told so -- since
    # GH #1497 in the notes block (`pending_note`), no leaf of the system
    # part. `p_shown`: the call's notes block (its own or the turn's frozen
    # one, GH #1298) holds the note; a side call beside it is told as well.
    p_shown = bool(CONSULT_PENDING) and any(
        isinstance(n, dict) and n.get("source") == "curator" and n.get("id") == CONSULT_PENDING
        for n in notes_in)
    if c_mode == "delta" and frozen is not None:
        # GH #1298: the system part stands over the tool rounds of a turn.
        leaves = without_slots(frozen["leaves"], foreign_slots(cp, c_state))
    elif c_mode == "delta" and turn and not no_tools and not is_spec:
        # GH #1512: (a) a spec call writes no row (see `frozen` above); (b)
        # the row names the target whose call wrote it (`turn_system_of`).
        way_ops += put("f-tsys", turn_system_key(session, turn), canonical({
            "turn": turn, "round": round_canon(the_round), "target": c_target,
            "leaves": [list(x) for x in leaves], "soft": c_budget["soft"], "hard": c_budget["hard"],
            "cuts": contract_cuts, "notes": notes_kept}))
        # Review m3 of F2: every fresh write of the row names it in the
        # session's list of open rows and takes down every row listed
        # longer than `pending_sweep_s` -- a round that ended on a
        # hand-over or lost its answer left it; a turn still running
        # beside this one (two channels of one session) keeps its own.
        # Delta review m5: also the first brain call of an escalated turn
        # (`it_now` >= 1), whose row no first call listed.
        stamp_ms = epoch_ms(stamp) or 0
        open_rows = []
        listed = loads(state.get(TURN_SYSTEM_LAST + session, ""), [])
        for i, x in enumerate(listed if isinstance(listed, list) else []):
            if not (isinstance(x, list) and len(x) == 2) or x[0] == turn:
                continue
            if stamp_ms - (epoch_ms(x[1]) or 0) >= PENDING_SWEEP_S * 1000:
                way_ops.append(("f-tsysold%d" % i, {
                    "operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                    "where": {"key": turn_system_key(session, str(x[0]))}}))
            else:
                open_rows.append([str(x[0]), str(x[1])])
        way_ops += put("f-tsyslast", TURN_SYSTEM_LAST + session,
                       canonical(open_rows + [[turn, stamp]]))
    # Review m1 of F2: the contract cuts of what is SENT -- the kept ones
    # when the system stands -- where they stood before the window's own.
    cuts[c_at:c_at] = frozen["cuts"] if frozen is not None else contract_cuts
    # The guard measures the leaves that are sent (review m1 of F2).
    # THE GUARD AT input_hard (GH #1225, K-2, OR-KF-6). A wall over the hard
    # line of the model -- a day longer than the window before its rebuild
    # came, a rebuild that failed -- was sent whole, and the llm cell refused
    # it (`input_over_hard`): the turn was lost. At HARD_HEADROOM of
    # `input_hard` (the margin `curate_mark` orders `hard` at) the oldest raw
    # rounds beyond `keep_recent` -- whole rounds, never the newest -- leave
    # THIS call until it is under the margin: said on the hop (`cuts`) and
    # as one `overflow_cut` mark; the turn is never refused and never parked.
    # The plan is not touched: the call's projection (`window_est`) keeps
    # the whole wall, so the tap's `curate_mark` orders the rebuild `hard`.
    # GH #1450 Z1.5: the guard and the quick scope are rules of the cut.
    def iw_drop(kept):
        # D38 V5 after the guard (review d38_r1 condition 3), before the order
        # (review d38_o28-R1 M1): the quotes are checked against the raw turns
        # whose rows the cut kept -- the raw text, so a row sent in its
        # released or shrunk form counts as said (review K3, as before the
        # guard). A candidate whose own round the guard cut is the guard's
        # cut, not a `recall_in_wall` (review K1). Dropping a pair only lowers
        # what is sent; `overflow.after` and `window_est` still count it
        # (review K2): conservative, a `hard` rebuild a little early, never
        # over the line.
        k_said = said_hashes(element_of(r) or {} for r in wall
                             if int(r.get("seq") or 0) in kept)
        # GH #1463: a candidate the cut kept is decided here, once; one whose
        # own row the guard or the scope of the way took stays undecided.
        shown = [b for b in iw_cand
                 if w_seq.get(str((b.get("origin") or {}).get("hash") or ""), -1) in kept]
        gone = [b for b in shown if recall_in_wall(w_el(b).get("text"), k_said)]
        stay = set(str(b.get("id") or "") for b in shown if b not in gone)
        gone_ids = set(str(w_el(b).get("id") or "") for b in gone) - {""}
        # GH #1517: the call of the pair by its element (`tool_call` of a
        # recall pair, `push` of an addendum).
        in_wall.extend([b for b in c_plan["blocks"] if b in gone
                        or (w_el(b).get("type") == "tool_call"
                            and str(w_el(b).get("id") or "") in gone_ids)])
        c_plan["blocks"] = [dict(b, decided="kept") if str(b.get("id") or "") in stay else b
                            for b in c_plan["blocks"] if b not in in_wall]
        if in_wall:
            c_plan["left_out"] = sorted(left_out | set(
                str((b.get("origin") or {}).get("hash") or "") for b in in_wall))
        return set(w_seq.get(str((b.get("origin") or {}).get("hash") or ""), -1)
                   for b in in_wall) - {-1}

    items, unmoved, overflow, c_stages = cut_timed(
        c_spent, cut_items, items, wall, plan, [[path, text] for path, text, _ in leaves],
        [ident["full"]] if ident["full"] is not None else [], cp, c_budget["line"], (session, turn),
        lead, own, iw_drop if iw_cand else None,
        t_cut.get("legend") if t_cut is not None and isinstance(t_cut.get("legend"), dict)
        else None)
    if overflow is not None:
        overflow = dict(overflow, call=call)
        cuts.append({"what": "overflow_cut", "shown": overflow["after"],
                     "total": overflow["before"], "unit": "tokens",
                     "rounds": overflow["rounds"]})
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: call %s over %d of input_hard -- %d oldest rounds"
                         " left out (%d -> %d tokens, GH #1225)\n"
                         % (call, overflow["limit"], overflow["rounds"], overflow["before"],
                            overflow["after"]))
    if in_wall:
        cuts[iw_at:iw_at] = [{"what": "recall_in_wall", "shown": 0, "total": 1, "unit": "rows",
                              "block": str(b.get("id") or "")} for b in in_wall]
    views += [(el, h, "view") for _, el, h, view in items if view]
    # GH #1450 Z1.9: the system families are the cut's, for its target.
    # D58 target (contract point 7): what each target was sent is kept per
    # target (`system_hash_sent`, `{target: {family: hash}}`); a call that
    # sends the whole tree clears it for every target, as before.
    c_sent_all = dict((k, v) for k, v in loads(state.get("system_hash_sent", ""), {}).items()
                      if isinstance(v, dict))
    system, fams, changed, removed, c_clear = cut_timed(
        c_spent, cut_system, leaves, c_sent_all.get(c_target, {}), c_mode, slots_failed)
    if c_clear:
        way_ops += put("f-sent0", "system_hash_sent", "{}")
    # GH #1471: what a rebuild said for the next call (`actions_pending`)
    # is the first call's of a turn; a later call of a turn that keeps its
    # cut was not changed by that rebuild and leaves it for the next turn.
    pending_actions = "" if slim.get("turn_cut") and t_cut is not None \
        else state.get(rkey("actions_pending"), "")
    actions = loads(pending_actions, [])
    if changed or removed:
        actions.append("system:" + ",".join(changed + removed))
    try:
        it = int(str(slim.get("iter") or "0"))
    except ValueError:
        it = 0
    ops = view_ops(views, stamp, blocks)
    # GH #1247 (T4-11): a consult carries the errand, not talky's identity.
    full_el = ident["full"] if not d_class else None
    # GH #1256: a consult or research call shows no identity (`full_el` is
    # None above), so it takes no snapshot either. Writing one off the
    # missing element killed the policy in phase `win` (AttributeError on
    # the first call of a `split` session) and dropped the errand and the
    # bridge with it: the turn dead-lettered `no_route`, the person heard
    # nothing. The next speaking call of the session finds no snapshot and
    # takes it, as after a rebuild.
    if ident["snap"] is not None and full_el is not None:
        # A new snapshot (GH #935): its block PUT with this call's stamp --
        # always, past the `_VIEWS` cache, so `call_blocks` names a block the
        # ledger holds -- and the state of this session PUT whole, the
        # element in it (review I-4: what the next call of the session sends
        # again is read from there, not off the newest block of its kind).
        fh = ident["snap"]["hash"]
        ops += [block_put("i-bi", fh, IDENTITY_FULL_KIND, len(str(full_el.get("text") or "")),
                          canonical(full_el), stamp)]
        ops += put("i-si", "identity_full:" + session,
                   canonical(dict(ident["snap"], element=full_el)))
    if ident["mark"]:
        # `split` without a short form runs as `full` and says so once per
        # session (GH #935): the mark carries the round, `[]` without one.
        # Its `seq` is one past the call's own (review M-4): a round-less
        # call writes `missing_audience` at `epoch_us(stamp)` beside it, and
        # `marks` has no key to order two rows of one `seq`.
        ops += [("i-miss", ins("marks", with_audience({
                    "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 1, "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn,
                    "kind": "identity_short_missing", "value": call, "at": stamp}, the_round)))]
        ops += put("i-mi", "identity_short_missing:" + session, session)
    ops.append(("f-call", ins("calls", with_audience({
        "call_id": call, "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn, "iter": it,
        "trigger": "curate", "started_at": stamp, "model": "", "tokens_prompt": None,
        "tokens_completion": None, "tokens_cached": None, "tokens_cache_write": None,
        "cost": None, "cache_expires_at": "", "system_hash": block_hash(fams),
        "actions": actions}, the_round))))
    if audience_of(the_round) is None:
        # OR-BD-4: a call without a round says so, once, beside its record --
        # as a row that declares no round (`[]`, PP-BD-12).
        ops.append(("f-noaud", ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp), "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn,
            "kind": "missing_audience", "value": call, "at": stamp}, None))))
    if overflow is not None:
        # GH #1225 (K-2): one mark per call the guard cut.
        ops.append(("f-ovf", ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 2 + len(missing), "session_id": session,
            "turn_id": turn, "kind": "overflow_cut", "value": canonical(overflow),
            "at": stamp}, the_round))))
    if failed:
        # GH #1225 (A3): one mark per call that went without what the store
        # refused, past the seqs of the call's other marks.
        ops.append(store_error_mark("f-err", phase, failed, session, turn, 3 + len(missing)))
    for i, r in enumerate(missing):
        # GH #1225 (K-8): one mark per wall row left out without its block,
        # past the seqs of the call's other marks (`i-miss`, `f-noaud`).
        ops.append(("f-miss%d" % i, ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 2 + i, "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn,
            "kind": "missing_block",
            "value": canonical({"call": call, "hash": str(r.get("hash") or ""),
                                "seq": int(r.get("seq") or 0)}),
            "at": stamp}, the_round))))
    for i, s_block in enumerate(skip_ids):
        # GH #1466: one mark per pair `recall_skip_sure` left out, with the
        # yes-value the decision stood on -- the watch counts the share of
        # skipped recalls from these, and a wrong "needs no memory" shows
        # only there. Past the seqs of the call's other marks.
        ops.append(("f-skip%d" % i, ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 20 + len(missing) + i, "session_id": session,
            "turn_id": turn, "kind": "recall_skipped",
            "value": canonical({"block": s_block, "call": call, "yes": skip_yes}),
            "at": stamp}, the_round))))
    listed = [h for _, _, h in leaves] + [h for _, _, h, _ in items]
    if full_el is not None:
        # The snapshot stands first among the messages (GH #935).
        listed.insert(len(leaves), block_hash(full_el))
    for pos, h in enumerate(listed):
        ops.append(("f-b%d" % pos, ins("call_blocks", {"call_id": call, "pos": pos, "hash": h})))
    if changed or removed:
        c_sent_all[c_target] = fams
        ops.append(("f-sent", upd("state", {"value": canonical(c_sent_all)},
                                  {"key": "system_hash_sent"})))
    if actions and pending_actions not in ("", "[]"):
        # Taken only if nobody added one since it was read.
        ops.append(("f-act", upd("state", {"value": "[]"},
                                 {"key": rkey("actions_pending"), "value": pending_actions})))
    ops.append(("f-drop", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                           "where": {"key": "pending:" + call}}))
    head = dict(slim.get("hop") or {})
    head["route"] = ERRAND_ROUTE if d_class else MODEL_ROUTE
    head["curator_call"] = call
    if ESCALATE in flags:
        # D58 moveout (contract point 3): the call that takes on a round its
        # first call handed on says so in its head field, not in the ending
        # `-esc` of its id; the collector holds its answer behind a side call
        # of the round that may still be out (GH #1300).
        head[KIND_FIELD] = FALLBACK_KIND
    if c_target:
        head["target"] = c_target
    if tool_round and c_fallback:
        # GH #1260 (OR-WG-9): the required call says it is one. talky lifts
        # `interim` into the context: the dispatcher says no answer of it that
        # carries no call, `./intake` keeps such prose out of the wall, and
        # `tap` gives the round to the fallback -- from this copy of its
        # parked turn (`pending:<call>-esc`; `f-drop` takes the call's own).
        # Contract point 4 (OR-d58-2.target.71): without a fallback in the
        # verdict nothing takes the round over, so it is no interim round.
        head["interim"] = "tool"
    if c_fallback and not is_spec:
        # GH #1352: every call of the quick voice keeps that copy, not only the
        # tool round's: a quick call that ends without an answer (an error, a
        # content filter) goes to the brain from it in `tap`. Measured in a
        # lab run: the quick voice ran into its
        # `tool_call_limit` (17 calls over the dispatcher's 16), the error left
        # for the drain, and the person got no answer at all.
        ops += put("f-escslim", "pending:" + call + ESC_SUFFIX,
                   state.get("pending:" + call, ""))
    ops += way_ops
    if seam_path:
        # GH #1247 (T4-07): one `route` mark per call that had a path. D54g
        # (GH #1506): with the stamp's trail beside the way (`route_trail`).
        ops.append(("f-route", ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 4 + len(missing), "session_id": session,
            "turn_id": turn, "kind": "route",
            "value": canonical(dict(dict({"call": call, "path": seam_path,
                                          "way": d_class or c_target},
                                         **({"reason": way_reason} if way_reason else {})),
                                    **route_trail(seam_hop))),
            "at": stamp}, the_round))))
    if tool_round and not c_fallback:
        # OR-d58-2.target.71 (contract point 4): a required round whose
        # verdict names no fallback is never parked -- an answer of it
        # without its call is the answer of the turn, and this mark says so.
        ops.append(("f-unbacked", ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 13 + len(missing), "session_id": session,
            "turn_id": turn, "kind": "tool_round_answer",
            "value": canonical({"call": call, "target": c_target, "fallback": ""}),
            "at": stamp}, the_round))))
    if c_missing:
        # D58 target (OR-d58-2.target.6): one `target_unknown` mark per call
        # cut without a named target or without the target's row.
        ops.append(("f-target", ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 11 + len(missing), "session_id": session,
            "turn_id": turn, "kind": "target_unknown",
            "value": canonical({"call": call, "target": c_target, "missing": c_missing}),
            "at": stamp}, the_round))))
    if w_unknown:
        # Nachtrag 11.11. Nr. 2 (OR-d58-2.target.6): no target holds the
        # tree, or several do and the call goes to none of them -- the
        # wall's values are the instance's, said once per call.
        ops.append(("f-wall", ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 12 + len(missing), "session_id": session,
            "turn_id": turn, "kind": "target_unknown",
            "value": canonical({"call": call, "target": c_target, "missing": "wall"}),
            "at": stamp}, the_round))))
    if LEAD_WIRED and LEAD:
        # GH #1447 (R-38-4 Nr. 6): one `lead` mark per call -- the station's
        # handle_ms, for the battery; never a verdict of a test.
        ops.append(("f-lead", ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 16 + len(missing), "session_id": session,
            "turn_id": turn, "kind": "lead",
            "value": canonical({"call": call, "way": d_class or c_target,
                                "handle_ms": int(LEAD.get("handle_ms") or 0)}),
            "at": stamp}, the_round))))
    if escalated:
        # GH #1248 (T4-10): one `escalate` mark per call the quick voice gave
        # up, with the reason.
        ops.append(("f-escm", ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 5 + len(missing), "session_id": session,
            "turn_id": turn, "kind": "escalate",
            "value": canonical(dict({"call": call, "path": seam_path,
                                     "from": c_from or str(LEAD.get("from") or ""),
                                     "to": c_target, "reason": escalated, "iter": it_now},
                                    **{k: str(v) for k, v in esc_detail.items()
                                       if k in ("finish", "error") and v})),
            "at": stamp}, the_round))))
    if notes_in or notes_out:
        # GH #1303: one mark per window that had notes -- what it showed and
        # what it left out, ids and scopes, never the texts.
        ops.append(("f-notes", ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 6 + len(missing), "session_id": session,
            "turn_id": turn, "kind": "notes",
            "value": canonical({"call": call, "notes_in": notes_in,
                                "notes_dropped": notes_out}),
            "at": stamp}, the_round))))
    ops += note_ops
    if d_class:
        # GH #1247 (T4-11, R-WP-5, R-27-3): the whole errand straight to the
        # backend, under its own consult id; the answer comes back on
        # `in_advice` like a consult the model asked for, and until then the
        # session's speaking calls carry the `consult.pending` note (#1198,
        # in the notes block since GH #1497).
        cid = "k-" + call
        head["consult_id"] = cid
        head["consult_class"] = d_class
        head["consult_wait_ms"] = str(wait_ms())
    # GH #1044: the usable window `./push` hands the memory on its ask (state
    # `input_soft`, kept from the last answer and cut to the model's window,
    # GH #1085) rides on the model call as well. The composite lifts
    # it into the call's context and stamps it on the model's own
    # `memory_recall` -- the one road to the memory that never passes
    # `./push`, about a fifth of all brain calls in a measured benchmark run.
    # Empty: no package, the memory keeps its old sizes. D58 target (N4,
    # OR-d58-2.target.16, .47): the bound is a value of the wall -- the one of
    # the target that holds it (`wall_source`), else the wall's bare bound,
    # which only an answer of a tree-holding target writes.
    head["recall_input_soft"] = (state.get(target_key(w_target, "input_soft"), "")
                                 if w_target else "") or state.get("input_soft", "")
    if cuts:
        head["cuts"] = cuts
    for k, v in (("session_id", session), ("turn_id", turn), ("iter", str(it))):
        if k not in head:
            head[k] = v
    out = {"header": head, "messages": ([full_el] if full_el is not None else [])
           + [el for _, el, _, _ in items]}
    if system:
        out["system"] = system
    c_has_scope, c_scope, c_refused = cut_timed(c_spent, cut_scope, cp, slim, q_scope,
                                                no_tools, LEAD.get("deny"), is_spec,
                                                tool_round)
    if c_has_scope:
        out["tool_scope"] = c_scope
    if c_refused:
        # GH #1497 (review I2 of the strand, K OR-58-197): the tools the lead
        # denies while the session's consult runs stay on the menu (a menu that
        # changes breaks the cached prefix before the system part) and are
        # refused at the call instead -- the composite lifts this hop key into
        # the context, and its dispatcher answers such a call with a tool
        # error: no second errand leaves, the model speaks once more.
        head["tools_refused"] = ",".join(c_refused)
    # GH #1038: what this call holds, estimated like the llm cell does --
    # every system leaf (the model keeps the whole tree, `out` carries only
    # what changed) and every message; the tap reads it back by the call.
    # A call the guard cut keeps the estimate of the whole wall (GH #1225).
    # GH #1427 (OR-d38-1.k6.4): the raw part rides along -- the messages of
    # the wall rows above the plan's cover and the rounds they belong to.
    raw_cover = plan_cover(plan, []) if plan else 0
    # GH #1434 (OR-38-29 B3, OR-d38-1.k6b.1): measured as the budget
    # measures it (`raw_estimate`: block characters over the rate, a shrunk
    # or released row at its one-line form), not `estimate_tokens` of the
    # elements -- the bench read that at 1.37-1.40x the budget.
    # Review I-1 of GH #1434: only the rows the call sends -- the seqs of its
    # `items`, after the guard's cut and the quick filter. Over the whole wall
    # a quick call (the running round and `keep_recent` 4 elements) named six
    # rounds it never sent, 3005 tokens over a projection of 1164.
    sent_seqs = set(p for p, _, _, _ in items)
    # A final answer `render` cut at its sidecar block counts at the text it
    # sends (`with_cut`, the cap `render` was handed); a shrunk, released or
    # expired row at its one-line form (`gone_ids`, as `render` only with a
    # plan) -- review m-2 and the rest list of GH #1434.
    raw_cap = budget_chars(c_budget["soft"], SIDECAR_SHARE)
    raw_wall = [with_cut(dict(r, chars=(blocks.get(str(r.get("hash") or "")) or {}).get("chars") or 0),
                         element_of(r), raw_cap)
                for r in wall if int(r.get("seq") or 0) > raw_cover
                and int(r.get("seq") or 0) in sent_seqs]
    raw_gone = (gone_ids(raw_wall, plan.get("shrunk") or [], plan.get("released") or [],
                         plan.get("as_of_ms"), (session, turn)) if plan else set())
    raw_rate = c_budget["rate"] or float(CHARS_PER_TOKEN)
    raw_part = {"raw_tokens": int(raw_estimate(raw_wall, raw_gone, raw_rate)),
                "raw_rounds": len(set((str(r.get("session_id") or ""), str(r.get("turn_id") or ""))
                                      for r in raw_wall))}
    est_at = len(ops)
    est_now = overflow["before"] if overflow else estimate_tokens(
        {"system": [[path, text] for path, text, _ in leaves], "messages": out["messages"]})
    ops += put("f-est", "window_est:" + call, est_row(way, est_now, raw_part, c_plan,
                                                     c_target, c_mode == "delta",
                                                     cp["closes_turn"], (w_target, w_profile),
                                                     c_moved))
    # A call no tap answered (a lost answer) left its projection behind: the
    # next call of the round takes it down, the round keeps one (KF2 review N3).
    prev_est = state.get(rkey("est_call"), "")
    if prev_est and prev_est != call:
        ops.append(("f-est-old", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                                  "where": {"key": "window_est:" + prev_est}}))
    ops += put("f-estc", rkey("est_call"), call)
    # GH #1448 (R-38-4 Nr. 5): the call's plan as a snapshot -- its block ids
    # with their prio and tokens, one row per call under the round; the
    # round keeps its newest `snapshot_keep`.
    # OR-d38-3.o10.2 (review I1): every block the call sends -- the system
    # part and the identity as `frame`, the plan's, the notes block's lines
    # as `state`/`note` -- the text sent unchanged; the call's own, never
    # the plan's (rebuilt each call, built ahead later).
    # GH #1448 (OR-38-65 b, review I2): a recall block's prio is the call's:
    # a brain call of a stamped turn without `memory` lowers the running
    # turn's ambient recall (every one in the wall), never a stub, and the
    # plan keeps `prio_of(kind)` -- a later turn sees the preset.
    low = set()
    if cp["recall"] and c_mode == "delta" and RECALL_BY_NEEDS and recall_unneeded(seam_hop, ctx):
        low = set("recall:" + short_id(r.get("hash")) for r in wall
                  if (str(r.get("session_id") or ""), str(r.get("turn_id") or "")) == (session, turn)
                  and ambient_of(loads(str(r.get("body") or ""), {})) == "recall")
    c_aud = round_canon(the_round)
    call_blocks = [block_of("frame", {"path": p, "text": t}, {"source": "system", "hash": h}, c_aud)
                   for p, t, h in leaves] \
        + ([block_of("frame", full_el, {"source": "system", "hash": block_hash(full_el)}, c_aud)]
           if full_el is not None else []) \
        + [dict(b, prio=prio_of("recall_unneeded" if b.get("id") in low else "recall"))
           if b.get("kind") == "recall" else b for b in c_plan["blocks"]] \
        + note_blocks(lead, notes_in, c_aud)
    # GH #1450 (OR-d38-3.c3b.2): the second half of the snapshot -- the cut.
    c_cut = cut(call_blocks, wall, c_stages, c_row, c_target,
                {"soft": cw_int(c_budget["soft"]) or None, "target": c_budget["target"] or None,
                 "hard": int(HARD_HEADROOM * c_budget["line"])}, (session, turn), c_spent,
                scope_names(out.get("tool_scope")))
    # D58 target (contract point 2, OR-d58-2.target.7): whose order the
    # system part of `sent` follows -- the reported one of the target's cell,
    # else the path's.
    c_cut["system_order"] = "reported" if c_row else "path"
    # Review o15-Rv1 m1 (V5): the snapshot says why a recall pair is absent.
    in_wall_cut = [{"id": str(b.get("id") or ""), "why": "recall_in_wall"} for b in in_wall]
    if in_wall_cut:
        c_cut["dropped"] = c_cut["dropped"] + in_wall_cut
    if skip_blocks:
        # GH #1466: and why the fetched pair of this turn is.
        c_cut["dropped"] = c_cut["dropped"] + [
            {"id": str(b.get("id") or ""), "why": "recall_skip_sure"} for b in skip_blocks]
    s_prev = sorted((cw_int(r.get("seq")) for r in rows(lg, "w-snap")), reverse=True)
    s_seq = max([epoch_us(stamp)] + [x + 1 for x in s_prev])
    # D58 moveout (contract point 1): the verdict's side calls whose
    # condition holds -- `external` when this call leaves the composite,
    # `must_call` when the cut made it the required tool round. Every one of
    # them goes (review A M1): which to name is the lead's choice.
    sides = holding_entries(LEAD.get("side"), bool(d_class), tool_round)
    # D58 moveout (orchestrator rulings b and moveout.15): the side text
    # stands under the slot the target's profile names
    # (`instructions.side_slot`), else under the entry's `slot` -- a target
    # that reported no profile yet (the first call to it in the life of the
    # colony goes out beside its `catalog_ask`, never after it) keeps its
    # side call so. Neither names one, or the entry names no target
    # (OR-d58-2.target.71): the side call has no place for its text and
    # stays in, said on stderr.
    s_unplaced = [e for e in sides if not side_slot_of(e, state)]
    for e in s_unplaced:
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: side call of call %s to %r not sent -- no target, or"
                         " neither the target's profile nor the entry names a side slot\n"
                         % (call, str(e.get("target") or "")))
    sides = [e for e in sides if not any(e is u for u in s_unplaced)]
    # Review o15-R1 I3: a side call is a call of its own and takes its own
    # snapshot row, one seq past this one each; the round still keeps its
    # newest `snapshot_keep`. Review m6 of c3b: with `snapshot_keep` 1 the
    # new rows are too many -- the call's own row goes too, a side call's is
    # kept.
    s_keep = SNAPSHOT_KEEP - (1 + len(sides))
    if SNAPSHOT_WINDOW:
        # GH #1463 (contract point 7, review I-2): the state of the plan this
        # call was built on (`window_epoch`: the claim of the rebuild that
        # made it and its cover), kept in the call's own row -- the watch of
        # the next call reads it there.
        c_cut["plan_epoch"] = window_epoch(plan)
    w_row = {
        "seq": s_seq, "call_id": call,
        "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn, "at": stamp,
        "body": canonical([{"id": b.get("id"), "prio": b.get("prio"), "tokens": b.get("tokens")}
                           for b in call_blocks]),
        "cut": canonical(c_cut)}
    s_kinds = {}
    if SNAPSHOT_WINDOW:
        # GH #1462 (R-38-4 Nr. 5): what this call SENT, element by element,
        # from what the cut holds at this point -- no read, no second render.
        # The system part is the tree the model holds for this call (`leaves`,
        # the tree the estimate above counts), each leaf marked by whether the
        # cut sent its family with this call (`system`, OR-58-44); what the
        # cut made itself is `s_made`.
        s_kinds = sent_kinds(c_plan["blocks"], wall)
        s_msgs = [(el, s_kinds.get(p) or block_kind(el), c_forms.get(p, "raw"))
                  for p, el, _, _ in items]
        s_sent, s_puts = sent_list(
            leaves, system, s_made, full_el, s_msgs,
            lead, note_lines(lead, notes_in), scope_menu(out.get("tool_scope")),
            c_row.get("system_order") if c_row else None)
        if in_wall:
            # GH #1463 (OR-d58-2.form.3): the pair this call decided to leave
            # out, behind the messages it sent -- each element with the form
            # `cut` and `why`. `hash` names the block of the wall, the bytes
            # that were NOT sent (the ledger holds it, no put); without the
            # entries "was the context there?" has no answer for a block that
            # never reached the plan. Only the deciding call lists them.
            s_gone = [{"hash": h, "kind": str(b.get("kind") or ""), "form": "cut",
                       "bytes": len(str((blocks.get(h) or {}).get("body") or "").encode("utf-8")),
                       "why": "recall_in_wall"}
                      for b in in_wall
                      for h in [str((b.get("origin") or {}).get("hash") or "")]]
            s_at = len(s_sent) - (0 if scope_menu(out.get("tool_scope")) is None else 1)
            s_sent[s_at:s_at] = s_gone
        if skip_blocks:
            # GH #1466: the pair `recall_skip_sure` left out, listed like the
            # form's (OR-d58-2.form.3): behind the messages sent, each element
            # with the form `cut` and `why`, `hash` the block of the wall.
            s_gone = [{"hash": h, "kind": str(b.get("kind") or ""), "form": "cut",
                       "bytes": len(str((blocks.get(h) or {}).get("body") or "").encode("utf-8")),
                       "why": "recall_skip_sure"}
                      for b in skip_blocks
                      for h in [str((b.get("origin") or {}).get("hash") or "")]]
            s_at = len(s_sent) - (0 if scope_menu(out.get("tool_scope")) is None else 1)
            s_sent[s_at:s_at] = s_gone
        w_row["sent"] = canonical(s_sent)
        ops += sent_ops(s_puts, stamp, blocks, SENT_PUTS[0])
        # GH #1463 (contract point 7, R-58-8): the watch of this call over
        # its own window, against the newest window sent to the same target
        # (a side call is a window of its own and is not compared). Measured in
        # the run before the form: a cut per call broke the cached prefix
        # and raised the cost of a call by 121 %, almost all cache write --
        # and nobody saw it. A rebuild lay between when the two calls were
        # built on different states of the plan (`plan_epoch` of the row
        # before against this call's own) -- never told by time (review I-2):
        # a plan carries the moment its rebuild was RESERVED, and a call that
        # left while the summarizer worked is younger than that; told by
        # time, the call after such a rebuild counted a break, one false
        # alarm per rebuild. A row from before the key says nothing: no
        # verdict. The guard at the hard line counts like a rebuild
        # (`overflow`). No window before: nothing to compare, both 0.
        watch = dict((k, 0) for k in WATCH_FIELDS)
        w_prev, w_held = None, None
        for r in rows(lg, "w-sent"):
            # D58 moveout (contract point 3): a side call's row says its kind
            # in its cut (`call_kind`), not in the ending of its id.
            if loads(str(r.get("cut") or ""), {}).get(KIND_FIELD) != SIDE_KIND \
                    and loads(str(r.get("cut") or ""), {}).get("target") == c_cut["target"] \
                    and loads(str(r.get("sent") or ""), []):
                w_prev = r if w_prev is None else w_prev
                # GH #1497: the tree the target holds -- the newest of these
                # rows that listed a system part (`window_watch`, HELD).
                if sent_parts(loads(str(r.get("sent") or ""), []))[0]:
                    w_held = loads(str(r.get("sent") or ""), [])
                    break
        if w_prev is not None:
            placed = {}
            for r in [] if wall_failed else rows(lg, "w-keep") + rows(lg, "w-wall"):
                if passes(r, the_round, session):
                    spot = (int(r.get("seq") or 0),
                            (str(r.get("session_id") or ""), str(r.get("turn_id") or "")))
                    if spot not in placed.setdefault(str(r.get("hash") or ""), []):
                        placed[str(r.get("hash") or "")].append(spot)
            w_epoch = loads(str(w_prev.get("cut") or ""), {}).get("plan_epoch")
            watch = window_watch(
                loads(str(w_prev.get("sent") or ""), []),
                (str(w_prev.get("session_id") or ""), str(w_prev.get("turn_id") or "")),
                s_sent, (session, turn), placed, sent_seqs, raw_cover,
                lambda h: is_error_result((loads(str((blocks.get(h) or {}).get("body") or ""), {})
                                           or {}).get("text")),
                # GH #1471 (contract point 6): for a turn that keeps a row
                # (`t_key`: the form on, a session and a turn) another
                # state of the plan excuses between two turns only. Every
                # call of such a turn is cut by the turn's row, so two
                # states inside it are the fault this figure is for; the
                # guard alone excuses, and a row that was swept excuses
                # nothing. A turn that keeps no row (`recall_in_wall`
                # "0") takes a rebuild between two of its calls by
                # design: no verdict there, as before the row.
                bool(overflow) or (w_epoch != window_epoch(plan) and not (
                    t_key and (str(w_prev.get("session_id") or ""),
                               str(w_prev.get("turn_id") or "")) == (session, turn))),
                w_held)
        ops[est_at] = put("f-est", "window_est:" + call,
                          est_row(way, est_now, dict(raw_part, **watch), c_plan,
                                  c_target, c_mode == "delta", cp["closes_turn"],
                                  (w_target, w_profile), c_moved))[0]
    ops.append(("f-snap", ins("snapshots", with_audience(w_row, the_round))))
    if s_keep < 0 or len(s_prev) > s_keep:
        ops.append(("f-snapgc", {"operation": "delete", "table": "snapshots", "where": {
            "audience_set": with_audience({}, the_round)["audience_set"],
            "seq": {"lte": s_seq if s_keep < 0 else s_prev[s_keep]}}}))
    also, first, a_cells = [], [], [c_target]
    for s_i, s_entry in enumerate(sides):
        # D58 moveout (GH #1476, contract point 2): A SIDE CALL -- one window
        # beside the main call for the target the entry names, built the same
        # for every entry: the target's leaves with the frame slot, without
        # the sidecar contract, the gated and session families whole, the
        # entry's text as a leaf of the target's side slot, no tool; its own
        # `calls` row (trigger `side`), its own snapshot, its own budget from
        # the target's catalogue row. Its answer never ends the turn. Before
        # the move the curator decided and worded these calls itself (GH #1248,
        # T4-12; GH #1260, OR-WG-6).
        b_text = side_fill(str(s_entry.get("text") or ""), s_entry.get("fill"), q_scope)
        b_window = "wall" if str(s_entry.get("window") or "") == "wall" else "turn"
        # The main call's `interim` ("tool": its required call) is the main
        # call's; a side call says only its own kind.
        b_head = {k: v for k, v in head.items()
                  if k not in ("consult_id", "consult_class", "consult_wait_ms", "interim")}
        b_head["route"] = MODEL_ROUTE
        # The id of the first keeps its ending of before (contract point 3,
        # the corpus stays byte-equal), every further one is new and says
        # `side`; nobody reads either.
        b_head["curator_call"] = call + ("-bridge" if s_i == 0 else "-%d-side" % s_i)
        b_head[KIND_FIELD] = SIDE_KIND
        if LEAD.get("quick_speculative"):
            # GH #1398 (V1): a speculating curator's side call reaches a cell
            # of its own by its target (`hop.target`, the verdict's entry), so
            # it never queues behind a spec call or the tool round; the head
            # says no spec of its own (contract point 4: `spec` "bridge" is
            # done with `hop.target`).
            b_head.pop("spec", None)
        # Every entry left names its target (OR-d58-2.target.71, `side_slot_of`).
        b_cell = str(s_entry.get("target") or "").strip()
        b_head["target"] = b_cell
        # The side call's own instruction slot (OR-d58-2.target.14: the profile
        # of its target names it): the call's leaves lost it with the slots
        # of the other targets (`foreign_slots` of the call's target), so it
        # comes back from the slots before that cut; the slots of the other
        # targets stay out. Before the profiles only the brain dropped the
        # quick slot, and a bridge beside a consult read it.
        b_cp = call_profile(b_cell, "", state)
        b_own = slot_path(b_cp["slot"])
        b_had = set(x[0] for x in leaves)
        # GH #1497 (OR-d58-2.prefix.3): a side call keeps the pending note
        # in its system part, as before the note moved to the main call's
        # notes block -- a side window carries no notes block, sends its
        # whole tree on every call and is no window the watch compares.
