        b_pend = [(CONSULT_PENDING, pending_text(pending),
                   block_hash({"path": CONSULT_PENDING, "text": pending_text(pending)}))] \
            if p_shown and pending else []
        b_src = without_slots(
            sorted(leaves + b_pend + [x for x in s_slots if b_own and x[0] not in b_had
                                      and (x[0] == b_own or x[0].startswith(b_own + "."))],
                   key=lambda x: path_key(x[0])),
            foreign_slots(b_cp, state))
        # The text stands under the target's side slot (its profile's
        # `instructions.side_slot`, OR-d58-2.moveout.3; else the entry's,
        # OR-d58-2.moveout.15), never in the messages.
        b_leaf = slot_path(side_slot_of(s_entry, state))
        # OR-d58-2.frame.2: the side call's moment is its target's word like
        # every call's -- `frame` only when the profile of `b_cell` says so;
        # a leaf the call's own target took along stays out of a side call
        # whose target did not ask for it (before, the knobs alone gave the
        # side call the leaf, whatever its target's profile said).
        b_own_leaves = own_slot_leaves(b_src, b_cp)
        b_own_leaves = with_frame(b_own_leaves, stamp) if b_cp["frame"] \
            else [x for x in b_own_leaves if x[0] != FRAME_PATH]
        b_leaves = sorted([x for x in b_own_leaves
                           if x[0] != CONTRACT_PATH
                           and not x[0].startswith(CONTRACT_PATH + ".")]
                          + [(b_leaf, b_text, block_hash({"path": b_leaf, "text": b_text}))],
                          key=lambda x: path_key(x[0]))
        if str(s_entry.get("when")) == WHEN_MUST_CALL:
            # GH #1260: the round goes on with the tool result, so the
            # side call's answer does not end it -- as final answer it ended
            # the round (the collector drops it) before the result came back.
            # Contract point 4 (ruling a): said in the neutral field.
            b_head[OPEN_FIELD] = "1"
        # The side call reaches its target like a call of it (re-check I1):
        # its gated and session families go whole, empty included.
        b_system = {f: family_node(f, b_leaves) for f in family_hashes(b_leaves)}
        for f in GATED_FAMILIES + SESSION_FAMILIES:
            b_system[f] = family_node(f, b_leaves)
        # GH #1260 (lock W6): a side call is a model call of its own and has
        # its own `calls` row, so the tap of its answer books its usage --
        # without it the update by `call_id` met no row and its tokens fell
        # out of the ledger.
        b_op = "" if s_i == 0 else "-%d" % s_i
        ops.append(("f-bcall" + b_op, ins("calls", with_audience({
            "call_id": b_head["curator_call"], "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn,
            "iter": it, "trigger": SIDE_KIND, "started_at": stamp, "model": "",
            "tokens_prompt": None, "tokens_completion": None, "tokens_cached": None,
            "tokens_cache_write": None, "cost": None, "cache_expires_at": "",
            "system_hash": block_hash(family_hashes(b_leaves)), "actions": []},
            the_round))))
        # Review o15-R1 I3 (OR-d38-3.o15.3): a side call is cut by the one
        # stage 2 -- its window (`cut_side`), its budget and its cell (the
        # entry's target), its snapshot and its catalogue question like every
        # other call.
        b_spent = [0.0]
        b_budget = cut_timed(b_spent, cut_budget, b_cell, state)
        b_msgs, b_pos = cut_timed(b_spent, cut_side, unmoved, wall, b_window, (session, turn),
                                  b_cp["keep_recent"])
        b_blocks = [block_of("frame", {"path": p, "text": t}, {"source": "system", "hash": h},
                             c_aud) for p, t, h in b_leaves] \
            + [b for b in c_plan["blocks"] if (b.get("origin") or {}).get("source") == "wall"]
        b_cut = cut(b_blocks, wall, c_stages[:2] + [b_pos, b_pos], catalog_row(b_cell, state),
                    b_cell, {"soft": cw_int(b_budget["soft"]) or None,
                             "target": b_budget["target"] or None,
                             "hard": int(HARD_HEADROOM * b_budget["line"])},
                    (session, turn), b_spent, [])
        b_cut["system_order"] = "reported" if catalog_row(b_cell, state) else "path"
        # D58 moveout (contract point 3): the row of a side call says its kind,
        # so the watch of the next call skips it without reading its id.
        b_cut[KIND_FIELD] = SIDE_KIND
        if in_wall_cut:
            b_cut["dropped"] = b_cut["dropped"] + in_wall_cut
        b_row = {
            "seq": s_seq + 1 + s_i, "call_id": b_head["curator_call"],
            "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn, "at": stamp,
            "body": canonical([{"id": b.get("id"), "prio": b.get("prio"),
                                "tokens": b.get("tokens")} for b in b_blocks]),
            "cut": canonical(b_cut)}
        if SNAPSHOT_WINDOW:
            # GH #1462: a side call is a call of its own and lists its own
            # window -- its whole tree as sent (`b_system`), its messages, and
            # a menu without a name. Built is what the call's cut made and
            # every leaf this tree holds beyond the call's; the lines of the
            # notes block are listed when one of its messages carries it.
            b_at = dict((id(el), p) for p, el, _, _ in unmoved)
            b_had = set(x[0] for x in leaves)
            b_sent, b_puts = sent_list(
                b_leaves, b_system,
                s_made + tuple(x[0] for x in b_leaves if x[0] not in b_had), None,
                [(el, s_kinds.get(b_at.get(id(el))) or block_kind(el),
                  c_forms.get(b_at.get(id(el)), "raw")) for el in b_msgs],
                lead, note_lines(lead, notes_in), scope_menu({"allow": []}),
                catalog_row(b_cell, state).get("system_order")
                if catalog_row(b_cell, state) else None)
            b_row["sent"] = canonical(b_sent)
            ops += sent_ops(b_puts, stamp, blocks,
                            SENT_PUTS[1] + ("" if s_i == 0 else "%d-" % s_i))
        ops.append(("f-bsnap" + b_op, ins("snapshots", with_audience(b_row, the_round))))
        a_cells.append(b_cell)
        (first if flag_word(s_entry.get("first") or False) else also).append(
            {"header": b_head, "messages": b_msgs, "system": b_system,
             "tool_scope": {"allow": []}})
    # An entry with `first` leaves before the main call, every other one after
    # it (contract point 1). GH #1260 fix round 1 (OR-WG-8): when the side
    # call and the main call reach the same stateful model cell (one
    # `handle()` at a time; `max_concurrency` is a stateless knob), they cannot
    # run side by side, and the order of the sends is the order of the
    # answers -- which goes first is the entry's word (the lead's choice).
    sends = first + [out] + also
    if c_form is not None:
        ops += put("f-form", target_key(c_target, "form"), c_form)
    a_asked = 0
    a_unheard = [c for i, c in enumerate(a_cells) if c and c not in a_cells[:i]
                 and not catalog_row(c, state)
                 and state.get(target_key(c, "asked"), "") != session]
    a_all = bool(a_unheard) and state.get(target_key("", "asked"), "") != session
    if a_all:
        # D58 target (contract point 5, OR-d58-2.target.15): the first call of
        # a session to a target without a row asks every cell at once --
        # `catalog_ask` without `catalog_for`, each cell answers on
        # `in_catalog` with its row, no model call --, beside the call and
        # never instead of it (OR-d38-3.c3b.1; latency is KEY).
        _ALSO.append({"header": {"route": "catalog_ask", "session_id": session},
                      "system": {}, "params": {}})
        ops += put("f-askall", target_key("", "asked"), session)
    for a_cell in a_unheard:
        if not a_all:
            # GH #1450 (OR-d38-3.c3b.1): asked everyone this session already
            # -- ask the one cell, once this session. One round trip, no
            # polling.
            _ALSO.append({"header": {"route": "catalog_ask", "catalog_for": a_cell,
                                     "session_id": session},
                          "system": {}, "params": {}})
        ops += put("f-ask" + (str(a_asked) if a_asked else ""), target_key(a_cell, "asked"),
                   session)
        a_asked += 1
    if ESCALATE in flags and str(LEAD.get("shown") or ""):
        # GH #1432 (Telegram round 4, turn 5): the stored call of a failed
        # speculation failed as well and the round went to the brain, which
        # wrote anew what the shown spec sentence had said. The brain call
        # carries that sentence as its own words, like the stored call did
        # (the lead reads the row `spec_shown` for an escalation).
        sends = with_shown(sends, str(LEAD.get("shown")))
    # D58 moveout (contract points 6 and 7): THE ROUND'S CONDITIONAL FEEDS
    # AND ITS NOTE. Whether a condition held (`external`: this call leaves the
    # composite; `must_call`: the cut made it the required tool round) only
    # this step knows. Each entry of the verdict's `feed` whose condition
    # holds goes as an own feed (`own_feed`, the one road of strand feed):
    # its body unchanged, its `mark` into the mark `feed`, WITH the round's
    # sends -- held with them for an awaited spec answer or a delta, gone
    # with them when the round never goes; its mark is a held write
    # (`go_ops`). An entry with `once` takes the claim's round trip
    # first (`feed-send`), that step riding with the sends the same way.
    # And the lead hears of every round a condition held for (`lead_note`
    # "round": the condition, the call, the time of the seam), even when no
    # feed goes -- it times its own bookkeeping from there; held, the note
    # rides with the sends and counts only when they go (before the move the
    # curator kept that row itself, GH #1400).
    h_ops = []
    r_when = WHEN_MUST_CALL if tool_round else (WHEN_EXTERNAL if d_class else "")
    if r_when:
        f_head = {"live": live_of(seam_hop), "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn}
        for f_i, f_entry in enumerate(holding_entries(LEAD.get("feed"), bool(d_class),
                                                      tool_round)):
            f_body = f_entry.get("body") if isinstance(f_entry.get("body"), dict) else {}
            f_order = own_feed(dict(f_head, section=str(f_entry.get("section") or "")),
                               f_body, the_round, str(f_entry.get("once") or ""),
                               f_entry.get("mark"))
            f_reads = feed_reads(f_order)
            if f_reads:
                sends = sends + [lstore(f_reads, "feed-send", "", canonical(f_order))]
                continue
            # The mark's seq: +9 for the first entry (its place of before the
            # move), the sequence beyond the marks of this step for the others.
            f_ops, f_msg = feed_out(f_order, None, stamp, 9 if f_i == 0 else 30 + f_i)
            h_ops += [(c + ("" if f_i == 0 else "-%d" % f_i), o) for c, o in f_ops]
            if f_msg:
                sends = sends + [f_msg]
        sends = sends + lead_note("round", session, turn, when=r_when, call=call,
                                  at_ms=epoch_ms(stamp))
    if spec_wait is None and s_raw and str(s_row.get("call") or "") == call \
            and str(s_row.get("state") or "") == "normal":
        # GH #1279: the `normal` claim goes with the call it guarded (the
        # lead's `spec_called:` row is the guard from here, OR-d38-3.c1.8).
        _ALSO.extend(lead_note("spec_normal", session, turn, raw=s_raw))
    # D58 lead (GH #1474, contract point 3): both stores below are the
    # lead's; without one (no verdict, so no delta and no awaited spec) the
    # call goes as it is.
    if LEAD_WIRED and d_verdict == "reused":
        # GH #1279: the reused call is stored in the lead and the row moved
        # `fired` -> `delta` by CAS; its `delta-send` hands it back (`spec_act`
        # "delta") only when the move took. The call's records go now.
        emit([lstore(ops, "done", call, ""),
              lead_spec("delta_fb", session, turn, call, sends=sends + once_sends,
                        go_ops=h_ops + once_ops, raw=s_raw, delta_raw=dl.get("raw"))])
    if LEAD_WIRED and spec_wait is not None:
        # GH #1275: the built call is the fallback of an awaited spec answer --
        # stored in the lead (`spec-await` there), sent when the answer is
        # dropped (`spec_act` "settle"/"fb_go"). The call's records go now.
        emit([lstore(ops, "done", call, ""),
              lead_spec("fb", session, turn, call, sends=sends + once_sends, needs=spec_wait,
                        families=spec_fams, go_ops=h_ops + once_ops, raw=s_raw)])
    spec_go = []
    if is_spec and LEAD_WIRED and (once_ops or once_sends):
        # D58 note (GH #1477, contract point 3): a spec call's answer is held,
        # not heard -- what its window showed is booked only when the answer
        # is kept (`spec_act` "settle" with `keep`, the `kept` branch), never
        # when it is dropped or discarded. Held in the lead beside the turn's
        # row, sent before the call so it is there before the answer.
        spec_go = [lead_spec("spec_go", session, turn, call, go_ops=once_ops,
                             sends=once_sends)]
        once_ops, once_sends = [], []
    emit([lstore(ops + h_ops + once_ops, "done", call, "")] + spec_go + sends + once_sends)

if phase == "tap":
    report_errors(lg)
    t_failed = failed_legs(lg)
    t_err = [store_error_mark("t-err", phase, t_failed)] if t_failed else []
    if "b-state" in t_failed:
        # GH #1225 (A3): the answer's usage (`pending:tap-<call>`) is out of
        # reach -- read as empty, the fallback row's limits would overwrite
        # the model's own (`input_hard`, `aim`, `curate`). The call is the
        # round's last; the rest waits for the next answer.
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: the store refused the tap of call %s -- its usage is"
                         " not known, nothing derived from it is written (%s)\n"
                         % (call, STORE_ERROR))
        emit([lstore(put("t-last", rkey("last_call"), call) + t_err, "done", call, "")])
    state = state_of(lg, "b-state")
    stash = loads(state.get("pending:tap-" + call, ""), {})
    # D58 moveout (contract point 3, OR-d58-2.moveout.1): whether this is the
    # answer of a side call -- its kind rides in the context (the composite
    # lifts `hop.call_kind`), never in the ending of its id.
    a_side = str(ctx.get(KIND_FIELD) or "") == SIDE_KIND
    usage = stash.get("usage") or {}
    e_turn = str(stash.get("turn") or "")
    if ERRAND_OUTCOME and round_label(e_turn):
        # GH #1469 (contract point 2): the call of a delegation round is
        # back -- as an error, or with a final answer that reached the
        # wall. Either is said at the parked row of the errand, in a read
        # and a compare-and-set of its own (phase `errand-end`); a tool
        # round and an empty answer say nothing.
        e_end = OUTCOME_FAILED if str(stash.get("finish") or "") == "error" \
            else "answered" if stash.get("final") and stash.get("messages") else ""
        if e_end:
            e_key = DELEGATION_KEY + "%s#%s" % (
                delegation_scope(str(stash.get("session") or ""), live_of(None)),
                round_label(e_turn))
            _ALSO.append(lstore(
                [("eo-row", sel("state", ["key", "value"], {"key": e_key}))],
                "errand-end", call,
                canonical({"k": e_key, "t": e_turn, "end": e_end,
                           "code": outcome_code(stash.get("error_code"))})))
    fields = {}
    for k in ("model", "tokens_prompt", "tokens_completion", "tokens_cached",
              "tokens_cache_write", "cost", "cache_expires_at"):
        if usage.get(k) is not None:
            fields[k] = usage.get(k) if k != "cache_expires_at" else str(usage.get(k))
    if "cost" in fields:
        # `calls.cost` is a `json` column: the llm cell stamps a fraction and
        # the store has no real type, so the number is kept as its JSON text
        # (review M4). Anything that is not a number is not a cost.
        c = fields.pop("cost")
        try:
            if not isinstance(c, bool):
                fields["cost"] = canonical(c if isinstance(c, (int, float)) else float(str(c)))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            pass
    # GH #943: the round's last call, PUT -- the row of a new round is not
    # there yet, and an `update` would set nothing.
    ops = put("t-last", rkey("last_call"), call)
    consults = [str(c) for c in (stash.get("consults") or []) if str(c)]
    if consults:
        # GH #1280 (review I1): the brain started a consult itself
        # (`consult_cogny` in its output, `./intake`). Since `talk:brain`
        # (GH #1260) the brain holds the tool on talk turns, and without a
        # mark the next turn's brain had it on its menu again -- the same
        # double consult as a curator's one. The mark is the curator's own
        # form, under the call's id (cogny's advice comes back under it), and
        # written only while none stands (`if_absent`): a consult the curator
        # sent keeps its mark. Advice, backstop and deny then work unchanged.
        # GH #1447: the mark is the lead's row -- a note, the lead writes it.
        _ALSO.extend(lead_note("errand", str(stash.get("session") or "default"),
                               str(stash.get("turn") or ""), consult_id=consults[0],
                               at=now()))
    if fields:
        ops.insert(0, ("t-call", upd("calls", fields, {"call_id": call})))
    # Review M1 of F2: the way the call left on, kept with its projection
    # (`window_est:<call>`, phase `win`); a bridge keeps none and is quick.
    projected, a_way, raw_part = est_of(state.get("window_est:" + call, ""))
    # D58 target (contract point 7): the target the call was cut for (its
    # projection), else the one the answer names (`curator_target`); None:
    # unknown, nothing is kept per target. The answer of a target that holds
    # its tree, or of an unknown way, keeps the wall's values too.
    a_est = loads(state.get("window_est:" + call, ""), {})
    a_target = str(a_est["target"]) if "target" in a_est else (
        str(ctx.get("curator_target")) if ctx.get("curator_target") not in (None, "") else None)
    a_wall = bool(a_est.get("tree")) if "target" in a_est else not a_side
    # Nachtrag 11.11.: the wall's values are the tree-holding target's, which
    # the call's projection names (phase `win`); without its profile, the
    # instance's. Its order to the clock carries that target (OR-d58-2.target.9).
    a_ref = str(a_est.get("wall") or "")
    if isinstance(a_est.get("wall_profile"), dict) and a_est["wall_profile"]:
        (KEEP_RECENT, KEEP_RECENT_TOKENS, COMPRESS_AT, REBUILD_TO, HORIZON, TIERS, KEEP_ROUNDS,
     GC, GC_SCAFFOLD, STUB_TOOLS_AFTER, WINDOW_TARGET, STATE_LINES) = wall_values(a_est["wall_profile"])
    # Contract point 10: the answer names its target (`curator_target`) or
    # its projection does; an answer without one counts as the answer of the
    # target that closes the turn. Its fallback is the copy `win` kept with
    # the parked call -- only when the verdict named one.
    a_esc = bool(state.get("pending:" + call + ESC_SUFFIX, ""))
    t_plan = loads(state.get("window_est:" + call, ""), {}).get("plan")
    if isinstance(t_plan, dict) and isinstance(t_plan.get("blocks"), list):
        # GH #1448 (Z1.2): the plan is built after the answer -- the call's
        # plan and the answer's blocks, ahead of the next turn.
        t_blocks = [b for b in t_plan["blocks"] if isinstance(b, dict)]
        t_blocks += blocks_of_rows(
            [{"el": m} for m in (stash.get("messages") or []) if isinstance(m, dict)],
            [str(b.get("id") or "") for b in t_blocks], round_canon(the_round))
        seen = str(t_plan.get("seen") or "")
        t_base = loads(seen, {})
        if RECALL_IN_WALL:
            # GH #1463: the plan keeps what the call decided to leave out
            # (`left_out`), and names the blocks planned ahead just now
            # (`ahead`) -- the next call checks them against the wall once;
            # the list of the tap before is spent.
            t_had = set(str((b.get("origin") or {}).get("hash") or "") for b in t_plan["blocks"]
                        if isinstance(b, dict))
            t_base = dict((k, v) for k, v in t_base.items() if k not in ("left_out", "ahead"))
            t_ahead = sorted(set(str((b.get("origin") or {}).get("hash") or "")
                                 for b in t_blocks) - t_had)
            if t_plan.get("left_out"):
                t_base["left_out"] = t_plan["left_out"]
            if t_ahead:
                t_base["ahead"] = t_ahead
        if RECALL_SKIP_SURE and not RECALL_IN_WALL and t_plan.get("left_out"):
            # GH #1466: the plan keeps what the call decided to leave out.
            t_base = dict(t_base, left_out=t_plan["left_out"])
        t_text = canonical(dict(
            t_base, blocks=t_blocks, blocks_to=cw_int(t_plan.get("blocks_to"))))
        ops += plan_cas("t-plan", rkey("window_plan"), t_text, seen)
        t_tc = t_plan.get("turn_cut") if RECALL_IN_WALL else None
        if isinstance(t_tc, dict) and t_tc.get("held") and isinstance(t_tc.get("meta"), dict):
            # GH #1471: the same plan into the row the call's turn is cut by
            # -- the next call of the turn reads it there, and with it what
            # this call decided (`left_out`, `ahead`); a recall block is
            # still decided once. By compare-and-set on the text the call
            # held, like the plan. A rebuild in between took the plan's
            # own `t-plan`: what the turn decides from there on stays in
            # its row, and the next turn checks those blocks once more.
            # wall-clock: pending_sweep_s (the age the sweep takes the row at)
            ops.append(("t-tcut", upd("state", {"value": turn_cut_text(
                dict(t_tc["meta"], parked_at=now()), t_text)},
                {"key": str(t_tc.get("key") or ""),
                 "value": turn_cut_text(t_tc["meta"], seen)})))
    cw = cw_of(usage.get("context_window"))
    if usage.get("context_window") not in (None, ""):
        # The window the model reported, for the aim of the next rebuild (the
        # rebuild starts on a strike of the clock, which carries no usage).
        ops.append(("t-cw", upd("state", {"value": str(cw)}, {"key": "context_window"})))
        if a_target is not None:
            # Review m1 of c3b: the target's own copy, the one `cut_budget`
            # cuts that target's row to.
            ops += put("t-cww", target_key(a_target, "context_window"), str(cw))
    # The usable window: the model's own (R-IG-1, GH #1085). Until 1.11.2 a
    # role's `quality_cap` cut it (GH #892, talky 120000): luna's 250000 was
    # 120000, and without the row's limits a rebuild came at 60000.
    usable = cw
    try:
        soft_now = int(float(usage.get("input_soft")))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        soft_now = 0
    if soft_now > 0:
        # GH #1040: the answering model's `input_soft` (the llm cell's stamp,
        # GH #1037), kept for `./push`: the memory ask of the NEXT turn leaves
        # before this model answers again, and the memory hive sizes its
        # bundle and its query by it. Cut to the model's own window (review
        # M1) and to nothing else (GH #1085): luna's row is 250k for every
        # role. An answer without a stamp leaves the last value standing;
        # since GH #1037 every llm answer of a model with a package stamps
        # one.
        if usable > 0:
            soft_now = min(soft_now, usable)
        if a_target is not None:
            ops += put("t-soft", target_key(a_target, "input_soft"), str(soft_now))
        if a_wall:
            # The bare key is the wall's: `./push` sizes the memory ask by it.
            ops += put("t-soft0", "input_soft", str(soft_now))
    tp = usage.get("tokens_prompt")
    due, why = None, ""
    t_now = now_ms()
    # GH #1038: the answering model's limits and prices decide first; the
    # usable window's share orders a rebuild only without them.
    limits = limits_of(usage)
    # GH #1225 (K-3, OR-KF-7): no package and no window known -- the
    # fallback row stands in (`FALLBACK_LIMITS`), said once per round.
    stand_in = "input_soft" not in limits and usable <= 0 and "input_soft" in FALLBACK_LIMITS
    if stand_in:
        limits = dict(FALLBACK_LIMITS, **limits)
    if "chars_per_token" in limits:
        # The answering row's rate, for the estimate of the next rebuild (it
        # starts on a strike of the clock, which carries no usage; review #5).
        ops += put("t-rate", "chars_per_token", repr(float(limits["chars_per_token"])))
    window = tp
    nxt = 0
    if "input_soft" in limits:
        # The package's rule measures the window, never a continuation's sum
        # (review M2), and looks one window ahead at the cell's estimate
        # (review M3). Without the package the rule of before is untouched.
        window = window_of(tp, projected)
        nxt = (projected + estimate_tokens(stash.get("messages") or [])) if projected else 0
    # GH #1272 (mark `day`): a role with a day horizon rebuilds when its
    # turn is on another UTC day than the newest round of its last rebuild.
    # The turn's day is its own time where `./intake` stamped one (a replay
    # channel's `happened_at`, the clock the rows age by) and this tap's
    # clock otherwise. A round that never rebuilt starts the count at the
    # day of its first answer.
    day_due = False
    if HORIZON == "day":
        t_day = day_of(stash.get("turn_at") or t_now)
        try:
            last_day = int(state.get(rkey("last_rebuild_day")) or 0)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            last_day = 0
        if t_day is not None and last_day <= 0:
            ops += put("t-day", rkey("last_rebuild_day"), str(t_day))
        elif t_day is not None and t_day != last_day:
            day_due = True
    # Review I-1 (GH #1272): the window of the round's last `target` order,
    # kept while the window stays over the target -- `curate_mark` waits for
    # new load before it orders the next one. A later turn lowers it to its
    # own window (review I-3): the hold counts the growth since the lowest
    # window after the order, the one the rebuild left, not since the order.
    target_at = cw_int(state.get(rkey("target_at")))
    cm = curate_mark(window, limits, None, nxt, day_due, target_at)
    mark = cm["mark"]
    if mark == "none" and a_est.get(MOVED_FIELD):
        # GH #1497: the call was cut by the catalogue rows its target's
        # window was first cut by on this plan, and a row has moved since
        # (`form_view`): the change of plan that takes it on, ordered like
        # every other one -- through the clock, so it waits for the end of a
        # round that runs (contract point 5) -- and only cutting anew. Every
        # other order cuts with the rows as they stand all the same.
        mark = CATALOG_MARK
    if mark == "target" and isinstance(window, (int, float)):
        ops += put("t-tat", rkey("target_at"), str(int(window)))
    elif target_at and isinstance(window, (int, float)) and window < WINDOW_TARGET:
        ops += put("t-tat", rkey("target_at"), "")
    elif target_at and isinstance(window, (int, float)) and window < target_at:
        ops += put("t-tat", rkey("target_at"), str(int(min(target_at, window))))
    if "input_soft" in limits or mark in ("target", "day"):
        aim = cm["rebuild_to"] or (int(limits["input_soft"]) if mark == "hard" else 0)
        ops += put("t-aim", rkey("aim"), str(aim) if aim else "")
    else:
        ops += put("t-aim", rkey("aim"), "")
    tc = usage.get("tokens_cached")
    said_now = {"call": call, "curate_mark": mark,
                **({"target_hold": cm["hold"]} if "hold" in cm else {}),
                "window_tokens": window if isinstance(window, (int, float)) else None,
                "cached_tokens": tc if isinstance(tc, (int, float)) else None,
                "cost_cents": cost_cents(window, tc, limits)}
    if projected:
        said_now["window_estimate"] = projected
    # GH #1427: the raw part of the call's window (`raw_tokens`, `raw_rounds`);
    # GH #1463: with the snapshot of the window on, the call's own watch
    # beside it (`prefix_break`, `window_lost`, phase `win`).
    said_now.update(raw_part)
    if SNAPSHOT_WINDOW:
        # GH #1463 (contract point 7): how many replayed thinking blocks the
        # provider dropped on this call -- `./intake` counted them off the
        # body of the answer (`meta.thinking_dropped`, the model cell's
        # list); a call without the count dropped none.
        said_now["thinking_dropped"] = cw_int(usage.get("thinking_dropped"))
    for k in ("input_soft", "input_hard"):
        if k in limits:
            said_now[k] = int(limits[k])
    ops += put("t-cur", rkey("curate"), canonical(said_now))
    if "input_hard" in limits:
        # GH #1225 (K-2): the hard line of the model that answers, for the
        # guard of the next call (`win`, OR-KF-6).
        if a_target is not None:
            ops += put("t-hard", target_key(a_target, "input_hard"),
                       str(int(limits["input_hard"])))
        if a_wall:
            ops += put("t-hard0", "input_hard", str(int(limits["input_hard"])))
    done_reason = ""
    if stand_in:
        # One `no_package` mark per round (OR-KF-7): written only while the
        # round has none, in one statement (`if_absent`); `done` says it on
        # stderr when this one was written.
        missing = [k for k in PACKAGE_KEYS if usage.get(k) in (None, "")]
        mrow = with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(now()) + 1, "session_id": str(stash.get("session") or ""),
            "turn_id": str(stash.get("turn") or ""), "kind": "no_package",
            "value": canonical({"call": call, "missing": missing,
                                "row": str(P.get("input_soft_fallback_row") or "")}),
            "at": now()}, the_round)
        ops.append(("t-nopkg", dict(ins("marks", mrow), if_absent={
            "kind": "no_package", "audience_set": mrow["audience_set"]})))
        done_reason = "no_package:" + ",".join(missing)
    if limits:
        # One row per turn in the ledger, with the round of the call.
        ops.append(("t-mark", ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(now()), "session_id": str(stash.get("session") or ""),
            "turn_id": str(stash.get("turn") or ""), "kind": "curate",
            "value": canonical(said_now), "at": now()}, the_round))))
    if mark != "none":
        # Over a limit, or dearer to keep than to rebuild: rebuild now --
        # through the clock, like the line below.
        due, why = t_now + 1000, mark
    elif "input_soft" not in limits and usable > 0 and isinstance(tp, (int, float)) \
            and tp >= COMPRESS_AT * usable:
        # The prompt crossed the line: rebuild now -- through the clock, so the
        # rebuild starts on a message of its own and the call that crossed the
        # line is already on its way.
        due, why = t_now + 1000, "compress"
    else:
        expiry = epoch_ms(usage.get("cache_expires_at"))
        if expiry is None and stand_in and FALLBACK_TTL_S > 0:
            # No stamp of the cache: the row's TTL from this answer on.
            expiry = t_now + FALLBACK_TTL_S * 1000
        if expiry is not None:
            # A stamp already past (at_in_past) is a cold cache NOW: the earliest
            # second the timer accepts.
            due, why = max(expiry, t_now + 1000), "cache"
    clock = []
    if due is not None:
        # One order per round, re-armed in place (GH #904, GH #943): whatever
        # the round's row holds -- its last call's order, active or already
        # struck -- it now holds this one. No `remove` + `add` pair, no row
        # per call, and no call of another round re-arms it.
        #
        # THE ROUND RIDES WITH THE ORDER (GH #925, OR-BD.A.6). A strike is a
        # fresh root (the timer emits it through its OriginSink) and carries
        # no context, and every rebuild starts on one -- so without this no
        # rebuild would ever have a round, and a rebuild without a round makes
        # no summary: in operation, never one. The order carries the round of
        # this call (the tap brings its context) as `emit_headers`; the timer
        # emits them as hop keys of the strike, and the edge `./clock ->
        # ./policy` lifts `hop.audience_set` into the context. `rearm`
        # replaces the whole order of the round. A call without a round
        # orders an empty one: that rebuild makes no summary and cuts the
        # window all the same (review I-3).
        clock.append({"header": {"route": "clock"}, "messages": [], "op": "add",
                      "schedule_id": clock_id(the_rk), "rearm": True,
                      "schedule_name": "cache",
                      "at": iso_z(due), "emit_to": "../policy",
                      "emit_body": dict({"messages": [], "curator_call": call, "reason": why},
                                        **({"curate_mark": mark} if limits else {}),
                                        **({"target": a_ref} if a_ref else {})),
                      "emit_headers": {"audience_set": audience_of(the_round) or ""}})
        ops += put("t-armed", rkey("armed_call"), call)
    # Contract point 3: the answer of a target that holds its tree and
    # closes the turn releases the turn's system (a projection of before
    # names no target: its way says it, as before).
    a_closes = not a_est.get("open") if "target" in a_est else True
    a_frees = (bool(a_est.get("tree")) and a_closes) if "target" in a_est else True
    if a_frees and not a_side \
            and str(stash.get("finish") or "") != "tool_calls" \
            and str(stash.get("tool_round") or "") != "1" and str(stash.get("turn") or ""):
        # Review m3 of F2: the brain's answer ends the turn -- its system row
        # goes (the next turn builds its own). F2d: so does an answer whose
        # way is not known -- its projection fell with the next call of the
        # round (`f-est-old`) while another turn of the session ran; a final
        # answer ends its turn whatever the way, and an ended turn keeps no row.
        ops.append(("t-tsys", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                               "where": {"key": turn_system_key(
                                   str(stash.get("session") or "default"),
                                   str(stash.get("turn") or ""))}}))
    esc = []
    if str(stash.get("tool_round") or "") == "1":
        esc_call = call + ESC_SUFFIX
        if str(stash.get("finish") or "") == "tool_calls":
            ops.append(("t-escd", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                                   "where": {"key": "pending:" + esc_call}}))
        else:
            # GH #1260 (OR-WG-9): the tool round ended without its call (lab
            # r026c: an HTTP 404 of a host that refuses a forced call, three of
            # three turns silent after the bridge; elsewhere prose with a
            # made-up answer). The round goes to the brain, from the parked
            # turn `win` kept.
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: call %s of a tool round came back without a"
                             " tool call (finish %r) -- the round goes to the brain\n"
                             % (call, str(stash.get("finish") or "")))
            detail = {"finish": str(stash.get("finish") or "")}
            if stash.get("error_code"):
                detail["error"] = str(stash.get("error_code"))
            esc = [lstore(slim_reads(esc_call), "win-plan", esc_call,
                          ESCALATE + "no_tool_call:" + canonical(detail))]
    elif a_esc and not a_side:
        # GH #1352: a quick call that came back without an answer -- the llm
        # cell's error (a `tool_call_limit` cut, a timeout, a provider error)
        # or a content filter -- goes to the brain like a tool round without
        # its call (GH #1260), from the copy `win` kept; reason `no_answer`.
        # Before, the error left for the drain and the turn ended in silence.
        # A bridge keeps none: its errand
        # answers the turn. Every other end drops the copy.
        esc_call = call + ESC_SUFFIX
        q_finish = str(stash.get("finish") or "")
        if q_finish in ("error", "content_filter"):
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: quick call %s came back without an answer"
                             " (finish %r) -- the round goes to the brain\n"
                             % (call, q_finish))
            detail = {"finish": q_finish}
            if stash.get("error_code"):
                detail["error"] = str(stash.get("error_code"))
            esc = [lstore(slim_reads(esc_call), "win-plan", esc_call,
                          ESCALATE + "no_answer:" + canonical(detail))]
        else:
            ops.append(("t-escd", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                                   "where": {"key": "pending:" + esc_call}}))
    t_turn = str(stash.get("turn") or "")
    if t_turn:
        # GH #1279 / #1432 (GH #1447: the rows are the lead's): a delta row of
        # the turn ends with it; the turn's answer is in -- a shown spec
        # sentence has done its work (an escalation keeps it for the brain).
        # D58 moveout (contract point 7): the answer that closes the turn's
        # round says when (`round_end`, ms of the epoch) -- the lead books the
        # round's duration from the time of its seam (`lead_note` "round");
        # the condition is the booking's of before the move (GH #1400).
        t_end = {}
        if not esc and a_closes and not a_side \
                and str(stash.get("finish") or "") not in ("tool_calls", "error", "content_filter") \
                and str(stash.get("tool_round") or "") != "1":
            t_end["round_end"] = epoch_ms(now())
        _ALSO.extend(lead_note("turn_end", str(stash.get("session") or "default"), t_turn,
                               shown_end=bool(not esc and not a_side
                                              and str(stash.get("finish") or "") != "tool_calls"
                                              and str(stash.get("tool_round") or "") != "1"),
                               **t_end))
    if LIVE_FEED and t_turn and not esc and a_closes \
            and not a_side \
            and str(stash.get("finish") or "") not in ("tool_calls", "error", "content_filter") \
            and str(stash.get("tool_round") or "") != "1":
        # GH #1279: the turn is closed -- its live feed is decided on reads
        # of its own (phase `live`).
        l_ses = str(stash.get("session") or "default")
        _ALSO.append(lstore(live_reads(l_ses, t_turn), "live", call,
                            canonical({"s": l_ses, "t": t_turn})))
    t_tc = t_plan.get("turn_cut") if RECALL_IN_WALL and isinstance(t_plan, dict) else None
    if isinstance(t_tc, dict) and t_tc.get("key") \
            and str(stash.get("finish") or "") != "tool_calls" and not esc \
            and str(stash.get("tool_round") or "") != "1":
        # GH #1471 (contract point 4): the answer ends the turn -- a final
        # answer, an error, a timeout --, and what the turn was cut by ends
        # with it. An answer that asks for a tool, one whose turn is handed
        # on (`esc`) and the sentence beside a required tool call keep it:
        # their next call comes. A row no answer takes down goes with the
        # sweep of the parked rows (`sweep_ops`, `pending_sweep_s`).
        ops.append(("t-tcutd", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                                "where": {"key": str(t_tc.get("key"))}}))
    emit([lstore(ops + t_err, "done", call, done_reason)] + clock + esc)

if phase == "rb-probe":
    # A13: the parked rows past their age fall beside whatever this probe
    # decides, in a bundle of their own (`swept`).
    swept, swept_keys = sweep_ops(rows(lg, "p-pend"), now_ms())
    if swept:
        # The keys ride as the reason: the mark names only what went.
        sw_reason = canonical(swept_keys)
        sw_errands = sweep_errands(rows(lg, "p-pend"), swept_keys) if ERRAND_OUTCOME else {}
        if sw_errands:
            # GH #1469: beside them the errands without an answer, as read,
            # and the end of the wall -- the answer files their outcome.
            sw_after = (rows(lg, "p-wseq") or [{}])[0].get("seq") or 0
            sw_reason = canonical({"keys": swept_keys, "errands": sw_errands,
                                   "after": sw_after})
        _ALSO.append(lstore(swept, "swept", call, sw_reason))
    # A refused read of the parked rows sweeps nothing this time, said
    # (review M-1 of KR-P2); the rebuild runs on, the next probe reads again.
    pend_failed = failed_legs(lg, ("p-pend",))
    failed = failed_legs(lg, ("p-state", "p-sum", "p-call"))
    if pend_failed and not failed:
        report_errors(lg)
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: the store refused the read of the parked rows (%s)"
                         " -- nothing swept this time\n" % STORE_ERROR)
        _ALSO.append(lstore([store_error_mark("q-err", phase, pend_failed)], "swept", call, ""))
    failed = dict(failed, **pend_failed) if failed else failed
    if failed:
        # GH #1225 (A3): a probe the store refused knows neither the round's
        # lock nor its plan -- a rebuild from it would start over an empty
        # plan. It stops with its mark; nothing is claimed, the old window
        # stays, the next trigger probes anew.
        report_errors(lg)
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: the store refused the probe of a rebuild (%s) --"
                         " no rebuild, the old window stays (%s)\n"
                         % (", ".join(sorted(failed)), STORE_ERROR))
        emit([lstore([store_error_mark("e-mark", phase, failed)], "done", call, "")])
    state = state_of(lg, "p-state")
    # Nachtrag 11.11.: the row of the order's target (the one catalogue row
    # the probe read) carries the wall's values; the claim takes them on to
    # the rebuild's later steps. No row with a profile: the instance's.
    p_ref = (held_targets(state) or [""])[0]
    p_wall = profile_held(p_ref, state)
    if p_wall:
        (KEEP_RECENT, KEEP_RECENT_TOKENS, COMPRESS_AT, REBUILD_TO, HORIZON, TIERS, KEEP_ROUNDS,
     GC, GC_SCAFFOLD, STUB_TOOLS_AFTER, WINDOW_TARGET, STATE_LINES) = wall_values(p_wall)
    # GH #943: stale against the last call of THIS round -- a call of another
    # round makes no strike of this one stale.
    if call and call != state.get(rkey("last_call"), ""):
        park("a fire for call %s, the last call is %s -- stale, dropped"
             % (call, state.get(rkey("last_call"), "")))
    if GC_ON_COLD and GC and reason == "cache" and call:
        # GH #1464 (contract 7): a running turn or an open tool round is
        # never collected. `last_call` names the last call ANSWERED; a call
        # that left since -- the first of a new round, the next iteration of
        # a tool round -- is out now and warmed the cache: the stroke lapses,
        # the tap of that call orders the next one.
        newest = str((rows(lg, "p-newest") or [{}])[0].get("call_id") or "")
        if newest and newest != call:
            park("the cache of call %s ran out, but call %s left since -- it warmed the"
                 " cache, the cold stroke lapses" % (call, newest))
    running = state.get(rkey("rebuild_running"), "")
    if running:
        info = loads(running, {})
        started = epoch_ms(info.get("at")) or 0
        if now_ms() - started < REBUILD_STALE_S * 1000:
            park("a rebuild is running -- this trigger (%s) merges into it" % reason)
    backoff = loads(state.get(rkey("rebuild_backoff"), ""), {})
    # GH #1497: a change of plan for a moved catalogue row asks no model, so
    # it never backs off -- the target would keep the old row meanwhile.
    if backoff and reason not in ("cache", CATALOG_MARK) \
            and int(backoff.get("turns") or 0) < AMORTISE_TURNS:
        # GH #1225 (K-2): the round's last rebuild failed (`old_window_kept`).
        # An order of a line crossed (soft, hard, cost, compress) makes no
        # summarizer call before the cache went cold or `amortise_turns` such
        # orders passed -- said as a `rebuild_backoff` mark each time; the
        # call itself stays under `input_hard` meanwhile (`win`).
        n = int(backoff.get("turns") or 0) + 1
        stamp = now()
        session = str((rows(lg, "p-call") or [{}])[0].get("session_id") or "")
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: the last rebuild of this round failed -- the %s"
                         " order backs off (%d of %d)\n" % (reason, n, AMORTISE_TURNS))
        emit([lstore(put("p-boff", rkey("rebuild_backoff"),
                         canonical(dict(backoff, turns=n)))
                     + [("p-boffm", ins("marks", with_audience({
                         "seq": epoch_us(stamp), "session_id": session, "turn_id": "",
                         "kind": "rebuild_backoff",
                         "value": canonical({"call": call, "reason": reason, "turns": n,
                                             "of": AMORTISE_TURNS}),
                         "at": stamp}, the_round)))],
                     "done", call, "")])
    prev = prev_of(plan_of(state), (rows(lg, "p-sum") or [{}])[0])
    as_of = now_ms()
    # The session of the call that started the rebuild (review I-4): the plan
    # names it, so a rebuild is a new epoch for that session alone.
    session = str((rows(lg, "p-call") or [{}])[0].get("session_id") or "")
    # OR-BC.W.3: the handover leaf goes with this rebuild only if it is this
    # round's -- its binding names the round of the rebuild. The leaf of a
    # session of round B fell at a rebuild of round A.
    # GH #949 (review M-4 of GH #943): a leaf bound to NO audience (`null`:
    # `./handover` met an undeclared round -- a round-less session -- or a
    # source from before the rule) is no round's and never fell. It reaches
    # no round, its own session's included (`allowed` refuses an undeclared
    # audience), so no round loses it: it goes with the rebuild of ANY round.
    # Not only with the round `[]`: a `null` from a source before the rule
    # stands in a hive whose calls may all name a round, and that hive never
    # rebuilds `[]`. The claim names the leaf's hash (`finish`).
    hb = leaf_binding(state.get("handover_audience", ""))
    hb_aud = audience_of(hb[1]) if hb is not None else None
    unleaf = hb[0] if hb is not None and hb_aud in (None, round_canon(the_round)) else ""
    # The token rides as `cur_reason` from `rb-claim` on (review M-1 of GH
    # #955): a refused bundle frees the claim only while it holds this token.
    # The trigger's reason stays in the claim itself (`why` in `rb-data`).
    token = str(uuid.uuid4())
    claim = canonical(dict({"reason": reason, "token": token, "at": now(),
                       "call": call, "session": session, "as_of_ms": as_of,
                       "cw": cw_of(state.get("context_window")), "prev": prev,
                       "aim": cw_int(state.get(rkey("aim"))),
                       # GH #1450 Z1.10 (OR-d38-3.c3b.5): the rate of the
                       # order's target's row before the tap's copy, as the
                       # call counts.
                       "chars_per_token": cut_budget(p_ref, state)["rate"],
                       "unleaf": unleaf},
                      # GH #1448 (C2 rule c): only with the knob on, so the
                      # claim of before stays byte for byte.
                      **({"brain_busy": True} if SUMMARIZER_SELF
                         and brain_busy(rows(lg, "p-pend"), session) else {}),
                      **({"wall": {"target": p_ref, "profile": p_wall}} if p_wall else {})))
    span = read_from(prev)
    # GH #932 (review I-1): the rebuild reads the rows of its own round only.
    rw = rebuild_where(the_round)
    cols = ["seq", "session_id", "turn_id", "iter", "kind", "hash", "nth", "final", "at"]
    # The round's lock (GH #943): CAS on the row the read found, an insert
    # (the unique index makes it the same CAS) for a round that has none yet.
    ops = [cas_put("c-claim", rkey("rebuild_running"), claim, state),
           ("c-me", sel("state", ["key", "value"], {"key": rkey("rebuild_running")})),
           ("c-wall", sel("wall", cols, dict(span, **rw), [("seq", "asc")])),
           ("c-slots", sel("slots", ["path", "hash", "owner", "at"])),
           ("c-pins", sel("pins", ["hash", "source", "until", "at", "audience_set"], dict(rw)))]
    emit([lstore(ops, "rb-claim", call, token)])

if phase == "rb-claim":
    code = (lg.get("c-claim") or {}).get("error_code", "")
    if code and code != "unique_violation":
        # GH #1225 (A3): the claim was refused, not lost to another trigger:
        # no claim is held, the rebuild stops with its mark.
        report_errors(lg)
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: the store refused the claim of a rebuild (%s) --"
                         " no rebuild, the old window stays (%s)\n" % (code, STORE_ERROR))
        emit([lstore([store_error_mark("e-mark", phase, failed_legs(lg))], "done", call, "")])
    if (lg.get("c-claim") or {}).get("rows_affected", 0) != 1:
        park("another trigger claimed the rebuild first -- merged")
    release_refused(lg, phase, reason)
    info = loads(str((rows(lg, "c-me") or [{}])[0].get("value") or ""), {})
    if claim_wall(info):
        (KEEP_RECENT, KEEP_RECENT_TOKENS, COMPRESS_AT, REBUILD_TO, HORIZON, TIERS, KEEP_ROUNDS,
     GC, GC_SCAFFOLD, STUB_TOOLS_AFTER, WINDOW_TARGET, STATE_LINES) = wall_values(claim_wall(info))
    prev = info.get("prev") or {}
    span = read_from(prev)
    model_pins = sorted(str(p.get("hash") or "") for p in rows(lg, "c-pins")
                        if str(p.get("source") or "") == MODEL_SOURCE)
    needed = sorted({str(r.get("hash") or "") for r in rows(lg, "c-wall")}
                    | {str(r.get("hash") or "") for r in own_slots(rows(lg, "c-slots"),
                                                                  the_rk)}
                    | {str(r.get("hash") or "") for r in rows(lg, "c-pins")}
                    | ({str(prev.get("hash"))} if prev.get("hash") else set()))
    # GH #925: the transcript is gated row by row, so each row brings its
    # audience. GH #932 (review I-1): every read that shapes the plan -- the
    # wall, the topics, the model's marks and pins, the rows it holds --
    # reads the rows of the round of the rebuild alone (`rebuild_where`).
    rw = rebuild_where(the_round)
    # GH #1225 (K-1): with the turn time a row ages by (`row_time`).
    # GH #1468: `failed`, the verdict on a tool result (`result_failed`).
    cols = ["seq", "session_id", "turn_id", "iter", "kind", "hash", "nth", "final", "at",
            "audience_set", "turn_at", "failed"]
    mcols = ["seq", "session_id", "turn_id", "kind", "value"]
    topic_span = dict(span)
    topic_span["kind"] = "topic"
    # The marks after this round's own cursor (`marks_to_by`; a plan from
    # before it has `marks_to`, the floor of every round): a cursor over all
    # rounds would pass over the marks a round it does not read has said.
    by = prev.get("marks_to_by") if isinstance(prev.get("marks_to_by"), dict) else {}
    cursor = int(by.get(round_canon(the_round), prev.get("marks_to") or 0) or 0)
    ops = [("n-me", sel("state", ["key", "value"],
                        {"key": {"in": [rkey("rebuild_running"), rkey("actions_pending"),
                                        "window_plans", "input_soft",
                                        "summarizer_input_soft"]}})),
           ("n-wall", sel("wall", cols, dict(span, **rw), [("seq", "asc")])),
           ("n-topic", sel("marks", mcols, dict(topic_span, **rw), [("seq", "asc")])),
           # The round a `pin` was said in is part of the pin's audience
           # (review C-1).
           ("n-trim", sel("marks", mcols + ["audience_set"],
                          dict({"kind": {"in": ["release", "pin"]},
                                "seq": {"gt": cursor}}, **rw),
                          [("seq", "asc")])),
           ("n-slots", sel("slots", ["path", "hash", "owner", "at"])),
           ("n-pins", sel("pins", ["hash", "source", "until", "at", "audience_set"], dict(rw)))]
    if needed:
        ops.append(("n-blocks", sel("blocks", ["hash", "kind", "chars", "body"],
                                    {"hash": {"in": needed}})))
    if model_pins:
        ops.append(("n-kept", sel("wall", cols, dict({"hash": {"in": model_pins}}, **rw),
                                  [("seq", "asc")])))
    if SUMMARY_FORM == "brief" and prev.get("summary") and prev.get("hash"):
        # GH #1440: a chained brief counts the wall rows of the brief before
        # as its sources, never that brief's hash (`transcript_of`).
        ops.append(("n-psrc", sel("summaries", ["id", "sources"],
                                  {"id": str(prev.get("summary"))})))
    if SUMMARY_STATE_COND and STATE_LINES > 0:
        # GH #1440 (OR-38-42, OR-d38-2.z3.4): the rows of the state line the
        # summarizer is handed as the list to keep -- the reads of the window's
        # line (`w-smarks`, `w-sdlg`) for the session that started the
        # rebuild; its consult row is the lead's (GH #1447: `lead_errand`
        # below). The pins and their texts ride in `n-pins`/`n-blocks`
        # already. Off, or a role whose cap is 0, no leg: the bundle of before.
        s_sess = str(info.get("session") or "")
        s_marks = round_sel("marks", ["seq", "session_id", "kind", "value", "at",
                                      "audience_set"],
                            {"kind": {"in": ["fact", "gap", "addendum"]},
                             "seq": {"gte": now_ms() // 86400000 * 86400000000}},
                            the_round, s_sess, [("seq", "desc")], STATE_READ)
        if s_marks is not None:
            ops.append(("n-smarks", s_marks))
        if s_sess:
            # OR-d38-3.o15.8: a delegation may be parked under a handle the
            # rebuild never knows (v.25: the strike lifts only `audience_set`)
            # -- the leg reads the whole prefix (one colony, one member) and
            # the audience the row carries decides below (D58 live, contract
            # point 7: always, the knob fell).
            ops += [("n-sdlg", sel("state", ["key", "value"],
                                   {"key": {"gt": DELEGATION_KEY}},
                                   [("key", "asc")], STATE_READ)),
]
    if SUMMARIZER_SELF and call and str(info.get("reason") or "cache") != "cache" \
            and not info.get("brain_busy"):
        # GH #1440 (OR-38-42 A1): the record of the round's last call (the
        # fire's own, `rb-probe` dropped any other) -- the prefix the role's
        # model holds in its cache -- and its turn. Off, no leg: the bundle of
        # before. A rebuild for an expired cache (review r1 M1) finds the
        # prefix cold: the role would pay the full price for a prefix that is
        # replaced right after, so the summarizer condenses.
        ops.append(("n-lcall", sel("call_blocks", ["pos", "hash"], {"call_id": call},
                                   [("pos", "asc")])))
        ops.append(("n-lcturn", sel("calls", ["turn_id"], {"call_id": call})))
    # D58 lead (GH #1474, contract point 3): without a lead the bundle goes
    # straight to the ledger; `rb-data` finds no verdict on the reason and
    # builds the state line with no running errand.
    if LEAD_WIRED and SUMMARY_STATE_COND and STATE_LINES > 0 \
            and str(info.get("session") or ""):
        # GH #1447: the consult row of the state line lives in the lead's
        # store, not in the ledger (the leg `n-sstate` of before): the lead
        # reads it and hands the bundle back with it (`in_lead`, `LEADV` on
        # the reason) -- one round trip, no RAM, the ledger reads unchanged.
        emit([lead_errand(call, str(info.get("session") or ""),
                          lstore(ops, "rb-data", call, reason))])
    emit([lstore(ops, "rb-data", call, reason)])

def apply_now(info, result, why, pending_actions, me, stamp, state, extra_ops=()):
    """A rebuild that needs no summary ends here: its plan is the window from
    now on (`finish`). GH #1471: at once, whatever call is out -- a turn
    that runs is cut by its own row (`turn_cut_key`). `extra_ops` ride
    with it (GH #1464: the mark of a cold collection)."""
    emit([lstore(finish(info, result, why, pending_actions, me, stamp, extra_ops=extra_ops,
                        state=state),
                 "done", call, reason)])


def cold_mark_op(info, stamp):
    """The mark of a cold collection (GH #1464, OR-d58-2.coldgc.2): a
    `curate` mark with `curate_mark` "cold" for the call whose cache ran out,
    `cost_cents` 0 -- no model was asked -- and no `window_tokens`, so the
    figure `rebuild` of `./stats` counts it as a rebuild and `window` does
    not count it as a turn. Two past the stamp: `over_aim` and `gc` hold
    the stamp and the one after it."""
    return ("f-cold", ins("marks", with_audience({
        "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 2, "session_id": str(info.get("session") or ""),
        "turn_id": "", "kind": "curate",
        "value": canonical({"call": str(info.get("call") or ""), "curate_mark": "cold",
                            "cost_cents": 0}),
        "at": stamp}, the_round)))


if phase == "rb-data":
    # GH #1447: the errand the lead handed back (`lead_errand`) rides in
    # front of the claim's token.
    r_lead = {}
    if reason.startswith(LEADV):
        r_lead = lead_of(reason)
        reason = reason_flags(reason)[1]
    release_refused(lg, phase, reason)
    state = state_of(lg, "n-me")
    me = state.get(rkey("rebuild_running"), "")
    info = loads(me, {})
    if not info.get("token"):
        park("the rebuild claim is gone -- dropped")
    if claim_wall(info):
        (KEEP_RECENT, KEEP_RECENT_TOKENS, COMPRESS_AT, REBUILD_TO, HORIZON, TIERS, KEEP_ROUNDS,
     GC, GC_SCAFFOLD, STUB_TOOLS_AFTER, WINDOW_TARGET, STATE_LINES) = wall_values(claim_wall(info))
    prev = info.get("prev") or {}
    blocks = {}
    for r in rows(lg, "n-blocks"):
        blocks.setdefault(str(r.get("hash") or ""), r)
    # GH #1434: the cap `render` cuts a final answer's sidecar block at, from
    # the window the rebuild reads (`input_soft`, the brain's) -- the budget
    # measures such an answer at the text the window sends (`with_cut`).
    cut_cap = budget_chars(state.get("input_soft", ""), SIDECAR_SHARE)

    def enrich(r):
        b = blocks.get(str(r.get("hash") or "")) or {}
        el = element_of(b) or {}
        out = dict(r, chars=int(b.get("chars") or 0), type=str(el.get("type") or ""))
        if el.get("type") == "tool_call":
            try:
                out["name"] = str((json.loads(str(el.get("text") or "{}")) or {}).get("name") or "")
            except Exception:
                out["name"] = ""
        if el.get("type") == "tool_result":
            # GH #1430: what the collection reads off a result -- structure
            # only: an error object, a recall result (the ledger kind
            # `recall` of `./intake` covers the model's own `memory_recall`,
            # the id the ambient one -- review M-1), its rows.
            # GH #1468: the verdict of the row where `./intake` wrote one.
            out["error"] = result_failed(r, el)
            out["recall"] = str(r.get("kind") or "") == "recall" \
                or ambient_of(el) == "recall"
            if out["recall"]:
                out["lines"] = row_lines(el.get("text"))
                if RECALL_IN_WALL:
                    # GH #1463: the quotes of the result, for the whole-block
                    # check of the collection (`gc_quoted`); [] = no quote.
                    out["quotes"] = recall_quotes(el.get("text")) or []
        if RECALL_IN_WALL and said_hash(el):
            # GH #1463: what a quote must equal to stand raw in the window.
            out["said"] = said_hash(el)
        if el.get("valid_until") is not None:
            out["valid_until"] = el.get("valid_until")
        return with_cut(out, el, cut_cap)

    # GH #1463: a pair a call left out is no row of the window, for the
    # rebuild as for every call after the decision; the new plan keeps the list.
    left_out = set(str(h) for h in (prev.get("left_out") or [])) if KEEPS_LEFT_OUT else set()
    wall = [enrich(r) for r in rows(lg, "n-wall") if str(r.get("hash") or "") not in left_out]
    low = min([int(r["seq"]) for r in wall] or [0])
    kept = [enrich(r) for r in rows(lg, "n-kept") if (not wall or int(r["seq"]) < low)
            and str(r.get("hash") or "") not in left_out]
    slots = [(str(r.get("path") or ""), str(r.get("hash") or ""),
              int((blocks.get(str(r.get("hash") or "")) or {}).get("chars") or 0))
             for r in own_slots(rows(lg, "n-slots"), the_rk)]
    def plan_with(aim, collect_only=False):
        return window_plan(wall, rows(lg, "n-topic"), rows(lg, "n-trim"), rows(lg, "n-pins"),
                           prev, int(info.get("as_of_ms") or now_ms()), slots, kept,
                           int(info.get("cw") or 0), round_canon(the_round),
                           aim=aim,
                           chars_per_token=rate_of(info.get("chars_per_token")),
                           day_cut=str(info.get("reason") or "") == "day",
                           collect_only=collect_only)

    cold_ops = []
    if GC_ON_COLD and GC and str(info.get("reason") or reason or "cache") == "cache":
        # GH #1464 (D58 coldgc): the cache of the round ran out. Under the aim
        # of the cold cache (`cold_aim_of`; without `cold_to` the claim's aim,
        # else `rebuild_to` of the usable window as `window_plan` reads it)
        # the rebuild only collects -- no model, its own mark (`cold_mark_op`);
        # a collection that takes nothing leaves the window and the ledger as
        # they are. Over the aim the rebuild of before runs, aimed at it.
        result = plan_with(cw_int(info.get("aim")), collect_only=True)
        usable = int(info.get("cw") or 0)
        aim = cold_aim_of(cw_int(info.get("aim"))
                          or (int(REBUILD_TO * usable) if usable > 0 and REBUILD_TO > 0 else 0))
        if aim > 0 and result["estimate"] > aim:
            result = plan_with(aim if COLD_TO is not None else cw_int(info.get("aim")))
        elif not result["collected"]:
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: the cache ran out and the collection finds"
                             " nothing -- the window stays (GH #1464)\n")
            # Every rebuild stamps its round in the registry (GH #943), this
            # one too: `prune_plans` reads the stamp as "used", and a round
            # whose strokes found nothing would otherwise drop with its plan
            # and summary after `round_plan_idle_s` while in use (review I1).
            # No plan, no mark (contract 2); `done` retries a lost `f-reg`.
            emit([lstore([("f-free", upd("state", {"value": ""},
                                         {"key": rkey("rebuild_running"), "value": me}))]
                         + reg_ops(state),
                         "done", call, reason)])
        else:
            cold_ops = [cold_mark_op(info, now())]
    elif str(info.get("reason") or reason or "") == CATALOG_MARK:
        # GH #1497: a catalogue row moved since the target's window was cut on
        # the plan that stands. The change of plan only cuts anew: the plan
        # of before as it is -- cover, summary and pins, nothing condensed, no
        # model asked (`collect_only`) -- under a new state, the one place
        # the next call of each target takes the rows as they stand.
        result = plan_with(cw_int(info.get("aim")), collect_only=True)
    else:
        result = plan_with(cw_int(info.get("aim")))
    for line in result["notes"]:
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: %s\n" % line)
    plan = result["plan"]
    stamp = now()
    plan["at"] = stamp
    # The session whose call started this rebuild (review I-4): a new epoch
    # for its snapshot alone (`window_epoch`); "" -- a clock refusal -- for all.
    plan["session"] = str(info.get("session") or "")
    # GH #1448 (Z1.6): the blocks of the new plan, built after `window_plan`
    # and read by nothing before the summarizer's request (o9.6); a summary
    # carried on stays the brief, a new one takes its place in `sum`.
    plan["blocks"] = rebuild_blocks(plan, wall + kept, blocks, round_canon(the_round))
    plan["blocks_to"] = max([0] + [int(r.get("seq") or 0) for r in wall + kept])
    # Form review M-2: the list ends where the new cover passes it -- a hash
    # stays only while a wall row this rebuild read above its cover holds it,
    # or a row of a model pin does (`n-kept`); no number, the cover is the
    # bound. Below the cover no window reads the row any more.
    new_cover = int(plan.get("cover") or 0)
    left_out = set(str(r.get("hash") or "") for r in rows(lg, "n-wall")
                   if str(r.get("hash") or "") in left_out
                   and int(r.get("seq") or 0) > new_cover) \
        | set(str(r.get("hash") or "") for r in rows(lg, "n-kept")
              if str(r.get("hash") or "") in left_out)
    if left_out:
        plan["left_out"] = sorted(left_out)
    carried = str(prev.get("hash") or "") if plan.get("summary") \
        and plan.get("summary") == prev.get("summary") else ""
    plan.update(with_brief(plan, carried, element_of(blocks.get(carried) or {}),
                           round_canon(the_round)))
    # The round's own row `history.summary:<rk>` (`own_slots` shows it as
    # `history.summary`, GH #943).
    info["slot_exists"] = any(p == SUMMARY_PATH for p, _, _ in slots)
    todo = result["todo"]
    why = str(info.get("reason") or reason or "cache")
    pending_actions = state.get(rkey("actions_pending"), "")
    if not todo:
        # Nothing to condense: the plan is the window from now on.
        apply_now(info, result, why, pending_actions, me, stamp, state,
                  [cold_mark_op(info, stamp)] if cold_ops else ())
    if audience_of(the_round) is None:
        # GH #925 (review I-3): a rebuild without a round -- its strike was
        # armed by a call that had none (the round rides with the order,
        # OR-BD.A.6) -- may hand no row's text to a model. It ends like a
        # round that sees none of the rows, for every reason: the plan stands
        # without a summary and the window is cut all the same. Keeping the
        # old window instead would never cut a conversation without a round
        # again, and it would grow until the provider refused it.
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: a rebuild without a round hands no text to a"
                         " model (GH #925) -- the summary is given up\n")
        lines, sources, auds, went = [], [], [], []
    else:
        chain, old_src = result["chain"], None
        if SUMMARY_FORM == "brief":
            # GH #1440: the brief so far and its sources; an unread source
            # list starts the brief anew, never stops the rebuild.
            info["form"] = "brief"
            old_src = brief_sources(lg) if chain else None
            chain = chain and old_src is not None
            pel = element_of(blocks.get(str(prev.get("hash") or "")) or {}) if chain else None
            if pel is not None and allowed(the_round, prev.get("sum_audience")):
                info["prev_text"] = str(pel.get("text") or "")
            elif not result["chain"] and prev.get("hash") \
                    and allowed(the_round, prev.get("sum_audience")):
                # GH #1448 (OR-38-55 a): the brief before goes with its age,
                # its open lines go on -- merged after the answer (`sum`),
                # never in the summarizer's transcript.
                oel = element_of(blocks.get(str(prev.get("hash") or "")) or {}) or {}
                open_lines = [l for l in brief_lines(oel.get("text"))[0] if l["who"] in BRIEF_OPEN]
                if open_lines:
                    info["carry_text"] = brief_render(open_lines)
        lines, sources, auds, went = transcript_of(todo, blocks, prev, chain, the_round,
                                                   SUMMARY_FORM, old_src)
        # R-IG-1 / OR-IG-4: the transcript is the main content of the
        # summarizer's call, half of ITS window (`summarizer_input_soft`), never
        # of the window it condenses; none known, it goes whole.
        lines, t_cuts = fit_transcript(lines, budget_chars(
            state.get("summarizer_input_soft") or SUMMARIZER_SOFT_FALLBACK, TRANSCRIPT_SHARE))
        if t_cuts:
            info["cuts"] = t_cuts
        if SUMMARY_STATE_COND and STATE_LINES > 0 and sources:
            # GH #1440 (OR-38-42): the state of the round as the list the
            # summary must keep, behind the cut transcript so the cut never
            # meets it (`fit_transcript` cuts the longest lines). A refused
            # state leg never gets here: `release_refused` ends the chain.
            s_rows = dict((str(r.get("key") or ""), str(r.get("value") or ""))
                          for r in rows(lg, "n-sdlg"))
            s_rows = rebuild_delegations(s_rows, str(info.get("session") or ""),
                                         the_round)
            s_pend = r_lead.get("pending")
            if isinstance(s_pend, dict) and s_pend:
                s_rows[ERRAND_ROW + str(info.get("session") or "")] = canonical(s_pend)
            s_texts = dict((h, str((element_of(b) or {}).get("text") or ""))
                           for h, b in blocks.items())
            s_marks = sorted(rows(lg, "n-smarks"), key=lambda r: -int(r.get("seq") or 0))
            s_line = state_block(state_of_rows(s_marks, rows(lg, "n-pins"), s_texts, s_rows,
                                               the_round, str(info.get("session") or ""),
                                               epoch_ms(stamp) or now_ms(), day_of(stamp),
                                               None, live_of(None),
                                               names_list(ctx.get("needs"))),
                                 STATE_COND_PARTS, STATE_LINES)
            if s_line:
                lines = lines + ["", STATE_COND_HEAD, s_line]
        if not sources:
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: the round sees none of the rows to condense"
                             " -- the summary is given up\n")
    if not sources:
        # Nothing to condense for this round: the plan stands without a
        # summary -- window_plan's own give-up.
        result = dict(result, todo=[], chain=False,
                      plan=with_brief(dict(plan, summary="", sum_from=0, sum_to=0), "", None,
                                      round_canon(the_round)))
        apply_now(info, result, why, pending_actions, me, stamp, state)
    # What the summary's head names (review M-1): the newest row that WENT
    # IN, or -- made of a chained summary alone -- what that one named. Not
    # `sum_to`: that may be a row this round may not see, and a `seq` is its
    # time. `covers_to_seq` keeps `sum_to`, the plan's own pointer.
    shown = [int(r.get("seq") or 0) for r in went]
    if str(prev.get("hash") or "") in sources or info.get("prev_text"):
        shown.append(int(prev.get("sum_shown") or 0))
    # The summary reaches whom every source reaches AND the round it was made
    # for (review R2-I-3): the rows went in because THIS round may see them,
    # so a wider round that sees them all would see the summary only as long
    # as no row it may not see went in -- whether it appears would hang on a
    # hidden row (driver: {e,a,b} saw the summary of an {e,a} rebuild over
    # {e,a,b} rows, and lost it when one {e,a} row was among them).
    # The span the head names is the time of the turns that went in
    # (`row_time`, GH #1225 K-1): on a replayed wall the ingest `at` is the
    # minute of the replay, not the week the summary condenses.
    info.update({"result": result, "transcript": "\n".join(lines),
                 "covers_to_seq": int(plan.get("sum_to") or 0), "sources": sources,
                 "shown_to": max(shown or [0]),
                 "audience": meet_of_rows(auds + [the_round]),
                 "first_at": str(row_time(went[0]) or "") if went else "",
                 "last_at": str(row_time(went[-1]) or "") if went else ""})
    send_ops = []
    if SUMMARIZER_SELF and not info.get("brain_busy"):
        # GH #1440 (OR-38-42 A1): the role condenses itself -- its last call's
        # blocks in `pos` order (system leaves and messages, the gh888 record)
        # and the answer that call got (the newest final answer on the wall,
        # its turn's final rows). Without the call's record the summarizer
        # condenses as before (OR-d38-2.z3.13).
        c_hashes = [str(r.get("hash") or "") for r in
                    sorted(rows(lg, "n-lcall"), key=lambda r: int(r.get("pos") or 0))]
        finals = [r for r in sorted(wall, key=lambda r: int(r.get("seq") or 0))
                  if str(r.get("kind") or "") == "assistant" and int(r.get("final") or 0) == 1
                  and (not info.get("session")
                       or str(r.get("session_id") or "") == str(info.get("session")))]
        a_turn = (str(finals[-1].get("session_id") or ""), str(finals[-1].get("turn_id") or "")) \
            if finals else ("", "")
        a_hashes = [str(r.get("hash") or "") for r in finals
                    if (str(r.get("session_id") or ""), str(r.get("turn_id") or "")) == a_turn]
        # Review r1 M3: after a tool round the newest final answer is the one
        # of the turn before -- prefix and answer would not belong together;
        # the summarizer condenses.
        c_turn = str((rows(lg, "n-lcturn") or [{}])[0].get("turn_id") or "")
        if c_hashes and c_turn and c_turn == a_turn[1]:
            info["self"] = {"call": c_hashes, "answer": a_hashes, "turn": a_turn[1]}
            send_ops.append(("n-cblk", sel("blocks", ["hash", "kind", "body"],
                                           {"hash": {"in": sorted(set(c_hashes + a_hashes))}})))
            # Review z3 r2 m1 (class GH #925/#1247): the self call sets the
            # role's tree back the moment it leaves; a call built while the role
            # condenses would diff against the hashes of before and leave a
            # family out. Cleared here, before the send (`s-sent0` clears again
            # after the calls of the window).
            send_ops += put("n-sent0", "system_hash_sent", "{}")
    # The claim's token rides as the reason to `rb-send`, out to the
    # summarizer and home on `in_summary` (the context carries `cur_reason`),
    # so the answer is kept only under the claim it was asked for (review
    # M-10, R2-I-14).
    emit([lstore([("r-note", upd("state", {"value": canonical(info)},
                                 {"key": rkey("rebuild_running"), "value": me})),
                  ("r-me", sel("state", ["key", "value"], {"key": rkey("rebuild_running")}))]
                 + send_ops,
                 "rb-send", call, str(info.get("token") or ""))])

if phase == "rb-send":
    release_refused(lg, phase, reason)
    info = loads(str((rows(lg, "r-me") or [{}])[0].get("value") or ""), {})
    if (lg.get("r-note") or {}).get("rows_affected", 0) != 1 or not info.get("transcript"):
        park("the rebuild note is gone -- dropped")
    head = {"route": "summarize"}
    if info.get("cuts"):
        # Every line this hive cut in the transcript, said on the hop (R-IG-1).
        head["cuts"] = info["cuts"]
    prompt = SUMMARY_PROMPT_BRIEF if info.get("form") == "brief" else SUMMARY_PROMPT
    own = info.get("self") or {}
    if own:
        # GH #1440 (OR-38-42 A1, `summarizer_self` "1"): ONE call to the
        # target that holds the tree, after its answer and outside the hot path:
        # the last call's system (every family whole -- the `llm` keeps one
        # tree, another round's call may have changed it since), its messages
        # as the prefix, the answer it got, and the instruction last. The
        # provider's prefix cache holds all but the tail, so the role
        # condenses at the cached price (arXiv 2611.05306 § 4 A1). The answer
        # comes home on `in_summary_self` (talky, `hop.summarize` "1") and is
        # never said. No `x_title` here: the role's `llm` cell carries it.
        blk = dict((str(r.get("hash") or ""), r) for r in rows(lg, "n-cblk"))
        leaves, msgs, lost = [], [], []
        for h in own.get("call") or []:
            el = element_of(blk.get(h) or {})
            if el is None:
                lost.append(h)
            elif str((blk.get(h) or {}).get("kind") or "") == "system":
                leaves.append((str(el.get("path") or ""), str(el.get("text") or ""), h))
            else:
                msgs.append(el)
        answer = [el for el in (element_of(blk.get(h) or {}) for h in own.get("answer") or [])
                  if el is not None]
        if lost:
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: %d block(s) of the last call are gone -- the"
                             " summarizer condenses (GH #1440)\n" % len(lost))
        else:
            # D58 target (contract point 4, Nachtrag 11.11. Nr. 3): the call
            # goes to the target that holds the tree (the claim's `wall`).
            s_ref = str((info.get("wall") or {}).get("target") or "") \
                if isinstance(info.get("wall"), dict) else ""
            if s_ref:
                head = dict(head, target=s_ref)
            head = dict(head, route=MODEL_ROUTE, summarize="1", summary_call=call,
                        summary_token=str(info.get("token") or ""), curator_call=call,
                        session_id=str(info.get("session") or ""),
                        turn_id=str(own.get("turn") or ""), iter="0")
            out = {"header": head,
                   "messages": msgs + answer + [{
                       "origin": "user", "type": "text",
                       "text": SELF_SUMMARY_HEAD + "\n\n" + prompt + "\n\n"
                       + info["transcript"]}]}
            # The gated and the session families go whole and empty included,
            # as on every call of the hot path (`win`, GH #925).
            fams = sorted({p.split(".")[0] for p, _, _ in leaves}
                          | set(GATED_FAMILIES + SESSION_FAMILIES))
            out["system"] = {f: family_node(f, leaves) for f in fams}
            emit([out])
    emit([{"header": head,
           "system": {"instructions": {"text": SUMMARY_PROMPT_BRIEF
                                       if info.get("form") == "brief" else SUMMARY_PROMPT}},
           "messages": [{"origin": "user", "type": "text", "text": info["transcript"]}]}])

if phase == "sum":
    if failed_legs(lg, ("s-read", "s-put")):
